verses.en_meaning: Salutations to the all-powerful Viṣṇu — by whose mere remembrance one is freed from the bondage of birth and saṃsāra.
verses.words: yasya (whose), smaraṇa-mātreṇa (by mere remembrance), janma-saṃsāra-bandhanāt (from the bondage of birth and worldly existence), vimucyate (one is freed), namaḥ tasmai (salutations to Him), viṣṇave prabhaviṣṇave (to the all-powerful Viṣṇu).

verses.label: VS · Pūrva Pīṭhikā
verses.te_meaning: ఓం. గొప్ప శక్తి గల ప్రభువైన విష్ణువుకు నమస్కారం.
verses.en_meaning: Om. Salutations to Viṣṇu, the Lord of mighty prowess.
verses.words: oṃ (the sacred syllable), namaḥ (salutations), viṣṇave (to Viṣṇu), prabhaviṣṇave (to the all-powerful / Lord of mighty prowess).

verses.label: VS · Pūrva Pīṭhikā 7
te: శ్రుత్వా ధర్మా నశేషేణ పావనాని చ సర్వశః ।
iast: śrutvā dharmān aśeṣeṇa pāvanāni ca sarvaśaḥ |
verses.te_meaning: అన్ని ధర్మాలను, పవిత్రం చేసే బోధలను పూర్తిగా విన్న తర్వాత, యుధిష్ఠిరుడు శంతనుని కుమారుడైన భీష్ముని మళ్ళీ ఇలా అడిగాడు.
verses.en_meaning: Having heard all the dharmas and purifying teachings in full, Yudhiṣṭhira again addressed Bhīṣma, the son of Śantanu.
verses.words: śrutvā (having heard), dharmān aśeṣeṇa (all the dharmas completely), pāvanāni ca sarvaśaḥ (and all the purifying teachings), yudhiṣṭhiraḥ (Yudhiṣṭhira), śāntanavam (to the son of Śantanu, i.e. Bhīṣma), punar eva abhyabhāṣata (spoke once again).

verses.label: VS · Pūrva Pīṭhikā 8
deva: किमेकं दैवतं लोके किं वाप्येकं परायणम् ।
te: కిమేకం దైవతం లోకే కిం వాప్యేకం పరాయణమ్ ।
iast: kim ekaṃ daivataṃ loke kiṃ vāpy ekaṃ parāyaṇam |
stuvantaḥ kaṃ kam arcantaḥ prāpnuyur mānavāḥ śubham || 8 ||
verses.te_meaning: ఈ లోకంలో ఏకైక దేవుడు ఎవరు? అందరికీ పరమ ఆశ్రయం ఏది? ఎవరిని స్తుతించి, పూజిస్తే మనుషులు శుభాన్ని పొందుతారు?
verses.en_meaning: Who is the one God in the world? What is the one supreme refuge? By praising and worshipping whom may humans attain the highest good?
verses.words: kim ekam daivatam (what is the one deity), loke (in the world), kim vā api ekam parāyaṇam (or what is the one supreme refuge), stuvantaḥ kam (praising whom), kam arcantaḥ (worshipping whom), prāpnuyuḥ mānavāḥ śubham (do humans attain the auspicious good).

verses.label: VS · Pūrva Pīṭhikā 9
deva: को धर्मः सर्वधर्माणां भवतः परमो मतः ।
te: కో ధర్మః సర్వధర్మాణాం భవతః పరమో మతః ।
iast: ko dharmaḥ sarva-dharmāṇāṃ bhavataḥ paramo mataḥ |
verses.te_meaning: అన్ని ధర్మాలలో మీరు ఏ ధర్మాన్ని అత్యుత్తమమైనదిగా భావిస్తారు? దేనిని జపిస్తే జీవుడు జన్మ, సంసార బంధాల నుండి విముక్తుడవుతాడు?
verses.en_meaning: Which dharma do you hold as supreme among all dharmas? By chanting what is a being freed from the bondage of birth and saṃsāra?
verses.words: kaḥ dharmaḥ (what dharma), sarva-dharmāṇām (among all dharmas), bhavataḥ paramaḥ mataḥ (is in your opinion the highest), kim japan (by chanting what), mucyate jantuḥ (is a being freed), janma-saṃsāra-bandhanāt (from the bondage of birth and saṃsāra).

verses.label: VS · Pūrva Pīṭhikā 10
verses.te_meaning: జగత్తుకు ప్రభువు, దేవదేవుడు, అనంతుడు, పురుషోత్తముడు అయిన స్వామిని వెయ్యి నామాలతో ఎల్లప్పుడూ స్తుతించే మనిషి…
verses.en_meaning: The person who constantly praises with the thousand names the Lord of the universe — God of gods, the Infinite, the Supreme Person…
verses.words: jagat-prabhum (Lord of the universe), deva-devam (God of gods), anantam (the Infinite), puruṣottamam (Supreme Person), stuvan nāma-sahasreṇa (praising with the thousand names), puruṣaḥ satata-utthitaḥ (a person who is ever steadfast / ever engaged).

verses.label: VS · Pūrva Pīṭhikā 11
iast: tam eva cārcayan nityaṃ bhaktyā puruṣam avyayam |
dhyāyan stuvan namasyaṃś ca yajamānas tam eva ca || 11 ||
verses.te_meaning: …నాశనం లేని ఆ పురుషుణ్ణి భక్తితో ఎల్లప్పుడూ పూజిస్తూ — ఆయననే ధ్యానిస్తూ, స్తుతిస్తూ, నమస్కరిస్తూ, ఆయనకే అర్పిస్తూ ఉండేవాడు…
verses.en_meaning: …and who always worships that imperishable Person with devotion — meditating, praising, bowing, and offering sacrifice to Him alone.
verses.words: tam eva (Him alone), arcayan nityam (worshipping always), bhaktyā (with devotion), puruṣam avyayam (the imperishable Person), dhyāyan stuvan namasyan (meditating, praising, bowing), yajamānaḥ ca (and offering sacrifice).

verses.label: VS · Pūrva Pīṭhikā 12
verses.te_meaning: ఆది, అంతం లేనివాడు, అన్ని లోకాలకు మహేశ్వరుడు, అధ్యక్షుడు అయిన విష్ణువును ఎల్లప్పుడూ స్తుతించేవాడు అన్ని దుఃఖాలను దాటుతాడు.
verses.en_meaning: One who always praises Viṣṇu — without beginning or end, the great Lord and overseer of all worlds — goes beyond all sorrow.
verses.words: anādi-nidhanam (without beginning or end), viṣṇum (Viṣṇu), sarva-loka-mahā-īśvaram (great Lord of all worlds), loka-adhyakṣam (overseer of the worlds), stuvan nityam (praising always), sarva-duḥkha-atigaḥ bhavet (becomes one who transcends all sorrow).

verses.label: VS · Pūrva Pīṭhikā 13
te: బ్రహ్మణ్యం సర్వ ధర్మజ్ఞం లోకానాం కీర్తి వర్ధనమ్ ।
verses.te_meaning: (ఆయనను స్తుతించాలి —) వేదాలకు ఆప్తుడు, అన్ని ధర్మాలు తెలిసినవాడు, లోకాల కీర్తిని పెంచేవాడు, లోకనాథుడు, మహాభూతం, సకల జీవులు పుట్టిన మూలం.
verses.en_meaning: (Praise Him who is) the friend of Brahman, knower of all dharma, enhancer of the world’s glory, Lord of the worlds, the great Being, and the source from which all beings arise.
verses.words: brahmaṇyam (friend/protector of the Vedas and brahmanas), sarva-dharma-jñam (knower of all dharma), lokānām kīrti-vardhanam (who increases the glory of the worlds), loka-nātham (Lord of the worlds), mahat-bhūtam (the great Being), sarva-bhūta-bhava-udbhavam (source of the existence of all beings).

verses.label: VS · Pūrva Pīṭhikā 14
iast: yad bhaktyā puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ stavair arcet naraḥ sadā || 14 ||
verses.te_meaning: భక్తితో స్తోత్రాల ద్వారా కమలనేత్రుడైన స్వామిని ఎల్లప్పుడూ పూజించడమే — నా అభిప్రాయంలో అన్ని ధర్మాలలోకెల్లా గొప్ప ధర్మం.
verses.en_meaning: This, in my judgment, is the highest among all dharmas — that a person should always worship the lotus-eyed Lord with devotion through hymns of praise.
verses.words: eṣaḥ me (this, in my view), sarva-dharmāṇām dharmaḥ adhikatamaḥ (the highest among all dharmas), yat bhaktyā (namely that with devotion), puṇḍarīka-akṣam (the lotus-eyed Lord), stavaiḥ arcet naraḥ sadā (a person should always worship with hymns).

verses.label: VS · Pūrva Pīṭhikā 15
deva: परमं यो महत्तेजः परमं यो महत्तपः ।
परमं यो महद्ब्रह्म परमं यः परायणम् ॥ १५॥
te: పరమం యో మహత్తేజః పరమం యో మహత్తపః ।
పరమం యో మహద్బ్రహ్మ పరమం యః పరాయణమ్ ॥ 15 ॥
iast: paramaṃ yo mahat tejaḥ paramaṃ yo mahat tapaḥ |
paramaṃ yo mahad brahma paramaṃ yaḥ parāyaṇam || 15 ||
verses.te_meaning: ఆయనే పరమ మహా తేజస్సు, పరమ మహా తపస్సు, పరమ మహా బ్రహ్మం, పరమ ఆశ్రయం.
verses.en_meaning: He is the supreme great splendour, the supreme great austerity, the supreme great Brahman, and the supreme final refuge.
verses.words: paramam yaḥ mahat tejaḥ (He who is the supreme great splendour), paramam yaḥ mahat tapaḥ (the supreme great austerity), paramam yaḥ mahat brahma (the supreme great Brahman), paramam yaḥ parāyaṇam (the supreme final refuge).

verses.label: VS · Pūrva Pīṭhikā 16
deva: पवित्राणां पवित्रं यो मङ्गलानां च मङ्गलम् ।
दैवतं दैवतानां च भूतानां योऽव्ययः पिता ॥ १६॥
te: పవిత్రాణాం పవిత్రం యో మంగళానాం చ మంగళమ్ ।
iast: pavitrāṇāṃ pavitraṃ yo maṅgalānāṃ ca maṅgalam |
daivataṃ daivatānāṃ ca bhūtānāṃ yo 'vyayaḥ pitā || 16 ||
verses.te_meaning: పవిత్రమైనవాటిలో అత్యంత పవిత్రుడు, మంగళకరమైనవాటిలో అత్యంత మంగళకరుడు, దేవతలకు దేవుడు, సకల జీవులకు నాశనం లేని తండ్రి ఆయనే.
verses.en_meaning: He is the purest among the pure, the most auspicious among the auspicious, the God of gods, and the imperishable Father of all beings.
verses.words: pavitrāṇām pavitram (the purest among the pure), maṅgalānām maṅgalam (the most auspicious among the auspicious), daivatam daivatānām (the deity of deities), bhūtānām avyayaḥ pitā (the imperishable father of all beings).

verses.label: VS · Pūrva Pīṭhikā 17
iast: yasmiṃś ca pralayaṃ yānti punar eva yuga-kṣaye || 17 ||
verses.te_meaning: యుగం మొదట్లో సకల జీవులు ఆయన నుండే పుడతాయి; యుగం చివర మళ్ళీ ఆయనలోనే లీనమవుతాయి.
verses.en_meaning: From Him all beings arise at the beginning of a cosmic age, and into Him they dissolve again at the end of the age.
verses.words: yataḥ (from whom), sarvāṇi bhūtāni bhavanti (all beings arise), ādi-yuga-āgame (at the beginning of a yuga cycle), yasmin ca (and into whom), pralayam yānti (they go to dissolution), punaḥ eva yuga-kṣaye (again at the end of the yuga).

verses.label: VS · Pūrva Pīṭhikā 18
te: విష్ణోర్నామ సహస్రం మే శృణు పాప భయాపహమ్ ॥ 18 ॥
verses.te_meaning: రాజా, లోకాలలో ప్రధానుడు, జగన్నాథుడు అయిన విష్ణువు యొక్క — పాపాన్ని, భయాన్ని పోగొట్టే — వెయ్యి నామాలను నా నుండి విను.
verses.en_meaning: O king, hear from me the thousand names of that Lord of the universe — Viṣṇu, foremost of the worlds — which destroy sin and fear.
verses.words: tasya (of that), loka-pradhānasya (foremost of the worlds), jagat-nāthasya (Lord of the universe), bhūpate (O king), viṣṇoḥ nāma-sahasram (the thousand names of Viṣṇu), me śṛṇu (hear from me), pāpa-bhaya-apaham (which removes sin and fear).

verses.label: VS · Pūrva Pīṭhikā 19
verses.te_meaning: మహాత్ముడైన ఆయన గుణాలను తెలిపే, ఋషులు గానం చేసిన ప్రసిద్ధ నామాలను నీ మేలు కోసం చెబుతాను.
verses.en_meaning: I shall declare, for your welfare, those well-known attributive names of the Great Self that have been sung by the sages.
verses.words: yāni nāmāni (those names), gauṇāni (attributive / qualitative), vikhyātāni (well-known), mahātmanaḥ (of the Great Self), ṛṣibhiḥ parigītāni (sung by the sages), tāni vakṣyāmi (those I shall declare), bhūtaye (for well-being / welfare).

verses.label: VS · Pūrva Pīṭhikā 20
verses.te_meaning: ఈ వెయ్యి నామాలకు ఋషి మహాముని వేదవ్యాసుడు; ఛందస్సు అనుష్టుప్; దేవత దేవకీ కుమారుడైన భగవంతుడు (శ్రీకృష్ణుడు).
verses.en_meaning: The ṛṣi of these thousand names is the great sage Veda-Vyāsa; the metre is Anuṣṭubh; and the deity is the Blessed Lord, the son of Devakī (Kṛṣṇa).
verses.words: ṛṣiḥ (the seer), nāmnām sahasrasya (of the thousand names), veda-vyāsaḥ mahā-muniḥ (the great sage Veda-Vyāsa), chandaḥ anuṣṭup (the metre is Anuṣṭubh), tathā devaḥ (and the deity is), bhagavān devakī-sutaḥ (the Blessed Lord, son of Devakī).

verses.label: VS · Pūrva Pīṭhikā 21
verses.te_meaning: బీజం అమృతాంశూద్భవుడు; శక్తి దేవకీనందనుడు; హృదయం త్రిసామ — దీనిని శాంతి కోసం ఉపయోగిస్తారు.
verses.en_meaning: The bīja (seed) is Amṛtāṃśūdbhava; the śakti (power) is Devakīnandana; the heart is Trisāmā — and this is employed for the attainment of peace.
verses.words: amṛta-aṃśu-udbhavaḥ (He who arose as the nectar-ray / the Moon), bījam (is the seed), śaktiḥ devakī-nandanaḥ (the power is the delight of Devakī), trisāmā (the threefold Sāman), hṛdayam tasya (is His heart), śānti-arthe viniyojyate (it is employed for the sake of peace).

verses.label: VS · Pūrva Pīṭhikā 22
verses.te_meaning: విష్ణువు, జయశీలుడు, మహావిష్ణువు, సర్వశక్తిమంతుడైన ప్రభువు, అనేక రూపాలు ధరించేవాడు, రాక్షసులను అంతం చేసేవాడు అయిన పురుషోత్తమునికి నమస్కరిస్తున్నాను.
verses.en_meaning: I bow to the Supreme Person — Viṣṇu, the victorious, the great Viṣṇu, the all-powerful Lord, who assumes many forms and destroys the demons.
verses.words: viṣṇum (Viṣṇu), jiṣṇum (the victorious), mahā-viṣṇum (the great Viṣṇu), prabhaviṣṇum (the all-powerful), mahā-īśvaram (the great Lord), aneka-rūpa (of many forms), daitya-antam (destroyer of demons), namāmi (I bow), puruṣottamam (to the Supreme Person).

verses.label: VS · Pūrva Nyāsaḥ
deva: उद्भवः क्षोभणो देव इति परमो मन्त्रः ।
te: ఓం అస్య శ్రీ విష్ణోర్దివ్య సహస్రనామ స్తోత్ర మహామంత్రస్య ।
iast: udbhavaḥ kṣobhaṇo deva iti paramo mantraḥ |
verses.te_meaning: ఇది శ్రీ విష్ణు దివ్య సహస్రనామ స్తోత్ర మహామంత్రానికి ఋషి, ఛందస్సు, దేవత, బీజం, శక్తి, కీలకం, అస్త్రం, నేత్రం, కవచం, యోని, దిగ్బంధం, ధ్యానం, వినియోగం — వీటిని తెలుపుతుంది.
verses.en_meaning: This declares the ṛṣi, metre, deity, seed, power, pin, weapon, eye, armour, source, direction-binding, meditation, and application (viniyoga) of the Śrī Viṣṇu Divya Sahasranāma Stotra Mahā-mantra.
verses.words: asya … mahā-mantrasya (of this great mantra, the divine thousand-name hymn of Viṣṇu), ṛṣiḥ (seer) = Veda-Vyāsa, chandaḥ (metre) = Anuṣṭubh, devatā (deity) = Mahā-Viṣṇu / Nārāyaṇa, bījam (seed) = Amṛtāṃśūdbhava Bhānu, śaktiḥ (power) = Devakīnandana the Creator, paramo mantraḥ = Udbhavaḥ Kṣobhaṇaḥ Deva, kīlakam (pin) = Śaṅkhabhṛt Nandakī Cakrī, astram (missile) = Śārṅgadhanvā Gadādhara, netram (eye) = Rathāṅgapāṇi Akṣobhya, kavacam (armour) = Trisāmā Sāmagaḥ Sāma, yoniḥ (source) = Ānandaṃ Parabrahma, digbandhaḥ (direction-binding) = Ṛtuḥ Sudarśanaḥ Kāla, dhyānam = Śrī Viśvarūpa, viniyogaḥ (application) = for the pleasure of Mahā-Viṣṇu, in the recitation of the Sahasranāma.

verses.label: VS · Atha Nyāsaḥ
iast: guhye amṛtāṃśūdbhavo bhānur iti bījāya namaḥ |
verses.te_meaning: ఇప్పుడు ఋష్యాది న్యాసం: తల, నోరు, గుండె మొదలైన చోట్ల ఋషి, ఛందస్సు, దేవత, బీజం, శక్తి, కీలకాలను ఉంచి నమస్కరించడం — శ్రీకృష్ణుని ప్రీతి కోసం జపించాలనే సంకల్పంతో.
verses.en_meaning: Now the ṛṣyādi-nyāsa: salutations placed on head, mouth, heart, and so on, assigning ṛṣi, metre, deity, seed, power, and pin — with the resolve to chant for the pleasure of Śrī Kṛṣṇa.
verses.words: atha nyāsaḥ (now the placement), śirasi (on the head) — to the ṛṣi Veda-Vyāsa, mukhe (on the mouth) — to the Anuṣṭubh metre, hṛdi (on the heart) — to the deity Śrī Kṛṣṇa Paramātman, guhye (at the secret place) — to the bīja, pādayoḥ (at the feet) — to the śakti, sarvāṅge (on the whole body) — to the kīlaka, kara-sampūṭe (with palms joined) — viniyoga for japa pleasing to Śrī Kṛṣṇa.

verses.label: VS · Atha Kara-nyāsaḥ
iast: oṃ viśvaṃ viṣṇur vaṣaṭkāra ity aṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ |
verses.te_meaning: ఇప్పుడు కరన్యాసం: ప్రతి వేలిని, అరచేతులను స్వామి నామాల గుంపులతో పవిత్రం చేయడం.
verses.en_meaning: Now the hand-nyāsa: each finger and the palms are consecrated with groups of the Lord’s names.
verses.words: kara-nyāsaḥ (nyāsa of the hands): thumbs — Viśvam Viṣṇuḥ Vaṣaṭkāraḥ; index — Amṛtāṃśūdbhavaḥ Bhānuḥ; middle — Brahmaṇyaḥ Brahmakṛt Brahma; ring — Suvarṇabinduḥ Akṣobhyaḥ; little — Nimiṣaḥ Animiṣaḥ Sragvī; palms and backs — Rathāṅgapāṇiḥ Akṣobhyaḥ.

verses.label: VS · Atha Ṣaḍaṅga-nyāsaḥ
deva: ॐ विश्वं विष्णुर्वषट्कार इति ज्ञानाय हृदयाय नमः ।
ॐ अमृतांशूद्भवो भानुरिति ऐश्वर्याय शिरसे स्वाहा ।
ॐ ब्रह्मण्यो ब्रह्मकृद्ब्रह्मेति शक्त्यै शिखायै वषट् ।
ॐ सुवर्णबिन्दुरक्षोभ्य इति बलाय कवचाय हुम् ।
ॐ रथाङ्गपाणिरक्षोभ्य इति वीर्याय अस्त्राय फट् ।
ॐ सर्वप्रहरणायुध ॐ नम इति दिग्बन्धः ॥
te: ఓం విశ్వం విష్ణుర్-వషట్కార ఇతి జ్ఞానాయ హృదయాయ నమః ।
ఓం అమృతాంశూద్భవో భానురితి ఐశ్వర్యాయ శిరసే స్వాహా ।
ఓం బ్రహ్మణ్యో బ్రహ్మ-కృద్-బ్రహ్మేతి శక్త్యై శిఖాయై వషట్ ।
ఓం సువర్ణ-బిందురక్షోభ్య ఇతి బలాయ కవచాయ హుమ్ ।
ఓం రథాంగ-పాణిరక్షోభ్య ఇతి వీర్యాయ అస్త్రాయ ఫట్ ।
ఓం సర్వ-ప్రహరణాయుధ ఓం నమ ఇతి దిగ్-బంధః ॥
iast: oṃ viśvaṃ viṣṇur vaṣaṭkāra iti jñānāya hṛdayāya namaḥ |
oṃ amṛtāṃśūdbhavo bhānur iti aiśvaryāya śirase svāhā |
oṃ brahmaṇyo brahma-kṛd brahmeti śaktyai śikhāyai vaṣaṭ |
oṃ suvarṇa-bindur akṣobhya iti balāya kavacāya hum |
oṃ rathāṅga-pāṇir akṣobhya iti vīryāya astrāya phaṭ |
oṃ sarva-praharaṇāyudha oṃ nama iti dig-bandhaḥ ||
verses.te_meaning: ఇప్పుడు షడంగ న్యాసం: గుండె, తల, శిఖ, కవచం, కళ్ళు, అస్త్రం — వీటిని పవిత్రం చేసి, తర్వాత దిక్కులను బంధించడం.
verses.en_meaning: Now the six-limb nyāsa, consecrating heart, head, śikhā, armour, eyes, and weapon, followed by the binding of the directions.
verses.words: ṣaḍ-aṅga-nyāsaḥ (six-limb nyāsa): heart — knowledge (jñāna); head — sovereignty (aiśvarya); tuft — power (śakti); armour — strength (bala); three eyes; weapon — valour (vīrya); then dig-bandha with Sarvapraharaṇāyudha Om Nama iti.

verses.label: VS · Saṅkalpaḥ
verses.te_meaning: శ్రీకృష్ణుని ప్రీతి కోసం విష్ణువు యొక్క దివ్య సహస్రనామ జపం చేస్తానని సంకల్పిస్తున్నాను.
verses.en_meaning: I resolve to perform the japa of the divine thousand names of Viṣṇu for the pleasure of Śrī Kṛṣṇa.
verses.words: śrī-kṛṣṇa-prīty-arthe (for the pleasure of Śrī Kṛṣṇa), viṣṇoḥ divya-sahasra-nāma-japam (the japa of Viṣṇu’s divine thousand names), aham kariṣye (I shall perform).

verses.label: VS · Dhyānam 1
te: శుభ్రైరభ్రై రదభ్రై రుపరివిరచితైః ముక్త పీయూష వర్షైః
ఆనందీ నః పునీయాద్(త్) అరినలినగదా శంఖపాణిర్ ముకుందః ॥ 1 ॥
iast: kṣīrodanvat-pradeśe śuci-maṇi-vilasat-saikate mauktikānāṃ mālā-kḷptāsana-sthaḥ sphaṭika-maṇi-nibhair mauktikair maṇḍitāṅgaḥ |
śubhrair abhrair adabhrair upari-viracitair mukta-pīyūṣa-varṣair ānandī naḥ punīyād ari-nalina-gadā-śaṅkha-pāṇir mukundaḥ || 1 ||
verses.te_meaning: పాల సముద్రం దగ్గర ముత్యాల ఆసనం మీద కూర్చున్నవాడు, స్ఫటికం లాంటి ముత్యాలతో అలంకరించుకున్నవాడు, పైన తెల్లని మేఘాల నుండి మోక్షమనే అమృతాన్ని కురిపించేవాడు, చక్రం, పద్మం, గద, శంఖం ధరించినవాడు అయిన ముకుందుడు మమ్మల్ని పవిత్రం చేసి ఆనందాన్ని ఇవ్వాలి.
verses.en_meaning: May Mukunda — seated on a pearl-throne by the milk-ocean, adorned with crystal-like pearls, raining the nectar of liberation from white clouds above, holding discus, lotus, mace, and conch — purify us and grant bliss.
verses.words: kṣīra-udanvat-pradeśe (in the region of the milk-ocean), śuci-maṇi-vilasat-saikate (on the shore gleaming with pure gems), mauktikānām mālā-kḷpta-āsana-sthaḥ (seated on a throne formed of pearl-garlands), sphaṭika-maṇi-nibhaiḥ mauktikaiḥ maṇḍita-aṅgaḥ (limbs adorned with crystal-like pearls), śubhraiḥ abhraiḥ adabhraiḥ (with white, abundant clouds), upari-viracitaiḥ mukta-pīyūṣa-varṣaiḥ (raining nectar of liberation from above), ānandī (the blissful), naḥ punīyāt (may He purify us), ari-nalina-gadā-śaṅkha-pāṇiḥ (holding discus, lotus, mace, and conch), mukundaḥ (Mukunda, the giver of liberation).

verses.label: VS · Dhyānam 2
deva: भूः पादौ यस्य नाभिर्वियदसुरनिलश्चन्द्रसूर्यौ च नेत्रे कर्णावाशाः शिरो द्यौर्मुखमपि दहनो यस्य वास्तेयमब्धिः ।
अन्तःस्थं यस्य विश्वं सुरनरखगगोभोगिगन्धर्वदैत्यैश्चित्रं रंरम्यते तं त्रिभुवनवपुषं विष्णुमीशं नमामि ॥ २॥
te: భూః పాదౌ యస్య నాభిర్ వియదసురనిలశ్చంద్ర సూర్యౌ చ నేత్రే
కర్ణావాశాః శిరో ద్యౌః ముఖమపి దహనో యస్య వాస్తేయమబ్ధిః ।
అంతఃస్థం యస్య విశ్వం సుర నర ఖగ గో భోగి గంధర్వ దైత్యైః-
చిత్రం రంరమ్యతే తం త్రిభువన వపుషం విష్ణుమీశం నమామి ॥ 2 ॥
iast: bhūḥ pādau yasya nābhir viyad asur anilaś candra-sūryau ca netre karṇāv āśāḥ śiro dyaur mukham api dahano yasya vāste yam abdhiḥ |
antaḥ-sthaṃ yasya viśvaṃ sura-nara-khaga-go-bhogi-gandharva-daityaiś citraṃ raṃramyate taṃ tri-bhuvana-vapuṣaṃ viṣṇum īśaṃ namāmi || 2 ||
verses.te_meaning: భూమి పాదాలుగా, ఆకాశం నాభిగా, గాలి ఊపిరిగా, సూర్యచంద్రులు కళ్ళుగా, దిక్కులు చెవులుగా, స్వర్గం తలగా, అగ్ని ముఖంగా, సముద్రం నివాసంగా — మూడు లోకాలే శరీరంగా ఉన్నవాడు, దేవతలు, మనుషులు, సకల జీవులతో కూడిన విశ్వం మొత్తం ఆనందంగా ఎవరిలో ఉంటుందో ఆ విష్ణువుకు నమస్కరిస్తున్నాను.
verses.en_meaning: I bow to Lord Viṣṇu, whose body is the three worlds — feet the earth, navel the sky, breath the wind, eyes the sun and moon, ears the directions, head heaven, mouth fire, ocean His dwelling — within whom the whole universe of gods, humans, and all beings delightfully abides.
verses.words: bhūḥ pādau (whose feet are the earth), nābhiḥ viyat (whose navel is the sky), asuḥ anilaḥ (whose life-breath is the wind), candra-sūryau netre (whose eyes are moon and sun), karṇau āśāḥ (whose ears are the directions), śiraḥ dyauḥ (whose head is heaven), mukham dahanaḥ (whose mouth is fire), abdhiḥ vāsaḥ (whose abode is the ocean), antaḥ-stham viśvam (within whom the universe rests), tri-bhuvana-vapuṣam (whose body is the three worlds), viṣṇum īśam namāmi (I bow to Lord Viṣṇu).

verses.label: VS · Dhyānam 3
deva: शान्ताकारं भुजगशयनं पद्मनाभं सुरेशं विश्वाकारं गगनसदृशं मेघवर्णं शुभाङ्गम् ।
लक्ष्मीकान्तं कमलनयनं योगिहृद्ध्यानगम्यं वन्दे विष्णुं भवभयहरं सर्वलोकैकनाथम् ॥ ३॥
iast: śāntākāraṃ bhujaga-śayanaṃ padma-nābhaṃ sureśaṃ viśvākāraṃ gagana-sadṛśaṃ megha-varṇaṃ śubhāṅgam |
lakṣmī-kāntaṃ kamala-nayanaṃ yogi-hṛd-dhyāna-gamyaṃ vande viṣṇuṃ bhava-bhaya-haraṃ sarva-lokaika-nātham || 3 ||
verses.te_meaning: శాంతమైన రూపం గలవాడు, పాము మీద పడుకున్నవాడు, నాభిలో పద్మం ఉన్నవాడు, దేవతలకు ప్రభువు, విశ్వమే రూపంగా గలవాడు, ఆకాశంలా వ్యాపించినవాడు, మేఘం రంగు గలవాడు, శుభమైన అవయవాలు కలవాడు, లక్ష్మీ కాంతుడు, కమల నేత్రుడు, యోగులు హృదయంలో ధ్యానించి పొందేవాడు, సంసార భయాన్ని పోగొట్టేవాడు, అన్ని లోకాలకూ ఏకైక ప్రభువు అయిన విష్ణువుకు నమస్కరిస్తున్నాను.
verses.en_meaning: I bow to Viṣṇu — peaceful of form, reclining on the serpent, lotus-naveled, Lord of the gods, of universal form, sky-like, cloud-hued, auspicious of limb, beloved of Lakṣmī, lotus-eyed, attainable in yogis’ heart-meditation — who removes the fear of saṃsāra and is the sole Lord of all worlds.
verses.words: śānta-ākāram (of peaceful form), bhujaga-śayanam (reclining on the serpent), padma-nābham (lotus-naveled), sura-īśam (Lord of gods), viśva-ākāram (of universal form), gagana-sadṛśam (sky-like), megha-varṇam (cloud-hued), śubha-aṅgam (auspicious-limbed), lakṣmī-kāntam (beloved of Lakṣmī), kamala-nayanam (lotus-eyed), yogi-hṛd-dhyāna-gamyam (reachable in the meditation of yogis’ hearts), vande viṣṇum (I bow to Viṣṇu), bhava-bhaya-haram (remover of the fear of saṃsāra), sarva-loka-eka-nātham (sole Lord of all worlds).

verses.label: VS · Dhyānam 4
verses.te_meaning: మేఘం లాంటి నల్లని రంగు గలవాడు, పసుపు పట్టు వస్త్రం ధరించినవాడు, శ్రీవత్స చిహ్నం ఉన్నవాడు, కౌస్తుభ మణి కాంతితో మెరిసే శరీరం గలవాడు, పవిత్రుడు, విశాలమైన కమల నేత్రాలు గలవాడు, అన్ని లోకాలకూ ఏకైక ప్రభువు అయిన విష్ణువుకు నమస్కరిస్తున్నాను.
verses.en_meaning: I bow to Viṣṇu, sole Lord of all worlds — cloud-dark, clad in yellow silk, marked with Śrīvatsa, limbs lit by the Kaustubha, holy, and wide-lotus-eyed.
verses.words: megha-śyāmam (cloud-dark), pīta-kauśeya-vāsam (clad in yellow silk), śrīvatsa-aṅkam (marked with Śrīvatsa), kaustubha-udbhāsita-aṅgam (limbs shining with Kaustubha), puṇya-upetam (holy), puṇḍarīka-āyata-akṣam (wide lotus-eyed), vande viṣṇum (I bow to Viṣṇu), sarva-loka-eka-nātham (sole Lord of all worlds).

verses.label: VS · Dhyānam 5
te: నమః సమస్త భూతానామ్ ఆది భూతాయ భూభృతే ।
verses.te_meaning: సకల జీవులలో మొట్టమొదటి వాడు, భూమిని ధరించేవాడు, లెక్కలేనన్ని రూపాలు ధరించే సర్వశక్తిమంతుడైన విష్ణువుకు నమస్కారం.
verses.en_meaning: Salutations to Viṣṇu, the all-powerful — the primordial Being among all beings, supporter of the earth, who assumes countless forms.
verses.words: namaḥ (salutations), samasta-bhūtānām ādi-bhūtāya (to the first among all beings), bhū-bhṛte (to the supporter of the earth), aneka-rūpa-rūpāya (of many forms), viṣṇave prabhaviṣṇave (to the all-powerful Viṣṇu).

verses.label: VS · Dhyānam 6
verses.te_meaning: శంఖం, చక్రం ధరించినవాడు, కిరీటం, కుండలాలు ధరించినవాడు, పసుపు వస్త్రం కట్టుకున్నవాడు, కమల నేత్రుడు, హారంతో, కౌస్తుభ మణితో మెరిసే వక్షస్థలం గలవాడు, నాలుగు చేతుల విష్ణువుకు తల వంచి నమస్కరిస్తున్నాను.
verses.en_meaning: With bowed head I salute four-armed Viṣṇu — holding conch and discus, wearing crown and earrings, clad in yellow, lotus-eyed, His chest shining with garland and the Kaustubha gem.
verses.words: sa-śaṅkha-cakram (with conch and discus), sa-kirīṭa-kuṇḍalam (with crown and earrings), sa-pīta-vastram (in yellow garments), sarasīruha-īkṣaṇam (lotus-eyed), sa-hāra-vakṣaḥ-sthala-śobhi-kaustubham (chest adorned with necklace and Kaustubha), namāmi śirasā (I bow with my head), viṣṇum catur-bhujam (to four-armed Viṣṇu).

verses.label: VS · Dhyānam 7
deva: चन्द्राननं चतुर्बाहुं श्रीवत्साङ्कितवक्षसं रुक्मिणीसत्यभामाभ्यां सहितं कृष्णमाश्रये ॥ ७॥
iast: chāyāyāṃ pārijātasya hema-siṃhāsanopari āsīnam ambuda-śyāmam āyatākṣam alaṅkṛtam |
candrānanaṃ catur-bāhuṃ śrīvatsāṅkita-vakṣasaṃ rukmiṇī-satyabhāmābhyāṃ sahitaṃ kṛṣṇam āśraye || 7 ||
verses.te_meaning: పారిజాత వృక్షం నీడలో బంగారు ఆసనం మీద కూర్చున్నవాడు, మేఘం లాంటి నల్లనివాడు, విశాల నేత్రుడు, అలంకరించుకున్నవాడు, చంద్రుని లాంటి ముఖం గలవాడు, నాలుగు చేతులవాడు, వక్షంపై శ్రీవత్స చిహ్నం ఉన్నవాడు, రుక్మిణి, సత్యభామలతో కూడిన శ్రీకృష్ణుని ఆశ్రయిస్తున్నాను.
verses.en_meaning: I take refuge in Kṛṣṇa — seated on a golden throne in the shade of the pārijāta, cloud-dark, wide-eyed, adorned, moon-faced, four-armed, chest marked with Śrīvatsa, together with Rukmiṇī and Satyabhāmā.
verses.words: chāyāyām pārijātasya (in the shade of the pārijāta), hema-siṃhāsana-upari āsīnam (seated on a golden throne), ambuda-śyāmam (cloud-dark), āyata-akṣam (wide-eyed), alaṅkṛtam (adorned), candra-ānanam (moon-faced), catur-bāhum (four-armed), śrīvatsa-aṅkita-vakṣasam (chest marked with Śrīvatsa), rukmiṇī-satyabhāmābhyām sahitam (together with Rukmiṇī and Satyabhāmā), kṛṣṇam āśraye (I take refuge in Kṛṣṇa).

verses.label: VS · Shloka 1
verses.te_meaning: విశ్వమే తానైనవాడు; అంతటా వ్యాపించినవాడు; యజ్ఞాలు ఎవరి కోసం చేస్తారో ఆయన; భూత, భవిష్యత్, వర్తమానాలకు ప్రభువు; అందరినీ సృష్టించి, పోషించి, అందరిలో తానే ఉన్నవాడు; సకల జీవులకు ఆత్మ, వారిని పెంచి పోషించేవాడు.
verses.en_meaning: The Universe; the all-pervader; He for whom sacrifice is offered; Lord of past, present and future; creator, sustainer and very being of all; the Self and nourisher of all beings.
verses.words: Viśvaṁ (He who is full of all infinite auspicious attributes (Guna-paripurna) without any defect (Nirdosha).); Viṣṇuḥ (All-pervading in space, time, and divine virtues (Vepana/Vyapti), possessing unlimited omnipotent energy.); Vaṣaṭkāraḥ (He who brings the entire universe under His supreme independent control (Vasham karoti).); Bhūta-bhavya-bhavat-prabhuḥ (The eternal Sovereign Lord and Master of all beings and time across the past, present, and future.); Bhūtakṛd (The sole Creator of all entities and beings according to their intrinsic nature (svabhava) and karma.); Bhūtabhṛd (The supreme Sustainer, Nourisher, and Protector of all beings throughout the cosmos (Bharana-karta).); Bhāvaḥ (The eternal, self-existent Reality (Sad-rupa) who exists unconditionally across all cosmic cycles.); Bhūtātmā (The Supreme Inner Controller (Antaryami) residing in all living souls, ever distinct from the individual jiva.); Bhūta-bhāvanaḥ (He who causes the spiritual growth, prosperity, and ultimate upliftment of all devoted souls.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 2
deva: पूतात्मा परमात्मा च मुक्तानां परमा गतिः।
अव्ययः पुरुषः साक्षी क्षेत्रज्ञोऽक्षर एव च॥
te: పూతాత్మా పరమాత్మా చ ముక్తానాం పరమా గతిః ।
అవ్యయః పురుషః సాక్షీ క్షేత్రజ్ఞోఽక్షర ఏవ చ ॥
iast: pūtātmā paramātmā ca muktānāṃ paramā gatiḥ |
avyayaḥ puruṣaḥ sākṣī kṣetrajño ’kṣara eva ca.
verses.te_meaning: పరిశుద్ధమైన ఆత్మ; పరమాత్మ; ముక్తులకు చివరి గమ్యం; నాశనం లేనివాడు; పురుషుడు; సాక్షి; క్షేత్రాన్ని (శరీరాన్ని) తెలిసినవాడు; క్షయం లేనివాడు.
verses.en_meaning: The pure Self; the Supreme Self; highest goal of the liberated; the imperishable; the Purusha; the witness; knower of the field; and the indestructible.
verses.words: Pūtātmā (The eternally pure Supreme Being, untouched by any defect, ignorance, or sorrow (Nirdosha).); Paramātmā (The Supreme Lord, eternally superior to and distinct from both perishable matter (Kshara) and imperishable souls/Lakshmi (Akshara).); Muktānāṁ paramā gatiḥ (The supreme destination, refuge, and eternal abode of bliss for all liberated souls (Muktas).); Avyayaḥ (He who is without any decay, destruction, diminution, or change in His form, knowledge, and bliss.); Puruṣaḥ (He who is full of all perfection and divine virtues (Purna-gunatva).); Sākṣī (The direct, omniscient witness who directly perceives all actions, thoughts, and cosmic events through His own consciousness.); Kṣetrajñaḥ (The supreme knower of all physical bodies, the material universe (Kshetra), and individual souls.); Akṣara (The imperishable One who is completely free from destruction, loss, or deterioration.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 3
verses.te_meaning: యోగం ద్వారా పొందదగినవాడు; యోగులకు నాయకుడు; ప్రకృతికి, పురుషునికి ప్రభువు; నరసింహ రూపం ధరించినవాడు; శ్రీమంతుడు; కేశవుడు; పురుషోత్తముడు.
verses.en_meaning: Attainable through yoga; leader of yogis; Lord of Prakriti and Purusha; of the man-lion form; the glorious Keshava; the Supreme Person.
verses.words: Yogaḥ (The supreme means of attainment (Sadhana) reached through devoted meditation, knowledge, and righteous action.); Yogavidāṁ netā (The divine leader and guide who directs all sincere practitioners of yoga and devotion to eternal liberation.); Pradhāna-puruṣeśvaraḥ (The supreme Sovereign Lord over both insentient Primordial Nature (Pradhana/Prakriti) and all sentient souls (Purusha/Jivas).); Nārasiṁha-vapuḥ (He who assumed the divine, transcendental Man-Lion form to protect His devotee Prahlada and destroy evil.); Śrīmān (The eternal consort of Goddess Lakshmi (Sri Devi), endowed with all divine majesty, fortune, and beauty.); Keśavaḥ (The supreme Master who commands Brahma (Ka) and Shiva/Vayu (Isha) (Ka + Isha + Va).); Puruṣottamaḥ (The Supreme Person, supreme above both perishable matter (Kshara) and imperishable souls/Lakshmi (Akshara).)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 4
te: సర్వః శర్వః శివః స్థాణుర్ భూతాదిర్ నిధిరవ్యయః ।
iast: sarvaḥ śarvaḥ śivaḥ sthāṇur bhūtādir nidhir avyayaḥ |
saṃbhavo bhāvano bhartā prabhavaḥ prabhur īśvaraḥ.
verses.te_meaning: సర్వమూ తానే; సంహరించేవాడు; శుభుడు; కదలనివాడు; జీవులకు మూలం; నాశనం లేని నిధి; తనంతట తానే పుట్టినవాడు; పోషించేవాడు; ధరించేవాడు; అందరికీ మూలం, ప్రభువు, పాలకుడు.
verses.en_meaning: The all; the destroyer; the auspicious; the immovable; source of beings; imperishable treasure; self-born; nourisher; supporter; origin, Lord and ruler of all.
verses.words: Sarvaḥ (He who possesses all knowledge and is the ultimate destination of all movement (Sr-gatau).); Śarvaḥ (He who destroys and dissolves the universe at Pralaya and eliminates the sins and sorrows of devotees.); Śivaḥ (The embodiment of supreme auspiciousness, flawless purity, and eternal bliss (Sham karoti).); Sthāṇuḥ (The eternally steadfast, firm, and unshakable Supreme Reality.); Bhūtādiḥ (The primal cause and original creator from whom all elements and beings originate.); Nidhir-avyayaḥ (The inexhaustible cosmic treasure in whom all worlds and souls rest securely during dissolution.); Sambhavaḥ (He who manifests divine incarnations (Avataras) by His independent supreme will for the protection of Dharma.); Bhāvanaḥ (He who dispenses the fruits of all actions and grants spiritual fulfillment to all devotees.); Bhartā (The supreme Sustainer, Master, and Ruler who supports the entire cosmos.); Prabhavaḥ (The exalted source and cause of the manifestation and glory of all created entities.); Prabhuḥ (The all-powerful Sovereign Lord who possesses unlimited capacity for cosmic creation, sustenance, and control.); Īśvaraḥ (The absolute, independent Ruler who exercises limitless control over all entities without any dependence.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 5
verses.te_meaning: స్వయంభువు; ఆనందాన్ని ఇచ్చేవాడు; సూర్యుడు; కమల నేత్రుడు; గొప్ప నాదం (వేదం) గలవాడు; ఆది, అంతం లేనివాడు; ధరించేవాడు, విధిని నిర్ణయించేవాడు, ఉత్తమమైన ఆధారం.
verses.en_meaning: Self-existent; giver of joy; the sun; lotus-eyed; of majestic sound (the Veda); without beginning or end; the upholder, ordainer and supreme support.
verses.words: Svayambhūḥ (The self-existent, uncreated Lord who exists eternally without being caused by any external agency.); Śaṁbhuḥ (The author and bestower of supreme spiritual happiness, peace, and auspicious bliss (Sham).); Ādityaḥ (The supreme Luminary who shines as the Inner Controller within the Sun, illuminating the cosmos.); Puṣkarākṣaḥ (He whose eyes are beautiful like lotus petals, radiating divine grace upon sincere seekers.); Mahāsvanaḥ (The supreme Author of the profound cosmic sound of the sacred Vedas proclaiming divine truth.); Anādi-nidhanaḥ (He who is without beginning and without end; eternal, uncreated, and immortal.); Dhātā (The universal Creator who forms, arranges, and establishes the universe and its diverse beings.); Vidhātā (The supreme dispenser of the fruits of all actions according to the cosmic law of karma.); Dhāturuttamaḥ (The greatest among all creators, superior to Brahma (the secondary creator) and all cosmic deities.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 6
te: విశ్వకర్మా మనుస్ త్వష్టా స్థవిష్ఠః స్థవిరో ధ్రువః ॥
iast: viśvakarmā manus tvaṣṭā sthaviṣṭhaḥ sthaviro dhruvaḥ.
verses.te_meaning: కొలవలేనివాడు; ఇంద్రియాలకు ప్రభువు; నాభిలో పద్మం ఉన్నవాడు; దేవతలకు ప్రభువు; విశ్వాన్ని నిర్మించేవాడు; ఆలోచించేవాడు; రూపాలను తీర్చిదిద్దేవాడు; అతి విశాలుడు; అతి ప్రాచీనుడు; స్థిరుడు, శాశ్వతుడు.
verses.en_meaning: Immeasurable; Lord of the senses; lotus-naveled; Lord of the immortals; architect of the universe; the thinker; the shaper; the vast; the ancient; the fixed and eternal.
verses.words: Aprameyaḥ (He who cannot be fully measured or delimited by human logic, empirical senses, or worldly standards.); Hṛṣīkeśaḥ (The supreme Lord and Inner Controller of all sensory organs (Hrishika) in all living beings.); Padmanābhaḥ (From whose navel sprouts the cosmic lotus that is the origin of Brahma and the entire universe.); Amara-prabhuḥ (The supreme Sovereign Lord and Protector of all the immortal gods (Devas).); Viśvakarmā (The divine cosmic Architect whose actions encompass the creation and fashioning of the entire universe.); Manuḥ (The omniscient Thinker whose supreme intellect perceives, designs, and governs everything.); Tvaṣṭā (He who shapes and pares down the universe during cosmic dissolution (Pralaya).); Sthaviṣṭaḥ (The immensely vast One who is greatest in dimensions, pervading the cosmic form (Virat-rupa).); Sthaviraḥ-dhruvaḥ (The ancient, timeless Lord who remains eternally steadfast, firm, and unaltering.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 7
verses.te_meaning: ఇంద్రియాలకు అందనివాడు; శాశ్వతుడు; నల్లని రంగు గలవాడు (సచ్చిదానందుడు); ఎర్రని కళ్ళు గలవాడు; ప్రళయంలో సంహరించేవాడు; ఎల్లప్పుడూ పూర్ణుడు; మూడు లోకాలకు ఆధారం; పవిత్రం చేసేవాడు; పరమ మంగళుడు.
verses.en_meaning: Ungraspable by the senses; eternal; the dark-hued (existence-knowledge-bliss); red-eyed; destroyer at dissolution; ever-full; support of the three worlds; the purifier; the supremely auspicious.
verses.words: Agrāhyaḥ (He who cannot be grasped or comprehended by mere physical senses or speculative intellect.); Śāśvataḥ (He who exists continuously in all periods of time without interruption or destruction.); Kṛṣṇaḥ (The embodiment of supreme infinite bliss (Krishi = existence/bliss, Na = peace).); Lohitākṣaḥ (He who possesses captivating, lotus-red eyes brimming with divine majesty and affection.); Pratardanaḥ (He who causes the complete dissolution of the cosmos at the end of the cosmic cycle.); Prabhūtaḥ (He who is abundantly endowed with supreme knowledge, sovereignty, bliss, and wealth.); Tri-kakub-dhāma (He who is the foundation and ruler of the three cosmic realms (upper, middle, and nether worlds).); Pavitraṁ (The supreme Purifier, remembering whom cleanses the heart of all sins and material impurities.); Maṅgalaṁ param (The supreme embodiment of auspiciousness, conferring the highest eternal good (Moksha).)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 8
deva: ईशानः प्राणदः प्राणो ज्येष्ठः श्रेष्ठः प्रजापतिः।
te: ఈశానః ప్రాణదః ప్రాణో జ్యేష్ఠః శ్రేష్ఠః ప్రజాపతిః ।
iast: īśānaḥ prāṇadaḥ prāṇo jyeṣṭhaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ prajāpatiḥ |
verses.te_meaning: అందరినీ నియంత్రించేవాడు; ప్రాణాన్ని ఇచ్చేవాడు; ప్రాణమే తానైనవాడు; అందరికంటే పెద్దవాడు; అత్యంత స్తుతించదగినవాడు; ప్రజలకు ప్రభువు; హిరణ్యగర్భుడు; భూమిని ధరించినవాడు; లక్ష్మీపతి (మాధవుడు); మధు రాక్షసుని సంహరించినవాడు.
verses.en_meaning: The controller; giver of life; the life-breath; the eldest; the most praiseworthy; Lord of creatures; the golden-wombed; holder of the earth; consort of Lakshmi; slayer of the demon Madhu.
verses.words: Īśānaḥ (The supreme Controller and Governor who appoints all cosmic deities to their respective duties.); Prāṇadaḥ (The giver of life, vital energy (Prana), strength, and spiritual vitality to all creatures.); Prāṇaḥ (The ultimate Life-Force and Inner Sustainer who animates all living entities (Mukhyaprana-antaryami).); Jyeṣṭhaḥ (The eldest and foremost of all, preceding everything in existence and glory.); Śreṣṭhaḥ (The most excellent and supreme in all auspicious virtues and perfections.); Prajāpatiḥ (The supreme Lord and protector of all created beings and cosmic progenitors.); Hiraṇyagarbhaḥ (He who contains the golden cosmic egg within Himself and guides the creator Brahma as Antaryami.); Bhūgarbhaḥ (He who holds and shelters the entire Earth within His divine belly as its protector.); Mādhavaḥ (The Lord and divine consort of Goddess Lakshmi (Ma-dhava).); Madhusūdanaḥ (The heroic slayer of the demon Madhu, destroying the ignorance and darkness of His devotees.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 9
deva: ईश्वरो विक्रमी धन्वी मेधावी विक्रमः क्रमः।
te: ఈశ్వరో విక్రమీ ధన్వీ మేధావీ విక్రమః క్రమః ।
iast: īśvaro vikramī dhanvī medhāvī vikramaḥ kramaḥ |
verses.te_meaning: సర్వశక్తిమంతుడు; పరాక్రమశాలి; విల్లు ధరించినవాడు; గొప్ప బుద్ధిమంతుడు; అడుగులు వేసి లోకాలను కొలిచినవాడు; అంతటా వ్యాపించినవాడు; సాటిలేనివాడు; ఎవరూ ఎదిరించలేనివాడు; చేసినదంతా తెలిసినవాడు; కర్మయే తానైనవాడు; ఆత్మవంతుడు.
verses.en_meaning: The omnipotent; the valiant; the wielder of the bow; supremely intelligent; the strider; all-pervading; unsurpassed; unassailable; knower of all deeds; the very act; and self-possessed.
verses.words: Īśvaraḥ (The omnipotent Lord who possesses unlimited, unassisted power over everything.); Vikramī (He who is endowed with supreme valor and strides majestically across all worlds.); Dhanvī (The supreme divine Archer who wields the invincible bow Sharnga to uphold Dharma.); Medhāvī (Endowed with supreme, flawless memory and all-comprehending divine intelligence.); Vikramaḥ (He who traversed the three worlds in the Vamana Avatara and rides upon the great bird Garuda.); Kramaḥ (He whose continuous, orderly power pervades every part of the cosmos.); Anuttamaḥ (The peerless Supreme Lord, above whom there is no higher or equal being.); Durādharṣaḥ (He who cannot be overcome, intimidated, or resisted by any demonic forces.); Kṛtajñaḥ (He who appreciates even the smallest loving offering (a leaf, flower, fruit, or water) with immense grace.); Kṛtiḥ (The embodiment of all sacred action and the motivator of all virtuous deeds.); Ātmavān (The self-sufficient Lord who is established purely in His own inherent glory and independent might.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 10
verses.te_meaning: దేవతలకు ప్రభువు; ఆశ్రయం; పరమానందం; విశ్వానికి బీజం; జీవులకు మూలం; పగలు; సంవత్సరం (కాలం); పాములా పట్టుకోలేనివాడు; జ్ఞానమే తానైనవాడు; అన్నీ చూసేవాడు.
verses.en_meaning: Lord of the gods; the refuge; supreme bliss; seed of the universe; source of beings; the day; the year (time); ungraspable as a serpent; the very knowledge; and the all-seeing.
verses.words: Sureśaḥ (The supreme Lord and sovereign Ruler of all the Devas and celestials.); Śaraṇaṁ (The supreme refuge and protector who removes all distress and danger from those who seek shelter in Him.); Śarma (The embodiment of supreme, unalloyed bliss and eternal peace.); Viśvaretāḥ (The primary seed and creative source from which the entire universe is generated.); Prajābhavaḥ (He from whom all living beings derive their existence, sustenance, and growth.); Ahaḥ (Luminous like the bright day, illuminating the minds of devotees with the light of wisdom.); Saṁvatsaraḥ (The Lord of Time who embodies the cycle of years, governing all cosmic durations.); Vyālaḥ (He who is elusive and ungraspable to the non-devoted, like a fierce serpent.); Pratyayaḥ (The embodiment of true conviction, faith, and realization of the ultimate truth.); Sarva-darśanaḥ (The omniscient Lord who sees and knows all things in their true essence at all times.); Ajah (The unborn and eternal Lord who has no material birth, yet appears as Avataras by His divine will.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 11
iast: ajaḥ sarveśvaraḥ siddhaḥ siddhiḥ sarvādir acyutaḥ |
verses.te_meaning: పుట్టుక లేనివాడు; అందరికీ ప్రభువు; ఎప్పుడూ సిద్ధుడు; సిద్ధియే తానైనవాడు; అన్నిటికీ మొదటి కారణం; జారిపోనివాడు (అచ్యుతుడు); ధర్మాన్ని ఉద్ధరించిన వరాహుడు; అపారమైన స్వభావం గలవాడు; అన్ని బంధాలకు అతీతుడు.
verses.en_meaning: The unborn; Lord of all; the ever-accomplished; the very fulfilment; first cause of all; the unfallen; the dharma-raising boar; of immeasurable nature; free from all bondage.
verses.words: Sarveśvaraḥ (The supreme Master and controller of all lords, gods, and cosmic forces.); Siddhaḥ (The eternally accomplished One whose divine nature, knowledge, and bliss are ever-perfect.); Siddhiḥ (The embodiment of supreme spiritual perfection and the granter of all genuine spiritual attainments.); Sarvādiḥ (The original cause and source preceding all created things.); Acyutaḥ (He who never loses His supreme nature, virtues, or status, and never lets His devotees fall from grace.); Vṛṣākapiḥ (The supreme Lord who showers (Vrish) the waters of Dharma and bliss, incarnating as the holy Boar (Varaha).); Ameyātmā (He whose boundless essence, thoughts, and capabilities are infinitely beyond measurement.); Sarvayoga-viniḥsṛtaḥ (Free from all material bondage, yet fully attainable through genuine spiritual devotion and yoga.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 12
verses.te_meaning: అందరికీ నివాసం; పరిశుద్ధమైన మనసు గలవాడు; సత్యం; సమభావం గలవాడు; కొలవలేనివాడు; అందరికీ సమానుడు; వ్యర్థం కానివాడు; కమల నేత్రుడు; ప్రతి పనీ ధర్మమైనవాడు; ధర్మమే రూపంగా గలవాడు.
verses.en_meaning: The abode of all; pure-minded; the truth; even-souled; immeasurable; equal to all; unfailing; lotus-eyed; whose every act is righteous; of the very form of dharma.
verses.words: Vasuḥ (He who resides within all cosmic entities as their Inner Sustainer and is the supreme spiritual wealth.); Vasumanāḥ (Possessing a supremely pure, benevolent, and auspicious mind that is free from any attachment or malice.); Satyaḥ (The ultimate Reality who is true in His essence, speech, promises, and protection of devotees.); Samātmā (He whose transcendental nature is free from prejudice, treating all souls justly according to their intrinsic nature.); Sammitaḥ (He who is boundless and cannot be limited or circumscribed by time, space, or entity.); Samaḥ (Ever equitable, free from all partiality, and possessing perfect balance in all divine virtues.); Amoghaḥ (He whose worship, grace, and divine will never go in vain and always bear true spiritual fruit.); Puṇḍarīkākṣaḥ (The lotus-eyed Lord residing in the lotus of the heart (Pundarika) who is beheld by contemplative sages.); Vṛṣakarmā (He whose every cosmic deed is the pure embodiment of Dharma and righteousness.); Vṛṣākṛtiḥ (He whose transcendental divine form is the personification of sacred Dharma.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 13
verses.te_meaning: రుద్రుడు (ప్రళయంలో జీవులను ఏడిపించేవాడు); అనేక తలలు గలవాడు; భారాన్ని మోసేవాడు; విశ్వానికి గర్భం; పవిత్రమైన కీర్తి గలవాడు; అమృతుడు; శాశ్వతంగా స్థిరమైనవాడు; ఉత్తమమైన ఆశ్రయం; గొప్ప తపస్సు గలవాడు.
verses.en_meaning: The Rudra (who makes beings weep at dissolution); many-headed; the bearer; womb of the universe; of holy fame; the immortal; the eternal-fixed; the sublime resort; of great penance.
verses.words: Rudraḥ (The destroyer of sorrow (Rujam dravayati) who drives away the afflictions and spiritual ignorance of devotees.); Bahuśirāḥ (He who has countless heads in His cosmic form (Visvarupa), aware of everything everywhere.); Babhruḥ (The supreme supporter and sustainer who upholds the entire planetary system.); Viśvayoniḥ (The ultimate cosmic womb and origin from which all worlds and elements are brought forth.); Śuciśravāḥ (He who listens to the pure prayers of His devotees and whose holy fame purifies the listener.); Amṛtaḥ (The immortal, nectar-like Lord who is eternal and bestows liberation upon the faithful.); Śāśvata-sthāṇuḥ (Eternally steadfast, unshakable, and permanently established in His supreme sovereignty.); Varārohaḥ (The supreme destination; attaining His divine realm guarantees no return to the cycle of rebirth.); Mahātapāḥ (Endowed with immense creative energy, radiant tapas (splendor), and supreme spiritual potency.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 14
iast: vedo vedavid avyaṅgo vedāṅgo vedavit kaviḥ.
verses.te_meaning: అంతటా వెళ్ళేవాడు; అన్నీ తెలిసినవాడు; ప్రకాశించేవాడు; ఎవరూ ఎదురు నిలవలేని సైన్యం గలవాడు; దుష్టులను బాధించేవాడు; వేదమే తానైనవాడు; వేదం తెలిసినవాడు; లోపం లేనివాడు; వేదాలే అవయవాలుగా గలవాడు; దార్శనికుడు.
verses.en_meaning: All-pervading; all-knowing; the effulgent; before whose army none can stand; who afflicts the wicked; the Veda itself; knower of the Veda; flawless; whose limbs are the Vedas; the seer.
verses.words: Sarvagaḥ (All-pervading One who reaches and dwells in every particle of the universe.); Sarvavid-bhānuḥ (The all-knowing Sun of wisdom who illumines all minds and dispels darkness.); Viṣvaksenaḥ (He before whose advancing divine host all negative forces, demons, and sins flee in all directions.); Janārdanaḥ (He who torments and vanquishes the wicked while answering the heartfelt prayers (Jana-ardanat) of devotees.); Vedaḥ (The supreme embodiment of true wisdom and the primary subject declared by all Vedic scriptures.); Vedavid (The true and perfect knower of the complete, profound meaning of the Vedas.); Avyaṅgaḥ (Flawlessly complete, without any deficiency in knowledge, limbs, or divine attributes.); Vedāṅgaḥ (He whose divine nature and ordinances are revealed through the auxiliary sciences of the Vedas.); Vedavit (He who reveals, interprets, and establishes the authentic import of the sacred Vedic texts.); Kaviḥ (The omniscient Seer who visualizes the past, present, and future with poetic divine vision.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 15
verses.te_meaning: లోకాలను పర్యవేక్షించేవాడు; దేవతలను, ధర్మాన్ని పర్యవేక్షించేవాడు; కార్యం, కారణం రెండూ తానే; నాలుగు ఆత్మలు గలవాడు; నాలుగు వ్యూహాలు గలవాడు; నాలుగు కోరలు గలవాడు (నరసింహుడు); నాలుగు చేతులవాడు.
verses.en_meaning: Overseer of the worlds; of the gods; of dharma; both the effect and its cause; of four aspects; four manifestations (vyuhas); four-tusked (as Narasimha); and four-armed.
verses.words: Lokādhyakṣaḥ (The supreme presiding Guardian and Overlord who directly oversees all cosmic realms.); Surādhyakṣaḥ (The divine Master and Commander who presides over all celestials and Devas.); Dharmādhyakṣaḥ (The supreme Inspector and Preserver of Dharma who judges the merits and demerits of all beings.); Kṛtākṛtaḥ (The Master of both the manifested universe (Krita/Karya) and the unmanifest cause (Akrita/Karana).); Caturātmā (The supreme Lord manifesting as the four transcendental forms: Vasudeva, Sankarshana, Pradyumna, and Aniruddha.); Chaturvyūhaḥ (He who manifests in the four divine cosmic emanations for creation, sustenance, dissolution, and grace.); Chatur-daṁṣṭraḥ (Endowed with four sharp divine incisors in His glorious Narasimha and Varaha manifestations.); Chatur-bhujaḥ (Possessing four graceful transcendental arms holding the Shankha, Chakra, Gada, and Padma.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 16
verses.te_meaning: ఎప్పుడూ ప్రకాశించేవాడు; అనుభవించబడేది (ప్రకృతి); అనుభవించేవాడు; సహనశీలి; లోకంలో మొదట పుట్టినవాడు; పాపం లేనివాడు; విజయుడు; జయించేవాడు; విశ్వానికి మూలం; మళ్ళీ మళ్ళీ శరీరాలలో నివసించేవాడు.
verses.en_meaning: Ever-luminous; the enjoyed (Prakriti); the enjoyer; the forbearing; first-born of the world; the sinless; the victorious; the conqueror; womb of the universe; who dwells again and again in bodies.
verses.words: Bhrājiṣṇuḥ (The self-luminous Lord whose transcendental effulgence illuminates the entire creation.); Bhojanam (The supreme object of spiritual enjoyment and nourishment for the liberated souls.); Bhoktā (The supreme enjoyer of all sacrificial offerings and the experiencer within the heart.); Sahiṣṇuḥ (He who is immensely forgiving of the errors of His devotees and overcomes all demonic obstacles.); Jagadādhijaḥ (Existing prior to the creation of the universe as its primordial source and progenitor.); Anaghaḥ (The immaculate, stainless Lord who is free from every trace of sin, blemish, or sorrow.); Vijayaḥ (The eternal Victor who triumphs over all adversities and bestows victory on righteousness.); Jetā (The natural conqueror who is ever victorious over all opposing forces.); Viśvayoniḥ (The primeval cause and shelter in whom the entire cosmos is generated and sustained.); Punarvasuḥ (He who repeatedly dwells as Antaryami in newly created bodies and brings souls back to their true spiritual home.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 17
deva: अतीन्द्रः सङ्ग्रहः सर्गो धृतात्मा नियमो यमः॥
te: అతీంద్రః సంగ్రహః సర్గో ధృతాత్మా నియమో యమః ॥
iast: upendro vāmanaḥ prāṃśur amoghaḥ śucir ūrjitaḥ |
atīndraḥ saṅgrahaḥ sargo dhṛtātmā niyamo yamaḥ.
verses.te_meaning: ఇంద్రుని తమ్ముడు (ఉపేంద్రుడు); వామనుడు; ఎత్తుగా ఎదిగినవాడు (త్రివిక్రముడు); వ్యర్థం కానివాడు; పరిశుద్ధుడు; బలశాలి; ఇంద్రుణ్ణి మించినవాడు; పోషించేవాడు; సృష్టి; తనలో తానే స్థిరపడినవాడు; నియమించేవాడు, నియంత్రించేవాడు.
verses.en_meaning: Younger brother of Indra; the dwarf (Vamana); the towering; the unfailing; the pure; the mighty; surpassing Indra; the sustainer; the creation; self-established; the appointer and the regulator.
verses.words: Upendraḥ (The younger brother of Indra (manifest as Vamana) who is in truth the supreme Lord over Indra.); Vāmanaḥ (He who assumed the charming dwarf-brahmana form to subdue Bali's ego and restore cosmic balance.); Prāṁśuḥ (The colossal Trivikrama who expanded infinitely to measure the universe in three strides.); Amoghaḥ (He whose actions, purpose, and blessings are unfailingly fruitful and unerring.); Śuchiḥ (Spotlessly pure and holy, purifying anyone who remembers His auspicious names.); Ūrjitaḥ (Possessing boundless, unmatched strength, vitality, and transcendental majesty.); Atīndraḥ (Supremely superior to Indra and all cosmic rulers in glory, wisdom, and power.); Saṅgrahaḥ (He who draws together and holds all entities within Himself during universal dissolution.); Sargaḥ (The prime source and master of creation, who creates the universe effortlessly.); Dhṛtātmā (He whose self-established nature is ever independent, unswerving, and self-supported.); Niyamaḥ (The supreme Ordainer who appoints and regulates the specific functions and limits of all entities.); Yamaḥ (The supreme Controller who governs from within the hearts of all living beings.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 18
deva: वेद्यो वैद्यः सदायोगी वीरहा माधवो मधुः।
te: వేద్యో వైద్యః సదాయోగీ వీరహా మాధవో మధుః ।
iast: vedyo vaidyaḥ sadāyogī vīrahā mādhavo madhuḥ |
verses.te_meaning: తెలుసుకోదగినవాడు; (సంసారానికి) వైద్యుడు; ఎప్పుడూ యోగంలో ఉండేవాడు; బలమైన శత్రువులను చంపేవాడు; విద్యలకు ప్రభువు; తేనె లాంటి మధురుడు; ఇంద్రియాలకు అతీతుడు; గొప్ప మాయావి; గొప్ప ఉత్సాహం గలవాడు; గొప్ప బలం గలవాడు.
verses.en_meaning: The knowable; the physician (of samsara); ever in yoga; slayer of mighty foes; Lord of knowledge; sweet as honey; beyond the senses; the great wielder of Maya; of great zeal; of great strength.
verses.words: Vedyaḥ (The supreme Reality worthy of being known by all earnest seekers of spiritual truth.); Vaidhyaḥ (The supreme Physician who cures the chronic spiritual malady of worldly transmigration (Samsara).); Sadāyogī (Eternally awake in unbroken divine awareness and communion with His own infinite bliss.); Vīrahā (The slayer of mighty demonic tyrants who disrupt cosmic peace and Dharma.); Mādhavaḥ (The consort of Lakshmi and the fountainhead of all sacred knowledge and devotion.); Madhuḥ (Sweet as celestial honey, giving supreme spiritual delight to the souls who contemplate Him.); Atīndriyaḥ (Beyond the range of material senses, perceptible only through unalloyed devotion and grace.); Mahāmāyaḥ (Master of the supreme divine potency (Maya) that veils or liberates souls according to their karma and devotion.); Mahotsāhaḥ (Endowed with tireless, joyous enthusiasm in sustaining and governing the cosmic drama.); Mahābalaḥ (Possessing supreme, infinite strength that supports and controls all cosmic operations.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 19
verses.te_meaning: గొప్ప బుద్ధి గలవాడు; గొప్ప వీర్యం గలవాడు; గొప్ప శక్తి గలవాడు; గొప్ప తేజస్సు గలవాడు; వర్ణించలేని రూపం గలవాడు; శ్రీమంతుడు; కొలవలేని ఆత్మ గలవాడు; గొప్ప పర్వతాన్ని (మందర / గోవర్ధన) ఎత్తినవాడు.
verses.en_meaning: Of great wisdom; great vigour; great power; great splendour; of indefinable form; the glorious; of immeasurable Self; upholder of the great mountain (Mandara / Govardhana).
verses.words: Mahābuddiḥ (Endowed with infinite, boundless intelligence, wisdom, and omniscient discernment.); Mahāvīryaḥ (Possessing inexhaustible, heroic potency that remains untainted and undiminished.); Mahāśaktiḥ (Possessor of infinite divine energies and capacities capable of accomplishing anything instantaneously.); Mahādyutiḥ (Radiating supreme transcendental splendor that outshines millions of suns.); Anirdeśya-vapuḥ (He whose divine form is beyond worldly comparisons and cannot be fully described by finite words.); Śrīmān (Possessor of eternal spiritual beauty, fortune, and the company of Goddess Sri.); Ameyātmā (He whose infinite nature and knowledge cannot be measured or circumscribed.); Mahādridhṛk (He who lifted the great Mandara and Govardhana mountains with divine ease.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 20
verses.te_meaning: గొప్ప విలుకాడు; భూమిని మోసేవాడు; లక్ష్మికి నివాసం (శ్రీనివాసుడు); సజ్జనులకు గమ్యం; ఎవరూ అడ్డుకోలేనివాడు (అనిరుద్ధుడు); దేవతలకు ఆనందం; గోవిందుడు; వేదాలు తెలిసినవారికి ప్రభువు.
verses.en_meaning: The mighty archer; upholder of the earth; abode of Lakshmi; goal of the righteous; the unobstructed; joy of the gods; Govinda; and Lord of those who know the Vedas.
verses.words: Maheṣvāsaḥ (The bearer of the great divine bow Sharnga, unleashing arrows of righteous judgment.); Mahībhartā (The protector and husband of the Earth (Bhudevi), who rescued Her in the Varaha Avatara.); Śrīnivāsaḥ (He on whose sacred chest Goddess Lakshmi resides eternally with unbroken devotion.); Satāṁgatiḥ (The ultimate destination, protector, and guide for all righteous and saintly souls.); Aniruddhaḥ (The unobstructed Lord who cannot be resisted, hindered, or stopped by anyone.); Surānandaḥ (He who delights the righteous Devas with divine nectar and protection.); Govindaḥ (The Lord who rescues the Earth (Go), protects cows/senses, and is known through Vedic speech (Gau).); Govidāṁ patiḥ (The Master and Lord of all who are learned in the sacred knowledge of the Vedas.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 21
verses.te_meaning: కాంతి కిరణం; అణచివేసేవాడు; (జ్ఞానమనే) హంస; మంచి రెక్కలు గలవాడు (సుపర్ణుడు); పాములలో శ్రేష్ఠుడు (అనంతుడు); బంగారు నాభి గలవాడు; గొప్ప తపస్సు గలవాడు; పద్మనాభుడు; ప్రజలకు ప్రభువు.
verses.en_meaning: The ray of light; the subduer; the swan (of knowledge); the fair-winged; best of serpents (Ananta); the golden-naveled; of noble penance; lotus-naveled; Lord of creatures.
verses.words: Marīciḥ (The supreme Light that dispels the darkness of ignorance across all worlds.); Damanaḥ (He who disciplines and chastises the wicked while subduing the unruly senses of seekers.); Haṁsaḥ (The pristine Swan-Avatara who imparts pure spiritual discrimination between matter and spirit.); Suparṇaḥ (Endowed with beautiful wings of Vedic knowledge (or the Lord riding Garuda).); Bhujagottamaḥ (The Master who reclines upon the celestial serpent Adisesha, the foremost of serpents.); Hiraṇyanābhaḥ (Possessing a beautiful, auspicious golden navel that radiates divine splendor.); Sutapāḥ (Endowed with supreme spiritual penance and glorious meditative luster in Badarikashrama (Nara-Narayana).); Padmanābhaḥ (He who resides within the lotus of the human heart as the supreme Inner Ruler.); Prajāpatiḥ (The eternal Master and father of all living entities.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 22
deva: अमृत्युः सर्वदृक् सिंहः सन्धाता सन्धिमान् स्थिरः।
te: అమృత్యుః సర్వదృక్ సింహః సంధాతా సంధిమాన్ స్థిరః ।
iast: amṛtyuḥ sarvadṛk siṃhaḥ sandhātā sandhimān sthiraḥ |
verses.te_meaning: మరణం లేనివాడు; అన్నీ చూసేవాడు; సింహం; (కర్మలకు ఫలాన్ని) కలిపేవాడు; కలిసి ఉండేవాడు; స్థిరుడు; పుట్టుక లేనివాడు; (శత్రువులకు) సహించలేనివాడు; శాసించేవాడు; ప్రసిద్ధమైన ఆత్మ గలవాడు; దేవతల శత్రువులను సంహరించేవాడు.
verses.en_meaning: The deathless; all-seeing; the lion; the joiner (of fruits to actions); the united; the steady; the unborn; the unbearable (to foes); the instructor; the renowned Self; slayer of the enemies of the gods.
verses.words: Amṛtyuḥ (The deathless Lord who has no mortality and frees His devotees from the fear of death.); Sarvadṛk (The all-seeing One who witnesses all thoughts, actions, and events in the cosmos simultaneously.); Simhaḥ (The majestic Lion (Narasimha) who fearlessly destroys all demonic terror and protects His devotees.); Sandhātā (He who unites the jivas with the fruits of their karmas and unites devotees with divine grace.); Sandhimān (He who is eternally united with all auspicious attributes and with His devotees.); Sthiraḥ (Unchanging and eternally steadfast in His nature, love, and protection of devotees.); Ajaḥ (He who is birthless, and who moves (Ajati) as the inner controller within all hearts.); Durmarṣaṇaḥ (He whose irresistible divine power cannot be endured or opposed by the wicked.); Śāstā (The supreme Teacher and Lawgiver who commands and guides all worlds through the scriptures.); Vishrutatma (He whose divine glories and transcendental nature are specially praised throughout the Vedas.); Surārihā (The destroyer of the enemies of the Devas and the vanquisher of all unrighteous forces.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 23
verses.te_meaning: గురువు; గురువులకే గురువు; పరమ ధామం; సత్యం; సత్యమైన పరాక్రమం గలవాడు; (యోగనిద్రలో) కళ్ళు మూసుకున్నవాడు; ఎప్పుడూ మేల్కొని ఉండేవాడు; మాల ధరించినవాడు; వాక్కుకు ప్రభువు; ఉదారమైన బుద్ధి గలవాడు.
verses.en_meaning: The teacher; the greatest teacher; the supreme abode; the truth; of true valour; the closed-eyed (in yoga-sleep); the ever-awake; the garlanded; Lord of speech; of noble intellect.
verses.words: Guruḥ (The primordial Spiritual Master who imparts sacred knowledge to Brahma, Vayu, and all seekers.); Gurutamaḥ (The greatest and foremost of all teachers, the supreme illuminator of the intellect.); Dhāma (The supreme Abode, support, and reservoir of all divine light, power, and refuge.); Satyaḥ (The ultimate Reality whose existence, knowledge, and virtues are absolute and unconditioned.); Satyaparākamaḥ (He whose divine valor and might are always unfailing, true, and dedicated to Dharma.); Nimiṣaḥ (He who has His eyes closed in transcendental contemplative slumber (Yoga-nidra).); Animiṣaḥ (The ever-watchful Lord whose divine gaze never blinks, constantly guarding all beings.); Sragvī (He who wears the fragrant, eternal Vaijayanti garland representing the elements and senses.); Vācaspatir-udāradhīḥ (The Master of all sacred speech and learning, endowed with supremely noble and generous intellect.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 24
iast: agraṇīr grāmaṇīḥ śrīmān nyāyo netā samīraṇaḥ |
verses.te_meaning: నడిపించేవాడు; సైన్యాలకు నాయకుడు; శ్రీమంతుడు; న్యాయమే తానైనవాడు; మార్గదర్శి; అన్నిటినీ కదిలించేవాడు; వెయ్యి తలలవాడు; విశ్వానికి ఆత్మ; వెయ్యి కళ్ళవాడు; వెయ్యి పాదాలవాడు.
verses.en_meaning: The leader; commander of hosts; the glorious; the very principle of justice; the guide; the mover of all; the thousand-headed; Self of the universe; thousand-eyed; thousand-footed.
verses.words: Agraṇīḥ (He who leads and elevates His devotees to the highest spiritual state of liberation.); Grāmaṇīḥ (The supreme Director who commands the hosts of senses, elements, and cosmic deities.); Śrīmān (Endowed with supreme spiritual splendor, beauty, and the eternal grace of Goddess Lakshmi.); Nyāyaḥ (The embodiment of perfect justice, equity, and divine cosmic law.); Netā (The supreme Governor and leader who guides the cosmic machine and all souls toward their destiny.); Samīraṇaḥ (He who animates and moves all beings as the life-breath (Mukhyaprana-antaryami).); Sahasramūrdhā (Possessing countless heads in His cosmic form, knowing all thoughts across the universe.); Viśvātmā (The all-pervading Inner Soul and Ruler of the entire cosmos.); Sahasrākṣaḥ (Having thousands of eyes, witnessing all occurrences and prayers in all realms simultaneously.); Sahasrapāt (Having thousands of feet, moving everywhere simultaneously in His cosmic majesty.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 25
verses.te_meaning: సంసార చక్రాన్ని తిప్పేవాడు; లోకం నుండి వెనుదిరిగిన ఆత్మ గలవాడు; కప్పబడినవాడు; (దుష్టులను) నలిపేవాడు; ప్రకాశింపజేసేవాడు; కాలాన్ని నడిపేవాడు; అగ్ని; ఎప్పుడూ కదిలేవాడు; భూమిని ధరించేవాడు.
verses.en_meaning: Turner of the wheel of samsara; whose Self is turned away from the world; the veiled; the crusher (of the wicked); the illumining; the impeller of time; the fire; the ever-moving; upholder of the earth.
verses.words: Āvartanaḥ (He who turns the cosmic wheel of creation, preservation, and dissolution, and the cycle of Samsara.); Nivṛttātmā (He who is completely unattached to material bonds and desires, ever resting in pure bliss.); Saṁvṛtaḥ (Veiled from the sight of the unrighteous by His mystical divine power of Prakriti/Maya.); Sampramardanaḥ (He who thoroughly crushes the pride of the wicked and destroys the ignorance of devotees.); Ahaḥ-saṁvartakaḥ (He who causes the orderly progression of days, seasons, and cosmic time as the Sun.); Vahniḥ (The sacred Fire that carries all sacrificial offerings and purifies all things.); Anilaḥ (The life-giving Wind who needs no support and is ever free in His movements.); Dharaṇī-dharaḥ (The supreme Supporter who upholds the Earth in the form of Varaha and Adisesha.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 26
iast: satkartā satkṛtaḥ sādhur jahnur nārāyaṇo naraḥ.
verses.te_meaning: దయతో అనుగ్రహించేవాడు; ప్రశాంతమైన ఆత్మ గలవాడు; విశ్వాన్ని ధరించి, రక్షించి, వ్యాపించేవాడు; సజ్జనులను గౌరవించేవాడు; గౌరవించబడేవాడు; సత్పురుషుడు; జీవులను తనలోకి తీసుకునేవాడు; నారాయణుడు; నడిపించేవాడు.
verses.en_meaning: Of gracious favour; serene Self; upholder and protector and pervader of the universe; honourer of the good; the honoured; the righteous; the withdrawer of beings; Narayana; and the guide.
verses.words: Suprasādaḥ (He whose boundless grace is easily attained through sincere and pure devotion.); Prasannātmā (Ever serene, joyful, and gracious, untainted by anger, grief, or material turmoil.); Viśvadhṛg (The all-sustaining Lord who supports, protects, and nourishes the entire cosmos.); Viśvabhug (The enjoyer of the universe and the consumer who absorbs the cosmos during Pralaya.); Vibhuḥ (All-pervading in His infinite majesty, appearing in manifold divine forms simultaneously.); Satkartā (He who honors, loves, and rewards the righteous who perform good deeds.); Satkṛtaḥ (He who is reverently worshipped and adored by all virtuous and noble souls.); Sādhuḥ (He who accomplishes all noble purposes and acts righteously as the friend of the virtuous.); Jahnuḥ (He who withdraws and conceals Himself from those devoid of genuine devotion.); Nārāyaṇaḥ (The supreme Abode and refuge of all beings and cosmic elements (Nara = souls/elements, Ayana = refuge).); Naraḥ (The imperishable Leader who guides all souls along the spiritual path.); Asaṅkhyeyaḥ (He whose names, forms, virtues, and glories are infinite and beyond counting.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 27
verses.te_meaning: లెక్కలేనివాడు; కొలవలేని ఆత్మ గలవాడు; అందరిలో విశిష్టుడు; సజ్జనులకు నాయకుడు; పవిత్రుడు; ప్రతి సంకల్పం నెరవేరినవాడు; తిరుగులేని సంకల్పం గలవాడు; విజయాన్ని ఇచ్చేవాడు; విజయానికి సాధనం.
verses.en_meaning: The countless; of immeasurable Self; the pre-eminent; commander of the good; the pure; whose every purpose is fulfilled; of unfailing will; giver of success; and the means to success.
verses.words: Aprameyātmā (He whose transcendental nature cannot be measured or delimited by any finite intellect.); Viśiṣṭaḥ (Supremely pre-eminent, excelling all other beings in purity, power, and auspicious qualities.); Śiṣṭakṛt (The protector and benefactor of the virtuous who disciplines and purifies His devotees.); Suciḥ (Eternally pure, spotless, and illuminating, cleansing all who meditate upon Him.); Siddhārthaḥ (He whose every desire and purpose is eternally realized and self-fulfilled.); Siddhasaṅkalpaḥ (He whose divine will (Sankalpa) materializes instantly without any impediment.); Siddhidaḥ (The bestower of spiritual perfections (Siddhis), wisdom, and final liberation upon devotees.); Siddhisādhanaḥ (He who is both the ultimate Goal (Siddhi) and the divine Means (Sadhana) to attain it.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 28
verses.te_meaning: ధర్మానికి ప్రభువు; వరాలు కురిపించేవాడు; అంతటా వ్యాపించినవాడు; ధర్మానికి దారితీసే అడుగులు గలవాడు; ఉదరం నుండి జీవులు పుట్టేవాడు; పోషించేవాడు; ఎప్పుడూ పెరిగేవాడు; అంటనివాడు; వేదాల సముద్రం.
verses.en_meaning: Lord of dharma; showerer of blessings; the all-pervading; whose steps lead to dharma; from whose belly beings issue; the nourisher; the ever-growing; the unattached; the ocean of the Vedas.
verses.words: Vṛṣāhī (Luminous and righteous like the day of Dharma, dispelling the night of ignorance.); Vṛṣābhaḥ (He who showers the nectar of blessings and divine grace upon all devoted souls.); Viṣṇuḥ (The all-pervading Supreme Lord who took the cosmic strides in Vamana Avatara.); Vṛṣaparva (He whose steps are the ladder of Dharma leading sincere seekers to the heights of liberation.); Vṛṣodaraḥ (In whose divine belly all creatures and the waters of Dharma reside safely.); Vardhanaḥ (He who fosters and increases the spiritual prosperity and devotion of His seekers.); Vardhamānaḥ (He who expands in glory and manifests in limitless forms across all realms.); Viviktaḥ (Transcendental and untouched by matter, uniquely distinct from all other entities.); Śrutisāgaraḥ (The vast ocean into which all Vedic hymns and scriptures flow and find their ultimate meaning.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 29
deva: सुभुजो दुर्धरो वाग्मी महेन्द्रो वसुदो वसुः।
te: సుభుజో దుర్ధరో వాగ్మీ మహేంద్రో వసుదో వసుః ।
iast: subhujo durdharo vāgmī mahendro vasudo vasuḥ |
verses.te_meaning: అందమైన చేతులు గలవాడు; (ధ్యానంలో) భరించలేనివాడు; మాటకారి; మహేంద్రుడు; ధనాన్ని ఇచ్చేవాడు; ధనమే తానైనవాడు; అనేక రూపాలవాడు; విశాల రూపుడు; కిరణాలలో ఉండేవాడు; ప్రకాశింపజేసేవాడు.
verses.en_meaning: Of graceful arms; hard to bear (in meditation); the eloquent; the great Lord; giver of wealth; wealth itself; of many forms; of vast form; who abides in the rays; the illuminator.
verses.words: Subhujaḥ (Endowed with powerful, graceful arms that protect the universe and vanquish evil.); Durdharaḥ (He who bears the entire cosmic burden but cannot be restrained or bound by anyone.); Vāgmi (The supreme Orator whose words in the Vedas and Bhagavad Gita impart perfect wisdom.); Mahendraḥ (The Supreme Sovereign Lord of all lords, far superior to the celestial Indra.); Vasudaḥ (The generous giver of true wealth, prosperity, and spiritual treasures to devotees.); Vasuḥ (The supreme spiritual Wealth and the Indweller of all beings.); Naikarūpaḥ (Manifesting in countless divine forms while remaining one indivisible, perfect Lord.); Bṛhadrūpaḥ (Assuming colossal, magnificent cosmic forms like Trivikrama and Varaha.); Śipiviṣṭaḥ (Residing as the pure, radiant light within the solar rays and in all sacred sacrifices.); Prakāśanaḥ (The cosmic Illuminator who gives the power of light to the sun, stars, and intellect.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 30
verses.te_meaning: ఓజస్సు, తేజస్సు, కాంతి ధరించినవాడు; ప్రకాశించే ఆత్మ గలవాడు; తపింపజేసేవాడు; సంపూర్ణుడు; ఓంకారం స్పష్టంగా వ్యక్తమైనవాడు; పవిత్ర మంత్రం; చంద్రకిరణం లాంటి చల్లనివాడు; సూర్యుని లాంటి కాంతిమంతుడు.
verses.en_meaning: Bearer of vigour, lustre and radiance; of luminous Self; the scorcher; the full; whose syllable (Om) is manifest; the sacred Mantra; cool as the moon-ray; brilliant as the sun.
verses.words: Ōjas-tejō-dyuti-dharaḥ (Endowed with supreme vitality (Ojas), irresistible might (Tejas), and divine effulgence (Dyuti).); Prakāśātmā (The self-luminous Soul whose essence is pure, unblemished light and wisdom.); Pratāpanaḥ (He who warms and sustains the universe through the sun and consumes the wicked with His heat.); Ṛddhaḥ (Full of all abundance, complete with infinite wisdom, Dharma, and divine qualities.); Spaṣṭākṣaraḥ (Clearly indicated and glorified by the sacred syllable OM and the Vedic mantras.); Mantraḥ (The essence of all sacred mantras, contemplation upon whom protects and liberates.); Candrāṁśuḥ (Cool and comforting like moonbeams, soothing the worldly burning of suffering souls.); Bhāskara-dyutiḥ (Radiant with the blinding brilliance of millions of suns.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 31
verses.te_meaning: అమృత కిరణాల చంద్రునికి మూలం; ప్రకాశించేవాడు; చంద్రుని గుర్తు గలవాడు; దేవతలకు ప్రభువు; (సంసారానికి) ఔషధం; సంసారాన్ని దాటించే వంతెన; సత్యమైన ధర్మం, పరాక్రమం గలవాడు.
verses.en_meaning: Source of the nectar-rayed moon; the shining; moon-marked; Lord of the gods; the medicine (for samsara); the bridge across worldly existence; of true dharma and valour.
verses.words: Amṛtāṁśūdbhavaḥ (The divine source from whom the nectar-rayed Moon was born during the churning of the milk ocean.); Bhānuḥ (The radiant Lord who shines by His own self-luminous nature.); Śaśabinduḥ (Pleasing and beloved like the full moon, nurturing all life on earth.); Sureśvaraḥ (The supreme Lord and sovereign Commander of all divine beings and gods.); Auṣadham (The supreme divine Medicine that cures the universal disease of worldly transmigration (Bhava-roga).); Jagataḥ setuḥ (The bridge across the turbulent ocean of worldly existence, maintaining cosmic order.); Satya-dharma-parākramaḥ (He whose valor and power are rooted solely in absolute truth and sacred righteousness.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 32
iast: kāmahā kāmakṛt kāntaḥ kāmaḥ kāmapradaḥ prabhuḥ.
verses.te_meaning: భూత, భవిష్యత్, వర్తమానాలకు ప్రభువు; వాయువు; పవిత్రం చేసేవాడు; అగ్ని; కామాన్ని నశింపజేసేవాడు; కోరికలు తీర్చేవాడు; ప్రియమైనవాడు; కోరదగినవాడు; కోరికలు ప్రసాదించేవాడు; ప్రభువు.
verses.en_meaning: Lord of past, present and future; the wind; the purifier; the fire; destroyer of desire; fulfiller of desire; the beloved; the desired; giver of desires; the Lord.
verses.words: Bhūta-bhavya-bhavan-nāthaḥ (The independent Master, Lord, and Protector of all beings in the past, present, and future.); Pavanaḥ (He who moves swiftly and purifies the atmosphere in the form of the holy breeze.); Pāvanaḥ (The supreme Sanctifier whose very remembrance purifies the mind of all defilements.); Analaḥ (He whose boundless glory is never satiated (Na Alam) and who consumes sins like fire.); Kāmahā (The destroyer of material lust and selfish attachments in the hearts of devotees.); Kāmakṛt (The fulfiller of all righteous desires and pure aspirations of His devotees.); Kantaḥ (Possessing supreme, irresistible beauty and charming sweetness that attracts all hearts.); Kāmaḥ (The supreme Object of desire, sought after by all seekers of eternal bliss.); Kāmapradaḥ (The generous granter of both worldly prosperity and the ultimate goal of liberation (Moksha).); Prabhuḥ (The exalted, supreme Master who reigns over the entire universe with effortless ease.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 33
verses.te_meaning: యుగాలను సృష్టించేవాడు; యుగాలను తిప్పేవాడు; అనేక మాయలు గలవాడు; గొప్పగా మింగేవాడు; కనిపించనివాడు; అయినా వ్యక్తమైన రూపం గలవాడు; వేలమందిని జయించేవాడు; అనంతాన్ని జయించేవాడు.
verses.en_meaning: Maker of the ages; the revolver of the yugas; of manifold Maya; the great devourer; the imperceptible; yet of manifest form; conqueror of thousands; conqueror of the infinite.
verses.words: Yugādikṛd (The initiator of cosmic ages (Yugas) and cycles of time.); Yugāvartaḥ (He who revolves the cycles of the four Yugas (Krita, Treta, Dvapara, Kali) in orderly progression.); Naikamāyaḥ (He who wields manifold wondrous divine powers to accomplish His cosmic will.); Mahāśanaḥ (The great consumer who absorbs the entire manifested universe during universal dissolution.); Adṛśyaḥ (Invisible to material eyes and sense organs, perceptible only through the eye of devotion.); Vyaktarūpaḥ (Directly perceivable in His glorious transcendental forms by self-realized yogis and devotees.); Sahasrajit (The conqueror of thousands of demonic hordes in cosmic battle.); Anantajit (The eternally victorious Lord whose triumphs are boundless and without end.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 34
verses.te_meaning: ఇష్టుడు; అందరిలో సమానంగా ఉండేవాడు; జ్ఞానులకు ప్రియుడు; (కృష్ణునిగా) నెమలి పింఛం ధరించినవాడు; బంధించేవాడు; ధర్మమే తానైనవాడు; కోపాన్ని నశింపజేసేవాడు; (దుష్టులపై) కోపం కలిగించేవాడు; కర్త; విశ్వమే చేతులుగా గలవాడు; భూమిని ధరించేవాడు.
verses.en_meaning: The beloved; dwelling in all equally; dear to the wise; the crested (as Krishna); the binder; the very dharma; destroyer of wrath; rouser of wrath (in the good, against evil); the doer; whose arms are the universe; upholder of the earth.
verses.words: Iṣṭaḥ (The most beloved Object of worship, adored in all sacred Vedic sacrifices.); Aviśiṣṭaḥ (The peerless Lord who has no superior or equal, reigning supreme over all.); Śiṣṭeṣṭaḥ (Supremely dear and beloved to the wise, righteous, and holy sages.); Śikhaṇḍī (Adorned with the beautiful peacock feather as Sri Krishna, charming the hearts of devotees.); Nahuṣaḥ (He who binds all beings together through His wondrous cosmic power and maintains unity.); Vṛṣaḥ (The personification of Dharma who showers all auspicious blessings upon the virtuous.); Krōdhahā (The destroyer of destructive anger and malice in the hearts of His devotees.); Krōdhakṛt-kartā (He who generates righteous wrath to destroy demonic tyrants and restore cosmic justice.); Viśvabāhuḥ (Possessing hands in all directions, supporting and aiding all beings everywhere.); Mahīdharaḥ (The supporter of the Earth who holds Her steadfast in cosmic space.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 35
verses.te_meaning: జారిపోనివాడు (అచ్యుతుడు); ప్రసిద్ధుడు; ప్రాణం; ప్రాణాన్ని ఇచ్చేవాడు; ఇంద్రుని తమ్ముడు; సముద్రం (జలనిధి); అధిష్ఠానం; ఎప్పుడూ జాగరూకుడు; తనలో తానే స్థిరపడినవాడు.
verses.en_meaning: The unfallen; the renowned; the life-breath; giver of life; younger brother of Indra; the ocean (treasure of waters); the substratum; the ever-vigilant; the self-established.
verses.words: Acyutaḥ (Eternally firm, never slipping from His supreme perfection, and steadfast in saving His devotees.); Prathitaḥ (Celebrated and renowned across all worlds through His glorious transcendental deeds.); Prāṇaḥ (The supreme Vital Force and Animator of all life across the cosmos.); Prāṇadaḥ (The giver of strength, life, and spiritual energy to all living entities.); Vāsavānujaḥ (The younger brother of Indra (Vasava), incarnating as Vamana to restore Indra's kingdom.); Apāṁ nidhiḥ (The vast reservoir of waters (the cosmic ocean) where He reclines as Kshirodakashayi Vishnu.); Adhiṣṭhānam (The supreme Foundation and substratum in which the entire universe rests.); Apramattaḥ (Ever vigilant, never careless or heedless in managing the cosmic order and protecting devotees.); Pratiṣṭhitaḥ (Eternally established in His own unshakeable, independent glory.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 36
verses.te_meaning: ఎండింపజేసేవాడు (లేదా స్కందుడు); ధర్మాన్ని నిలిపేవాడు; భారాన్ని మోసేవాడు; వరాలు ఇచ్చేవాడు; గాలులను నడిపేవాడు; వాసుదేవుడు; గొప్ప కాంతి గలవాడు; ఆది దేవుడు; శత్రు నగరాలను ధ్వంసం చేసేవాడు.
verses.en_meaning: The one who dries up (or Skanda); upholder of dharma; bearer of the burden; giver of boons; mover of the winds; Vasudeva; of vast radiance; the primal God; destroyer of the enemy citadels.
verses.words: Skandaḥ (He who causes the flow of celestial nectar and the destruction of the wicked.); Skanda-dharaḥ (The upholder and supporter of righteous Dharma and righteous warriors.); Dhuryaḥ (He who bears the supreme responsibility and burden of cosmic creation, sustenance, and redemption.); Varadaḥ (The compassionate bestower of divine boons, spiritual wisdom, and liberation.); Vāyuvāhanaḥ (He who directs and impels the wind (Vayu) and uses the breath of life as His vehicle.); Vāsudevaḥ (The all-pervading Lord who resides in all things (Vasu) and plays delightfully (Deva); the son of Vasudeva.); Bṛhadbhānuḥ (Endowed with vast, radiant rays of light that illuminate all directions.); Ādidevaḥ (The primordial, original Deity who existed before all gods and cosmic creation.); Purandaraḥ (The shatterer of the strongholds and cities of the demonic forces.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 37
iast: aśokas tāraṇas tāraḥ śūraḥ śaurir janeśvaraḥ |
verses.te_meaning: శోకం లేనివాడు; (సంసారాన్ని) దాటించేవాడు; రక్షించేవాడు; వీరుడు; శూరుని కుమారుడు (కృష్ణుడు); జీవులకు ప్రభువు; అనుకూలుడు; వంద అవతారాలు ఎత్తినవాడు; చేతిలో పద్మం ఉన్నవాడు; కమల నేత్రుడు.
verses.en_meaning: Free from sorrow; the ferryman; the deliverer; the valiant; the son of Shura (Krishna); Lord of beings; the favourable; of a hundred incarnations; lotus-handed; lotus-eyed.
verses.words: Aśokaḥ (Completely free from all sorrow, grief, and anxiety, full of eternal bliss.); Tāraṇaḥ (The supreme Deliverer who ferries souls safely across the turbulent ocean of Samsara.); Tāraḥ (The Savior who saves devotees from the terror of worldly bondage and fear.); Śūraḥ (The valiant Hero whose unmatched prowess destroys all obstacles and evils.); Śauriḥ (Born in the heroic lineage of Shurasena as Sri Krishna, endowed with supreme heroism.); Janeśvaraḥ (The supreme Lord and sovereign Master of all people and living beings.); Anukūlaḥ (Ever favorable, loving, and beneficent toward all who seek His divine shelter.); Śatāvartaḥ (He who manifests in hundreds of glorious incarnations to protect Dharma and rescue the world.); Padmī (Holding the auspicious lotus flower, symbolizing purity, beauty, and cosmic creation.); Padma-nibhekṣaṇaḥ (Possessing eyes as charming and tender as the petals of a blooming lotus.); Padma-nābhaḥ (Whose navel is the origin of the cosmic lotus from which the universe manifests.); Aravindākṣaḥ (Having beautiful, wide eyes like the petals of a lotus, radiating compassion.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 38
verses.te_meaning: పద్మనాభుడు; కమల నేత్రుడు; హృదయ కమలంలో పూజించబడేవాడు; శరీరాలను పోషించేవాడు; గొప్ప సంపద గలవాడు; సమృద్ధుడు; ప్రాచీన ఆత్మ; విశాల నేత్రుడు; గరుడుని ధ్వజంగా గలవాడు.
verses.en_meaning: Lotus-naveled; lotus-eyed; worshipped within the heart-lotus; sustainer of bodies; of great prosperity; the full; the ancient Self; of great eyes (or axle); who bears Garuda on his banner.
verses.words: Padma-garbhaḥ (He who is meditated upon as dwelling within the lotus of the spiritual heart.); Śarīra-bhṛt (He who sustains and nourishes the physical bodies of all living beings through His divine energy.); Mahardhi (Endowed with immense, boundless spiritual prosperity, majesty, and opulence.); Ṛddhaḥ (Ever-flourishing and fully accomplished in all divine perfections.); Vṛddhātmā (The ancient, primeval Supreme Soul who is the oldest of all beings.); Mahākṣaḥ (Endowed with great, all-seeing divine eyes that behold all reality simultaneously.); Garuḍa-dhvajaḥ (He whose standard and emblem bears the majestic figure of Garuda, the eagle of the Vedas.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 39
verses.te_meaning: సాటిలేనివాడు; శరీరాలలో ప్రకాశించేవాడు; భయం కలిగించేవాడు; తగిన సమయాలు తెలిసినవాడు; హవిస్సును స్వీకరించేవాడు; అన్ని ప్రమాణాలతో తెలియబడేవాడు; లక్ష్మీపతి; యుద్ధంలో విజయుడు.
verses.en_meaning: The incomparable; who shines in bodies; the awe-inspiring; knower of the fitting times; receiver of the oblation; known by all marks of proof; consort of Lakshmi; victorious in battle.
verses.words: Atulaḥ (Incomparable One, having no equal or parallel in beauty, strength, knowledge, or grace.); Śarabhaḥ (The luminous Lord who destroys the bodies of the wicked and shines within the heart.); Bhīmaḥ (Awe-inspiring and formidable to the unrighteous, evoking reverence in all worlds.); Samayajñaḥ (The perfect knower of proper time, circumstance, and cosmic seasons for action.); Havir-hariḥ (The supreme receiver of all sacred offerings (Havis) who destroys all sins (Hari).); Sarva-lakṣaṇa-lakṣaṇyaḥ (Endowed with all supreme, auspicious bodily and spiritual marks revealed in the scriptures.); Lakṣmīvān (Eternally united with Goddess Lakshmi, the personification of divine fortune and grace.); Samitiñjayaḥ (Ever victorious in cosmic battles and debates, triumphing over all opposing forces.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 40
iast: vikṣaro rohito mārgo hetur dāmodaraḥ sahaḥ |
verses.te_meaning: క్షయం లేనివాడు; ఎర్రనివాడు (మత్స్యావతారం); మార్గం; కారణం; దామోదరుడు (నడుముకు తాడుతో కట్టబడినవాడు); సహనశీలి; భూమిని ధరించేవాడు; మహాభాగ్యశాలి; వేగవంతుడు; (ప్రళయంలో) అపారమైన ఆకలి గలవాడు.
