verses.en_meaning: The imperishable; the red one (fish incarnation); the path; the cause; Damodara (bound at the belly); the forbearing; upholder of the earth; the greatly fortunate; the swift; of boundless appetite (at dissolution).
verses.words: Vikṣaraḥ (Imperishable, free from decay, loss, or destruction under all circumstances.); Rōhitaḥ (He who incarnated as the divine red Fish (Matsya Avatara) to save the Vedas and creation.); Mārgaḥ (The supreme spiritual Path by walking which seekers attain eternal liberation.); Hetuḥ (The ultimate instrumental and primary cause behind the entire universe.); Damodaraḥ (Attained through self-control (Dama), who has all worlds within His belly (Udara), and bound by Mother Yashoda with love.); Sahaḥ (Endowed with immense forbearance, patiently bearing all things and forgiving His devotees.); Mahīdharaḥ (He who holds and stabilizes the Earth as mountain-like support and cosmic sustainer.); Mahābhāgaḥ (Possessing the highest fortune, sovereignty, beauty, renunciation, and divine virtues.); Vegavān (Endowed with infinite speed, reaching instantly wherever His devotees call upon Him.); Amitāśanaḥ (The limitless consumer who absorbs the vast universe into Himself at cosmic dissolution.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 41
deva: करणं कारणं कर्ता विकर्ता गहनो गुहः॥
te: కరణం కారణం కర్తా వికర్తా గహనో గుహః ॥
iast: karaṇaṃ kāraṇaṃ kartā vikartā gahano guhaḥ.
verses.te_meaning: సృష్టికి మూలం; (ప్రకృతిని) కదిలించేవాడు; లీలలు చేసే దేవుడు; గర్భంలో శ్రీ గలవాడు; పరమేశ్వరుడు; సాధనం; కారణం; కర్త; అనేక విధాలుగా సృష్టించేవాడు; అర్థం కానివాడు; రహస్యుడు.
verses.en_meaning: The source of creation; the agitator (of Prakriti); the sporting God; in whose womb is glory; the supreme Lord; the instrument; the cause; the doer; maker of the manifold; the unfathomable; the hidden.
verses.words: Udbhavaḥ (The creative origin from whom the entire cosmos springs forth into manifestation.); Kṣōbhaṇaḥ (He who stirs and activates Primordial Nature (Prakriti) at the dawn of creation.); Devaḥ (The self-luminous Lord who sports delightfully in cosmic creation, protection, and grace.); Śrīgarbhaḥ (He in whose divine belly Goddess Lakshmi and all cosmic riches find eternal shelter.); Parameśvaraḥ (The Supreme Ruler and absolute Sovereign above whom there is no higher authority.); Karaṇam (The supreme instrument and facilitator through which all cosmic actions are accomplished.); Kāraṇam (The primal, efficient cause from which the entire universe originates.); Kartā (The independent Doer who initiates and governs all cosmic operations.); Vikartā (The transformer who fashions the multifarious, wondrous varieties of creation.); Gahanaḥ (Profound, unfathomable, and deep; His divine nature cannot be penetrated by limited intellects.); Guhaḥ (The mysterious Indweller who conceals Himself within the secret cave of the heart.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 42
verses.te_meaning: నిశ్చయమే (జ్ఞానమే) తానైనవాడు; నిలిపి ఉంచే వ్యవస్థ; చివరి నివాసం; స్థానాన్ని ఇచ్చేవాడు; స్థిరుడు; గొప్ప సంపద గలవాడు; అత్యంత స్పష్టుడు; ఎప్పుడూ తృప్తుడు; సంపూర్ణుడు; శుభమైన చూపు గలవాడు.
verses.en_meaning: The very resolve (knowledge); the sustaining order; the final abode; giver of place; the fixed; of supreme prosperity; supremely manifest; the ever-content; the full; of auspicious glance.
verses.words: Vyavasāyaḥ (The embodiment of resolute determination, wisdom, and steadfast purpose.); Vyavasthānaḥ (He who assigns and maintains the universal laws, duties, and boundaries of all beings.); Sāṁsthānaḥ (The ultimate resting place and supreme station in which all entities abide.); Sthānadaḥ (The generous bestower of status, realms, and the supreme eternal abode (Moksha) upon devotees.); Dhruvaḥ (Eternally fixed, immutable, and permanent, never shifting from His divine perfection.); Pararddhiḥ (Possessing the highest, supreme spiritual glory, wealth, and majesty.); Paramaspaṣṭaḥ (Supremely clear, self-evident, and luminous to those endowed with pure devotion.); Tuṣṭaḥ (Eternally contented and pleased with even the humblest loving service of His devotees.); Puṣṭaḥ (Full of all perfection, overflowing with infinite virtues and strength.); Śubhekṣaṇaḥ (He whose glance is supremely auspicious, purifying and liberating all upon whom it falls.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 43
deva: रामो विरामो विरजो मार्गो नेयो नयोऽनयः।
te: రామో విరామో విరజో మార్గో నేయో నయోఽనయః ।
iast: rāmo virāmo virajo mārgo neyo nayo ’nayaḥ |
verses.te_meaning: ఆనందింపజేసేవాడు (రాముడు); విరామం; మాలిన్యం లేనివాడు; మార్గం; నడిపించబడేవాడు, నడిపించేవాడు; ఎవరిచేతా నడిపించబడనివాడు; వీరుడు; శక్తిమంతులలో శ్రేష్ఠుడు; ధర్మమే తానైనవాడు; ధర్మం తెలిసినవారిలో ఉత్తముడు.
verses.en_meaning: The delightful (Rama); the cessation; the stainless; the path; the guided and the guide; who is led by none; the hero; best of the powerful; dharma itself; foremost of the knowers of dharma.
verses.words: Ramaḥ (The supreme source of spiritual delight in whom enlightened yogis rejoice in eternal meditation (Ramante yogino'smin).); Virāmaḥ (The ultimate cessation where all worldly striving and wandering in Samsara come to rest.); Virajaḥ (Completely free from the material passion (Rajas) and defects, ever stainless.); Mārgaḥ (The true spiritual pathway through knowledge and devotion leading directly to God-realization.); Neyaḥ (He who lovingly allows Himself to be guided by the sincere prayers and devotion of His saints.); Nayaḥ (The divine Guide who leads all souls along the righteous path toward spiritual fulfillment.); Anayaḥ (He who cannot be directed or commanded by anyone, being the independent Lord of all.); Vīraḥ (The supreme Hero who effortlessly destroys all demonic forces and spiritual obstacles.); Śaktimatāṁ śreṣṭhaḥ (The foremost and most powerful among all mighty beings in the cosmos.); Dharmaḥ (The ultimate embodiment and foundation of all righteousness, virtue, and cosmic law.); Dharma-viduttamaḥ (The greatest among all knowers of Dharma, establishing true righteousness across all ages.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 44
deva: वैकुण्ठः पुरुषः प्राणः प्राणदः प्रणवः पृथुः।
te: వైకుంఠః పురుషః ప్రాణః ప్రాణదః ప్రణవః పృథుః ।
iast: vaikuṇṭhaḥ puruṣaḥ prāṇaḥ prāṇadaḥ praṇavaḥ pṛthuḥ |
verses.te_meaning: వైకుంఠనాథుడు; పురుషుడు; ప్రాణం; ప్రాణాన్ని ఇచ్చేవాడు; పవిత్రమైన ఓంకారం; విశాలుడు; హిరణ్యగర్భుడు; శత్రువులను చంపేవాడు; వ్యాపించబడినవాడు; వాయువు; తన స్వభావం నుండి ఎప్పుడూ జారనివాడు.
verses.en_meaning: Lord of Vaikuntha; the Purusha; the life-breath; giver of life; the sacred Om; the expansive; the golden-wombed; slayer of foes; the pervaded; the wind; who never declines from His nature.
verses.words: Vaikuṇṭhaḥ (He who unites the cosmic elements and removes all hindrances (Kuntha) on the path to liberation.); Puruṣaḥ (The Supreme Being who is full of all infinite virtues and precedes the entire universe.); Prāṇaḥ (The supreme Life and animator of all living entities throughout the cosmos.); Prāṇadaḥ (The bestower of life, vital breath, strength, and spiritual wisdom upon all souls.); Praṇavaḥ (The sacred primordial sound OM, glorifying the Supreme Lord who is bowed to by all.); Pṛthuḥ (The expansive Lord who manifested as King Prithu to cultivate and nourish the Earth.); Hiraṇyagarbhaḥ (The creator and sustainer who holds the luminous golden cosmic egg within Himself.); Śatrughnaḥ (The slayer of all internal enemies (lust, anger, greed) and external demonic foes.); Vyāptaḥ (All-pervading in His transcendental essence, filling all space, time, and hearts.); Vāyuḥ (The mover and purifier who gives life to all beings as the supreme Inner Breath.); Adhokṣajaḥ (Beyond the grasp of material senses (Aksha), unexhausted and inexhaustible in glory.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 45
verses.te_meaning: ఋతువులు; శుభమైన దర్శనం గలవాడు (సుదర్శనుడు); కాలం; పరమంలో స్థిరపడినవాడు; (పూజను) స్వీకరించేవాడు; భయంకరుడు; సంవత్సరం; నైపుణ్యం గలవాడు; విశ్రాంతి స్థానం; అత్యంత నేర్పరి.
verses.en_meaning: The seasons; of auspicious sight (Sudarshana); time; established in the supreme; the receiver (of worship); the terrible; the year; the skilful; the resting-place; supremely dexterous.
verses.words: Ṛtuḥ (The regulator of cosmic seasons and time, bringing order and renewal to creation.); Sudarśanaḥ (He whose auspicious vision (Darshana) confers liberation, and wielder of the divine Sudarshana Chakra.); Kālaḥ (The Master of Time who measures, drives, and dissolves all cosmic events.); Parameṣṭhī (Enthroned in the supreme celestial realm of Vaikuntha and in the highest sanctuary of the heart.); Parigrahaḥ (He who lovingly accepts even the simplest offerings of devotees and grasps them with protection.); Ugraḥ (Fierce and terrifying to the wicked (as Narasimha), commanding awe across the cosmos.); Saṁvatsaraḥ (He in whom all beings live and abide through the cycles of time.); Dakṣaḥ (Supremely skilled, prompt, and energetic in accomplishing all cosmic tasks effortlessly.); Viśrāmaḥ (The ultimate peaceful Haven and resting place for weary souls wandering in Samsara.); Viśvadakṣiṇaḥ (Supremely generous, bestowing gifts and blessings abundantly upon all beings.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 46
verses.te_meaning: విస్తారం; దృఢమైన, కదలని ఆధారం; ప్రమాణమే తానైనవాడు; నాశనం లేని బీజం; కోరదగిన గమ్యం; ఏదీ అవసరం లేనివాడు; గొప్ప నిధి గలవాడు; గొప్ప భోగం గలవాడు; గొప్ప ధనం గలవాడు.
verses.en_meaning: The expanse; the firm and unmoving support; the very proof; the imperishable seed; the sought-for goal; needing nothing; of vast treasure; of great enjoyment; of great wealth.
verses.words: Vistāraḥ (He in whom the vast universe expands, and who extends His presence everywhere.); Sthāvaraḥ-sthāṇuḥ (Eternally firm, unmoving, and stable, maintaining the steadfastness of creation.); Pramāṇaṁ (The supreme authority of truth and the personification of unassailable valid knowledge.); Bījamavyayam (The imperishable, eternal Seed from which all creation continually springs.); Arthaḥ (The supreme Goal sought by all spiritual aspirants and the source of true happiness.); Anarthaḥ (Free from all worldly desires and completely devoid of any calamity or distress.); Mahākōśaḥ (Enveloping the universe in five subtle sheaths (Koshas), great and unfathomable.); Mahābhōgaḥ (The possessor and enjoyer of infinite, supreme spiritual bliss and opulence.); Mahādhanaḥ (Possessor of inexhaustible wealth, grace, and spiritual treasures.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 47
verses.te_meaning: ఎప్పుడూ నిరాశపడనివాడు; విశాలుడు; పుట్టుక లేనివాడు; ధర్మానికి యూపస్తంభం; మహా యజ్ఞం; నక్షత్రాలకు కేంద్రం; నక్షత్రాలకు ప్రభువు (చంద్రుడు); సమర్థుడు; పవిత్రుడు; మంచి సంకల్పం గలవాడు.
verses.en_meaning: Never despondent; the vast; the birthless; the sacrificial post of dharma; the great sacrifice; hub of the stars; lord of the stars (moon); the capable; the pure; the well-intentioned.
verses.words: Anirviṇṇaḥ (Ever enthusiastic and free from all despondency, sorrow, or fatigue in running the universe.); Sthaviṣṭhaḥ (The immensely vast One who encompasses the entire cosmic form.); Abhūḥ (Unborn and uncreated, having no material origin outside of Himself.); Dharma-yūpaḥ (The sacred sacrificial pillar to which all universal Dharma is anchored.); Mahāmakhaḥ (He for whom all great Vedic sacrifices (Yajnas) are performed, making them fruitful.); Nakṣatra-nemiḥ (The celestial Hub around which the wheel of all stars, planets, and constellations revolves.); Nakṣatrī (The ruler of the celestial bodies, shining as the Moon among the stars.); Kṣamaḥ (Endowed with supreme patience, forbearance, and competence in managing all things.); Kṣāmaḥ (Remaining solitary and serene after dissolving the entire universe at Pralaya.); Samīhanaḥ (Ever actively willing and organizing the well-being and liberation of all souls.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 48
deva: यज्ञ इज्यो महेज्यश्च क्रतुः सत्रं सतां गतिः।
te: యజ్ఞ ఇజ్యో మహేజ్యశ్-చ క్రతుః సత్రం సతాం గతిః ।
iast: yajña ijyo mahejyaś ca kratuḥ satraṃ satāṃ gatiḥ |
verses.te_meaning: యజ్ఞం; పూజించబడేవాడు; అత్యంత పూజ్యుడు; క్రతువు; సత్రయాగం; సజ్జనులకు గమ్యం; అన్నీ చూసేవాడు; ఎప్పుడూ ముక్తుడైన ఆత్మ; సర్వజ్ఞుడు; ఉత్తమమైన జ్ఞానం.
verses.en_meaning: The sacrifice; the worshipped; supremely worshipped; the rite; the sacrificial session; goal of the good; the all-seeing; the ever-free Self; the omniscient; the supreme knowledge.
verses.words: Yajñaḥ (The embodiment of all sacred sacrifice (Yajna), directly propitiated through all offerings.); Ijyaḥ (The supreme Object of worship to whom all oblations and prayers are rightfully directed.); Mahejyaḥ (The most exalted among all who are worthy of supreme adoration and worship.); Kratuḥ (The personification of sacred rituals, rites, and the divine intent behind them.); Satraṁ (The protector of the good (Sat-tra) and the embodiment of the sacred long-duration Soma sacrifice.); Satāṁ-gatiḥ (The supreme Refuge, Path, and Goal for all saintly, righteous persons.); Sarva-darśī (The all-seeing Witness who perceives all things, actions, and minds naturally and directly.); Vimuktātmā (Eternally free from all material bonds, karma, and worldly contamination.); Sarvagñaḥ (Omniscient Lord who knows everything that exists, has existed, or will exist in full detail.); Jñānam-uttamam (The supreme embodiment of transcendental knowledge and supreme wisdom.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 49
deva: सुव्रतः सुमुखः सूक्ष्मः सुघोषः सुखदः सुहृत्।
te: సువ్రతః సుముఖః సూక్ష్మః సుఘోషః సుఖదః సుహృత్ ।
iast: suvrataḥ sumukhaḥ sūkṣmaḥ sughoṣaḥ sukhadaḥ suhṛt |
verses.te_meaning: మంచి వ్రతాలు గలవాడు; ప్రసన్నమైన ముఖం గలవాడు; సూక్ష్ముడు; శుభమైన నాదం గలవాడు; సుఖాన్ని ఇచ్చేవాడు; మిత్రుడు; మనసులను ఆకర్షించేవాడు; కోపాన్ని జయించినవాడు; వీరమైన బాహువులు గలవాడు; (దుష్టులను) చీల్చేవాడు.
verses.en_meaning: Of noble vows; of pleasant face; the subtle; of auspicious sound; giver of joy; the friend; the captivator of minds; conqueror of wrath; of heroic arms; the render (of the wicked).
verses.words: Suvrataḥ (Firm in His divine vows of protecting the surrendered (Sharanagata-rakshana).); Sumukhaḥ (Possessing a gracious, beautiful, smiling countenance that radiates divine grace.); Sūkṣmaḥ (Subtle, pervasive, and capable of entering into the most minute particle of creation.); Sughōṣaḥ (Resonant with the auspicious and purifying sound of the sacred Vedic hymns and the Panchajanya conch.); Sukhadaḥ (The generous giver of true joy, peace, and eternal spiritual bliss (Moksha) to devotees.); Suhṛt (The genuine, selfless Friend of all living beings who helps without expecting anything in return.); Manōharaḥ (Captivating the hearts and minds of all devotees by His supreme transcendental beauty.); Jitakrōdhaḥ (Completely victorious over anger, maintaining divine serenity under all circumstances.); Vīrabāhuḥ (Possessing mighty, heroic arms capable of protecting the righteous and crushing evil.); Vidāraṇaḥ (He who tears apart and destroys the demonic oppressors of Dharma (as Narasimha tore Hiranyakashipu).)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 50
verses.te_meaning: జీవులను (మాయా) నిద్రలోకి పంపేవాడు; ఆత్మ నిగ్రహం గలవాడు; వ్యాపించేవాడు; అనేక రూపాలవాడు; అనేక పనులు చేసేవాడు; నివాసం (సంవత్సరం); వాత్సల్యం గలవాడు; రక్షించేవాడు; గర్భంలో రత్నాలు గలవాడు; ధనానికి ప్రభువు.
verses.en_meaning: Who casts beings into sleep (of Maya); the self-controlled; the pervading; of manifold aspects; doer of many deeds; the abode (year); the affectionate; the protector; whose womb holds jewels; Lord of wealth.
verses.words: Svāpanaḥ (He who brings restful sleep to beings and lulls the universe into slumber during dissolution.); Svavaśaḥ (Fully independent and self-controlled, subject to no external power or constraint.); Vyāpī (All-pervading One who fills every nook and corner of the cosmos with His presence.); Naikātmā (Manifesting in countless divine forms while remaining one unfragmented Supreme Lord.); Naikakarmakṛt (The performer of manifold cosmic works including creation, preservation, destruction, and redemption.); Vatsaraḥ (The Abode in whom all souls and entities dwell comfortably.); Vatsalaḥ (Deeply affectionate and compassionate toward His devotees, loving them like a mother loves her child.); Vatsī (The protector of calves/children; all jivas are His beloved children whom He nurtures.); Ratnagarbhaḥ (The ocean of all precious jewels, holding immense wealth and divine virtues within Himself.); Dhaneśvaraḥ (The supreme Lord and dispenser of all physical and spiritual wealth.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 51
iast: dharmagub dharmakṛd dharmī sadasat kṣaram akṣaram |
verses.te_meaning: ధర్మాన్ని రక్షించేవాడు; ధర్మం చేసేవాడు; ధర్మాన్ని నిలిపేవాడు; సత్తు, అసత్తు రెండూ తానే; క్షరం, అక్షరం రెండూ తానే; (శుద్ధ సాక్షిగా) తెలుసుకోనివాడు; వేయి కిరణాలవాడు; విధాత; స్పష్టమైన లక్షణాలు గలవాడు.
verses.en_meaning: Protector of dharma; doer of dharma; upholder of dharma; the real and the unreal; the perishable and the imperishable; the non-knower (as pure witness); the thousand-rayed; the ordainer; whose nature is well-defined.
verses.words: Dharmagub (The vigilant guardian and protector of eternal Dharma.); Dharmakṛd (The practitioner and upholder of Dharma, setting the perfect ideal in His Avataras.); Dharmī (The ultimate repository and supporter of all righteous virtues.); Sat (The eternal, unchanging Reality (Brahman) who exists unconditionally across all time.); Asat (Beyond the comprehension of worldly intellect and distinct from mutable material forms.); Kṣaram (The controller of perishable material creation, causing its transformation.); Akṣaram (The imperishable Supreme Brahman, distinct from all perishable matter and mutable souls.); Avijñātā (Unknown in His entirety to limited minds, yet the all-knowing Knower within all.); Sahasrāṁśuḥ (Endowed with thousands of radiant rays of divine light, illuminating the worlds.); Vidhātā (The supreme Arranger who supports the great cosmic supporters (like Adisesha and Diggajas).); Kṛtalakṣaṇaḥ (The author of the defining characteristics and science of all things, adorned with auspicious marks.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 52
verses.te_meaning: (కాంతి) కిరణాలకు కేంద్రం; సత్త్వంలో ఉండేవాడు; సింహం; జీవులకు మహేశ్వరుడు; ఆది దేవుడు; మహాదేవుడు; దేవతలకు ప్రభువు; దేవతలను పోషించేవాడు; గురువు.
verses.en_meaning: Hub of the rays (of light); seated in sattva; the lion; great Lord of beings; the primal God; the great God; Lord of the gods; supporter of the gods; the teacher.
verses.words: Gabhastinemiḥ (Residing at the center of the wheel of radiant solar rays as the cosmic Sun.); Sattvasthaḥ (Established in pure, unmixed spiritual existence (Shuddha-sattva) and dwelling in the virtuous.); Simhaḥ (Majestic and fearless like the Lion, destroying the elephant-like sins of devotees.); Bhūtamaheśvaraḥ (The supreme Sovereign and great Lord over all created beings and cosmic deities.); Ādidevaḥ (The primordial God who existed prior to all celestials and cosmic creation.); Mahādevaḥ (The great God who excels all beings in wisdom, majesty, and transcendental bliss.); Deveśaḥ (The Supreme Lord and commander of all the Devas.); Devabhṛd-guruḥ (The Teacher, Master, and Protector of Indra (the leader of Devas).)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 53
verses.te_meaning: అతీతుడు; భూమికి (లేదా వాక్కుకు) ప్రభువు; రక్షించేవాడు; జ్ఞానంతో పొందదగినవాడు; ప్రాచీనుడు; శరీరంలోని ధాతువులను పోషించేవాడు; అనుభవించేవాడు; వానరులకు ప్రభువు (రాముడు); అపారమైన దానాలు ఇచ్చేవాడు.
verses.en_meaning: The transcendent; Lord of the earth (or of speech); the protector; attainable through knowledge; the ancient; sustainer of the elements of the body; the enjoyer; Lord of the monkeys (Rama); giver of abundant gifts.
verses.words: Uttaraḥ (The supreme Savior who lifts all souls out of the ocean of worldly existence (Samsara).); Gōpatiḥ (The Lord and protector of the Earth, the cows, the senses, and the sacred Vedas.); Gōptā (The universal Protector who shields all surrendered souls from fear and destruction.); Jñānagamyaḥ (Attainable only through pure spiritual knowledge and unswerving devotion.); Purātanaḥ (The ancient, primeval Lord who is not limited by the bounds of time.); Śarīrabhūtabhṛd (The Sustainer of the physical elements and subtle bodies of all living entities.); Bhōktā (The supreme Enjoyer of all devotion and the protector who delights in His devotees' spiritual welfare.); Kapīndraḥ (The beloved Lord of the monkey warriors (as Sri Rama) and the divine Boar (Varaha).); Bhūridakṣiṇaḥ (The generous performer of great sacrifices who bestows lavish blessings and spiritual rewards.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 54
iast: vinayo jayaḥ satyasandho dāśārhaḥ sātvatāṃ patiḥ.
verses.te_meaning: సోమం తాగేవాడు; అమృతం తాగేవాడు; (మొక్కలను పోషించే) చంద్రుడు; అనేకులను జయించేవాడు; జీవులలో శ్రేష్ఠుడు; వినయం నేర్పేవాడు; విజయం; సత్యమైన సంకల్పం గలవాడు; దాశార్హ వంశంలో పుట్టినవాడు; సాత్వతులకు ప్రభువు.
verses.en_meaning: Drinker of the Soma; drinker of the nectar; the moon (that nourishes plants); conqueror of many; supreme among beings; the humbler; the victory; of true resolve; born in the Dasharha clan; Lord of the Satvatas.
verses.words: Sōmapaḥ (The supreme receiver who drinks the sacred Soma juice in Vedic sacrifices.); Amṛtapaḥ (The Drinker and bestower of the nectar of immortality and divine spiritual bliss.); Sōmaḥ (Nourishing all medicinal herbs and plants with cool, refreshing celestial nectar as the Moon.); Purujit (The conqueror of numerous enemies in all realms.); Purushottamaḥ (The foremost and most excellent among all great beings.); Vinayaḥ (He who teaches humility and disciplines the wicked, leading souls to righteousness.); Jayaḥ (The personification of victory, triumphing over all material bonds and ignorance.); Satyasandhaḥ (He whose resolve (Sankalpa) and promise are always true, unfailing, and completely fulfilled.); Dāśārhaḥ (Worthy of all offerings and gifts, born in the noble Dasharha (Yadava) clan as Sri Krishna.); Sātvatāṁ-patiḥ (The supreme Lord and protector of the devotees following the Satvata / Bhagavata tradition.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 55
verses.te_meaning: జీవాత్మ; క్రమశిక్షణ నేర్పేవాడు; సాక్షి; మోక్షాన్ని ఇచ్చేవాడు (ముకుందుడు); కొలవలేని అడుగులు గలవాడు; సముద్రం; అనంతమైన ఆత్మ గలవాడు; మహా సముద్రంపై పడుకునేవాడు; అన్నిటినీ అంతం చేసేవాడు.
verses.en_meaning: The living Self; the disciplinarian; the witness; the giver of liberation (Mukunda); of immeasurable stride; the ocean; of infinite Self; who reclines on the great ocean; the ender (of all).
verses.words: Jīvaḥ (The life-giving Lord who sustains the existence of all individual souls.); Vinayitā-sākṣī (The omniscient Witness of the humility and genuine devotion of His devotees.); Mukundaḥ (The bestower of liberation (Mukti) and supreme spiritual bliss.); Amitavikramaḥ (Possessing boundless, immeasurable valor and cosmic strides.); Ambhōnidhiḥ (The celestial ocean in whom the waters of creation and all elements reside.); Anantātmā (The infinite Soul possessing limitless divine forms, knowledge, and perfections.); Mahōdadhi-śayaḥ (Reclining in blissful yoga-nidra upon the cosmic ocean on the serpent bed of Adisesha.); Antakaḥ (He who brings about the cosmic end of all created beings at the appointed time.); Ajaḥ (The unborn Lord who has no material beginning or birth.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 56
verses.te_meaning: పుట్టుక లేనివాడు; గొప్పగా పూజించదగినవాడు; ఎప్పుడూ తన స్వభావంలో స్థిరుడు; శత్రువులను జయించినవాడు; ఎప్పుడూ ఆనందంగా ఉండేవాడు; ఆనందమే తానైనవాడు; ఆనందింపజేసేవాడు; సంపూర్ణుడు; సత్యమైన ధర్మం గలవాడు; మూడు అడుగులతో లోకాలను కొలిచినవాడు.
verses.en_meaning: The unborn; worthy of great worship; ever-established in His own nature; conqueror of foes; the ever-joyous; bliss itself; the delighter; the full; of true dharma; who measured the worlds in three strides.
verses.words: Mahārhaḥ (Worthy of the highest reverence, worship, and devotion in all the worlds.); Svābhāvyaḥ (Eternally established in His self-existent, unconditioned nature.); Jitāmitraḥ (He who has completely conquered all adversaries, both internal and external.); Pramōdanaḥ (The source of supreme joy who delights the hearts of those who meditate on Him.); Ānandaḥ (The embodiment of pure, unalloyed, infinite spiritual bliss.); Nandanaḥ (He who brings joy and spiritual happiness to all living entities.); Nandaḥ (Full of all spiritual opulence, virtues, and transcendental delight.); Satyadharmā (Possessing true, eternal Dharma and rewarding all according to righteousness.); Trivikramaḥ (He who measured the three worlds with His three mighty divine strides as Vamana.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 57
verses.te_meaning: మహర్షి; గురువైన కపిలుడు; చేసినదంతా తెలిసినవాడు; భూమికి ప్రభువు; మూడు అడుగులవాడు; దేవతలను పర్యవేక్షించేవాడు; గొప్ప కొమ్ము గలవాడు (మత్స్యం); (మృత్యువు యొక్క) అంతాన్ని నాశనం చేసేవాడు.
verses.en_meaning: The great seer; the teacher Kapila; knower of all that is done; Lord of the earth; of three strides; overseer of the gods; the great-horned (fish); destroyer of the end (of death).
verses.words: Maharṣiḥ Kapilācāryaḥ (The great sage Kapila, the master who revealed the pure theistic Sankhya philosophy.); Kṛtajñaḥ (He who acknowledges and rewards the sincere devotion of His seekers.); Medinīpatiḥ (The supreme Lord and protector of the Earth.); Tripadaḥ (He who took three cosmic steps, and who is praised in the three parts of the Gayatri mantra.); Tridaśādhyakṣaḥ (The supreme Ruler and Guardian of the thirty-three groups of Devas.); Mahāśṛṅgaḥ (The divine Horned One (Matsya/Varaha) who anchored the vessel of creation.); Kṛtānta-kṛt (The controller and destroyer of death (Yama), who terminates cosmic cycles.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 58
verses.te_meaning: మహా వరాహం; గోవిందుడు; మంచి సైన్యం గలవాడు; బంగారు భుజకీర్తులు ధరించినవాడు; రహస్యుడు; లోతైనవాడు; చొరరానివాడు; దాగి ఉన్నవాడు; చక్రం, గద ధరించినవాడు.
verses.en_meaning: The great boar; Govinda; of goodly army; wearing golden armlets; the mysterious; the profound; the impenetrable; the hidden; bearer of discus and mace.
verses.words: Mahā-varāhaḥ (The colossal divine Boar who lifted the Earth from the dark cosmic waters.); Gōvindaḥ (He who is known through sacred Vedic words and who brought joy to the cows of Vrindavan.); Suṣeṇaḥ (Surrounded by an auspicious, invincible army of celestial beings and devotees.); Kanakāṅgadī (Adorned with glowing golden armlets that accentuate His divine beauty.); Guhyaḥ (Profound and concealed, to be realized within the secret cave of the heart.); Gabhīraḥ (Unfathomably deep in wisdom, majesty, and divine attributes.); Gahanaḥ (Impenetrable and inaccessible to speculative intellect and material senses.); Guptaḥ (Concealed from the unrighteous, protected by sacred mystery.); Chakra-gadā-dharaḥ (The bearer of the divine discus (Sudarshana) and mace (Kaumodaki) to protect Dharma.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 59
verses.te_meaning: సృష్టికర్త; తన అవయవాలతోనే పని చేసేవాడు; ఓటమి లేనివాడు; కృష్ణుడు; దృఢుడు; అన్నిటినీ తనలోకి లాగుకునేవాడు; అచ్యుతుడు; వరుణుడు (అస్తమించే సూర్యుడు); వరుణుని కుమారుడు; (స్థిరమైన) వృక్షం; కమల నేత్రుడు; గొప్ప మనసు గలవాడు.
verses.en_meaning: The creator; who acts through His own limbs; the unconquered; Krishna; the firm; who draws all into Himself; the unfallen; Varuna (setting sun); son of Varuna; the tree (steadfast); lotus-eyed; the great-minded.
verses.words: Vedhāḥ (The supreme Creator and Ordainer of all cosmic functions.); Svāṅgaḥ (Possessing limbs of pure consciousness and bliss, self-supported and perfect.); Ajitaḥ (The invincible One who can never be conquered by anyone.); Kṛṣṇaḥ (The dark, all-attractive Supreme Lord of infinite bliss and consciousness.); Dṛḍhaḥ (Firm and steadfast in His resolve, promises, and protection.); Saṅkarṣaṇo-acyutaḥ (The divine emanation who draws all things together at dissolution without losing His own perfection.); Varuṇaḥ (The envelope and controller of cosmic waters, who envelops all with His presence.); Vāruṇaḥ (The Inner Guide of Varuna, radiating wisdom and purity.); Vṛukṣaḥ (The cosmic tree of life providing shade, shelter, and fruits of liberation to all souls.); Puṣkarākṣaḥ (Possessing eyes as expansive and serene as lotus blossoms.); Mahāmanāḥ (Endowed with an expansive, benevolent mind capable of willing all cosmic deeds.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 60
verses.te_meaning: భగవంతుడు; (ప్రళయంలో) ఆరు ఐశ్వర్యాలను ఉపసంహరించేవాడు; ఎప్పుడూ ఆనందమయుడు; వనమాల ధరించినవాడు; నాగలి ఆయుధంగా గలవాడు (బలరాముడు); అదితి కుమారుడు; సూర్యునిలోని కాంతి; సహనశీలి; పరమ గమ్యం.
verses.en_meaning: The blessed Lord; withdrawer of the six glories (at dissolution); the ever-blissful; wearer of the forest-garland; the plough-armed (Balarama); son of Aditi; the radiance within the sun; the forbearing; the supreme goal.
verses.words: Bhagavān (Possessing the six divine opulences in full: wealth, strength, fame, beauty, wisdom, and renunciation.); Bhagahā (He who withdraws the cosmic opulences into Himself during dissolution.); Ānandī (Full of eternal, uninterrupted bliss, sharing that joy with His devotees.); Vanamālī (Adorned with the divine garland of forest flowers (Vanamala) symbolizing the cosmic elements.); Halāyudhaḥ (Wielder of the plough weapon as Balarama, subduing the arrogant and purifying the Earth.); Ādityaḥ (Born of Aditi as the divine Vamana, shining with celestial splendor.); Jyōtir-ādityaḥ (The supreme Effulgence within the Sun that gives illumination to the cosmos.); Sahiṣṇuḥ (Endowed with supreme patience, bearing all dualities and forgiving sincere devotees.); Gatisattamaḥ (The highest and most noble destination for all spiritual seekers.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 61
verses.te_meaning: మంచి విల్లు (శార్ఙ్గం) గలవాడు; గొడ్డలి ధరించినవాడు (పరశురాముడు); దుష్టులకు కఠినుడు; ధనాన్ని ఇచ్చేవాడు; ఆకాశాన్ని తాకేవాడు; అన్నీ చూసేవాడు; వేదాలను విభజించినవాడు (వ్యాసుడు); విద్యకు ప్రభువు; గర్భం నుండి పుట్టనివాడు.
verses.en_meaning: Of the goodly bow (Sharnga); wielder of the axe (Parashurama); harsh to the wicked; giver of wealth; who touches the heavens; all-seeing; the arranger (Vyasa); Lord of learning; the womb-born (unborn).
verses.words: Sudhanvā (The bearer of the glorious bow Sharnga, which never misses its righteous target.); Khaṇda-paraśuḥ (Wielder of the sharp battle-axe as Parashurama to rid the earth of tyrannical oppressors.); Dāruṇaḥ (Fierce and formidable in punishing those who tread the path of evil.); Draviṇapradaḥ (The bestower of material wealth and the greatest treasure of spiritual devotion.); Divah-spṛk (Touching the highest celestial heavens with His colossal cosmic form.); Sarvadṛg-vyāsaḥ (The all-seeing Sage Vyasa who arranged the single Veda into four and composed the Mahabharata.); Vācaspatirayōnijaḥ (The Master of all sacred speech who has no material birth from a womb.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 62
deva: त्रिसामा सामगः साम निर्वाणं भेषजं भिषक्।
te: త్రిసామా సామగః సామ నిర్వాణం భేషజం భిషక్ ।
iast: trisāmā sāmagaḥ sāma nirvāṇaṃ bheṣajaṃ bhiṣak |
saṃnyāsakṛc chamaḥ śānto niṣṭhā śāntiḥ parāyaṇam.
verses.te_meaning: మూడు సామాలతో స్తుతించబడేవాడు; సామగానం చేసేవాడు; సామమే తానైనవాడు; పరమానందం; ఔషధం; వైద్యుడు; సన్యాసాన్ని నిర్దేశించినవాడు; శాంతుడు; ప్రశాంతుడు; అన్నిటికీ ఆధారం; శాంతి; ఉత్తమ ఆశ్రయం.
verses.en_meaning: Praised by the three Samas; singer of the Sama; the Sama itself; supreme bliss; the medicine; the physician; who ordained renunciation; the calm; the peaceful; the ground of all; peace; the supreme resort.
verses.words: Trisāmā (Praised by the singers of the Sama Veda through the three sacred chants.); Sāmagaḥ (The singer and subject of the sweet melodic hymns of the Sama Veda.); Sāma (The Sama Veda itself, sweet and auspicious in sound and spiritual meaning.); Nirvāṇaṁ (The supreme state of liberation, free from all sorrow and material agitation.); Bheṣajaṁ (The celestial Medicine that completely eradicates the disease of cycle of rebirth.); Bhiṣak (The supreme Physician who imparts the knowledge that cures ignorance.); Saṁnyāsakṛt (The author and institutor of the sacred order of renunciation (Sannyasa).); Samaḥ (The tranquil Lord who teaches internal peace and restraint of the mind.); Sāntaḥ (Ever serene, peaceful, and untouched by anger or passion.); Niṣṭhā (The supreme Abode of steadfast focus and dedication during meditation.); Śāntiḥ (The embodiment of supreme cosmic and spiritual peace.); Parāyaṇam (The ultimate Refuge and highest goal of all righteous souls.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 63
verses.te_meaning: అందమైన రూపం గలవాడు; శాంతిని ఇచ్చేవాడు; సృష్టికర్త; భూమిలో ఆనందించేవాడు; నీటిపై పడుకునేవాడు; భూమికి (గోవులకు) మేలు చేసేవాడు; భూమికి ప్రభువు, రక్షకుడు; కోరికలు కురిపించే కళ్ళు గలవాడు; ధర్మాన్ని ప్రేమించేవాడు.
verses.en_meaning: Of beautiful form; giver of peace; the creator; who delights in the earth; who reclines on the waters; benefactor of the earth (or cows); Lord and protector of the earth; whose eyes rain fulfilment; lover of dharma.
verses.words: Śubhāṅgaḥ (Possessing limbs of pure beauty, grace, and auspiciousness.); Śāntidaḥ (The bestower of profound peace of mind and liberation upon devotees.); Sraṣṭā (The Creator who brings forth all worlds from Himself at the beginning of creation.); Kumudaḥ (He who delights in the Earth and makes the virtuous rejoice like night-blooming lotuses.); Kuvaleśayaḥ (He who reclines upon the waters encircling the Earth as the cosmic sustainer.); Gōhitaḥ (The supreme benefactor and protector of cows, the Earth, and Vedic speech.); Gōpatiḥ (The Master and Lord of the Earth and the cosmic senses.); Gōptā (The constant Protector who guards all living beings from downfall.); Vṛṣabhākṣaḥ (He whose compassionate eyes shower righteousness and blessings on the world.); Vrushapriyaḥ (He who loves Dharma and holds dear those who practice righteousness.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 64
verses.te_meaning: (ధర్మం నుండి) వెనుదిరగనివాడు; లోకం నుండి వెనుదిరిగిన ఆత్మ గలవాడు; (విశ్వాన్ని) సంకోచింపజేసేవాడు; మేలు చేసేవాడు; శివుడు (శుభుడు); వక్షంపై శ్రీవత్సం గలవాడు; లక్ష్మికి నివాసం; లక్ష్మీపతి; శ్రీమంతులలో శ్రేష్ఠుడు.
verses.en_meaning: Never turning back (from dharma); of world-withdrawn Self; the contractor (of the universe); doer of good; the auspicious; who bears the Srivatsa on His chest; abode of Lakshmi; Lord of Lakshmi; best of the glorious.
verses.words: Anivartī (He who never retreats in battle against evil and never turns away a surrendered soul.); Nivṛttātmā (Untouched by material desires, ever absorbed in His own transcendent bliss.); Saṁkṣeptā (He who condenses and withdraws the expansive universe during dissolution.); Kṣemakṛt (He who protects what has been acquired and grants well-being (Kshema) to devotees.); Śivaḥ (The supreme Auspiciousness, conferring eternal bliss on all who remember Him.); Śrīvatsavakṣāḥ (Bearing the auspicious mark of Shrivatsa upon His divine chest, symbolizing Goddess Lakshmi's presence.); Śrīvāsaḥ (The eternal Abode in whom Goddess Lakshmi resides constantly with immense delight.); Śrīpatiḥ (The divine Consort, Master, and Lord of Goddess Lakshmi.); Śrīmatāṁ-varaḥ (The foremost and supreme among all glorious and blessed beings in creation.); Śrīdaḥ (The generous bestower of spiritual and material prosperity upon His devotees.); Śrīśaḥ (The supreme Lord and sovereign Ruler over Goddess Lakshmi Herself.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 65
verses.te_meaning: సంపదను ఇచ్చేవాడు; లక్ష్మీపతి; లక్ష్మికి నివాసం; శ్రీకి నిధి; భాగ్యాలను పంచేవాడు; లక్ష్మిని ధరించేవాడు; సంపదను సృష్టించేవాడు; పరమ శ్రేయస్సు; శ్రీమంతుడు; మూడు లోకాలకు ఆశ్రయం.
verses.en_meaning: Giver of prosperity; Lord of Lakshmi; abode of Lakshmi; treasury of glory; distributor of fortunes; bearer of Lakshmi; maker of prosperity; the supreme good; the glorious; refuge of the three worlds.
verses.words: Śrīnivāsaḥ (He in whose pure heart and chest Goddess Lakshmi abides eternally.); Śrīnidhiḥ (The inexhaustible treasure-house of all divine glory, auspiciousness, and spiritual beauty.); Śrīvibhāvanaḥ (The creator, distributor, and regulator of all prosperity and auspicious fortunes.); Śrīdharaḥ (He who carries Goddess Lakshmi on His sacred chest and bears the splendor of all worlds.); Śrīkaraḥ (He who bestows auspiciousness, divine grace, and spiritual elevation on all who remember Him.); Śreyaḥ (The supreme Good, representing the highest attainable goal of liberation (Moksha).); Śrīmān (Possessing all divine auspicious qualities, beauty, and majesty in absolute perfection.); Lōkatrayāśrayaḥ (The supreme Refuge and sole foundation supporting the three cosmic worlds.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 66
verses.te_meaning: అందమైన కళ్ళు గలవాడు; అందమైన అవయవాలు గలవాడు; అనంతమైన ఆనందం గలవాడు; ఆనందమే తానైనవాడు; జ్యోతి గణాలకు ప్రభువు; మనసును జయించినవాడు; ఎవరికీ లొంగని ఆత్మ గలవాడు; సత్యమైన కీర్తి గలవాడు; సందేహాలు తెగిపోయినవాడు.
verses.en_meaning: Of beautiful eyes; of graceful limbs; of infinite bliss; the very bliss; Lord of the luminous hosts; who has conquered the mind; whose Self is subject to none; of true renown; whose doubts are severed.
verses.words: Svakṣaḥ (Possessing radiant, beautiful divine eyes that gaze with boundless grace upon devotees.); Svaṅgaḥ (Endowed with perfectly proportioned, beautiful transcendental limbs of pure bliss.); Śatānandaḥ (Experiencing and bestowing hundreds and thousands of varieties of spiritual joy.); Nandiḥ (The embodiment of boundless divine delight, gladdening the hearts of devotees.); Jyōtir-gaṇeśvaraḥ (The supreme Lord and controller of the celestial hosts of stars, suns, and luminaries.); Vijitātmā (He whose nature is fully self-mastered and independent of all external influences.); Vidheyātmā (Subject to no higher authority or command, being the sovereign Lord of all.); Satkīrtiḥ (Possessing pure, untainted, and eternal renown throughout all the scriptures.); Chinna-saṁśayaḥ (He who possesses direct, doubt-free knowledge and dispels all doubts in the minds of devotees.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 67
verses.te_meaning: అతీతుడు; అంతటా కన్నులు గలవాడు; తనకు యజమాని లేనివాడు; ఎప్పుడూ స్థిరుడు; భూమిపై (సముద్రంపై) పడుకునేవాడు; ఆభరణం; ఉనికియే తానైనవాడు; శోకం లేనివాడు; శోకాన్ని పోగొట్టేవాడు.
verses.en_meaning: The transcendent; the eye everywhere; who has no master; the eternally steady; who reclines on the earth (or ocean); the ornament; the very being; free from sorrow; destroyer of sorrow.
verses.words: Udīrṇaḥ (Exalted high above all created entities in majesty, power, and glory.); Sarvataḥ-cakṣuḥ (Having eyes on all sides, perceiving all things in every corner of creation.); Anīśaḥ (Having no superior or master above Him (Na vidyate isho yasya).); Śāśvata-sthiraḥ (Eternally steadfast, unwavering, and constant in His divine perfection.); Bhūśayaḥ (Resting upon the shore of the ocean (as Sri Rama) and sustaining the Earth.); Bhūṣaṇaḥ (Adorning the entire universe with His beauty while Himself needing no external ornament.); Bhūtiḥ (The embodiment of all cosmic glory, existence, and spiritual wealth.); Viśōkaḥ (Free from all grief, sorrow, and mental anguish, ever radiant in supreme bliss.); Śōkanāśanaḥ (The compassionate destroyer of the sorrows and suffering of all surrendered souls.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 68
verses.te_meaning: ప్రకాశించేవాడు; పూజించబడేవాడు; (అన్నిటినీ) కలిగి ఉన్న పాత్ర; పరిశుద్ధమైన ఆత్మ గలవాడు; పవిత్రం చేసేవాడు; అనిరుద్ధుడు (ఎవరూ అడ్డుకోలేనివాడు); సాటిలేని యోధుడు; ప్రద్యుమ్నుడు; కొలవలేని పరాక్రమం గలవాడు.
verses.en_meaning: The radiant; the worshipped; the vessel (containing all); of pure Self; the purifier; the unobstructed (vyuha Aniruddha); the unrivalled warrior; the vyuha Pradyumna; of measureless valour.
verses.words: Arciṣmān (Radiating brilliant rays of divine light, adored by all seekers through sacred hymns.); Arcitaḥ (Reverently worshipped by Brahma, Shiva, Indra, and all enlightened sages.); Kumbhaḥ (The sacred vessel containing all cosmic elements and nectar of liberation.); Viśuddhātmā (Immaculately pure in His transcendental essence, untouched by material gunas.); Viśōdhanaḥ (The supreme Purifier who cleanses the minds of devotees of all past karmic impressions.); Aniruddhaḥ (He who can never be restrained, blocked, or resisted by any force in creation.); Aprati-rathaḥ (Having no rival warrior capable of standing against Him in cosmic battle.); Pradyumnaḥ (Endowed with supreme, boundless wealth and illumination (Prakrishta-dyumna).); Amitavikramaḥ (Possessing boundless, measureless prowess and divine strength.); Kālanemi-nihā (The slayer of the demon Kalanemi, destroying the wheel of time's tribulations for devotees.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 69
verses.te_meaning: కాలనేమిని సంహరించినవాడు; వీరుడు; శూరుని కుమారుడు; వీరులకు ప్రభువు; మూడు లోకాలకు ఆత్మ; మూడు లోకాలకు ప్రభువు; కేశవుడు; కేశి రాక్షసుని సంహరించినవాడు; హరి (దుఃఖాన్ని హరించేవాడు).
verses.en_meaning: Slayer of Kalanemi; the hero; son of Shura; Lord of the valiant; Self of the three worlds; Lord of the three worlds; Keshava; slayer of the demon Keshi; Hari (remover of sorrow).
verses.words: Viraḥ (The valiant Hero who upholds truth and righteousness effortlessly.); Śauriḥ (Born in the heroic Shura lineage as Sri Krishna, endowed with supreme prowess.); Śūrajaneśvaraḥ (The supreme Lord and Master of all valiant and noble heroes.); Trilōkātmā (The Inner Soul and animating presence pervading the three cosmic realms.); Trilōkeśaḥ (The sovereign Ruler and protector of the three worlds.); Keśavaḥ (The Lord of Brahma and Rudra, radiating luminous rays and slayer of Keshi.); Keśihā (The heroic slayer of the horse-demon Keshi in Vrindavan.); Hariḥ (He who takes away (Harati) all sins, sorrows, and material attachments of devotees.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 70
verses.te_meaning: కోరిన దేవుడు; కోరికలను రక్షించేవాడు; కోరికలు నెరవేరినవాడు; మనోహరుడు; శాస్త్రాలను రచించినవాడు; వర్ణించలేని రూపం గలవాడు; అంతటా వ్యాపించినవాడు; వీరుడు; అనంతుడు; ధనాన్ని గెలిచినవాడు (అర్జునుడు).
verses.en_meaning: The desired God; protector of desires; the fulfilled; the lovely; author of the scriptures; of indefinable form; the all-pervading; the hero; the infinite; winner of wealth (Arjuna).
verses.words: Kāmadevaḥ (The beloved Deity of desire whom all righteous souls desire for liberation.); Kāmapālaḥ (The protector and fulfiller of the pure spiritual aspirations of His devotees.); Kāmī (He who possesses all fulfilled desires within Himself, ever satisfied.); Kāntaḥ (Supremely handsome and enchanting, attracting the hearts of all beings.); Kṛtāgamaḥ (The divine Author of the sacred Vedic scriptures and Agamas.); Anirdeśya-vapuḥ (Possessing a transcendental form that exceeds finite worldly definitions.); Viṣṇuḥ (The all-pervading Supreme Lord who enters all beings and worlds.); Vīraḥ (Endowed with matchless courage, vanquishing demonic ignorance.); Anantaḥ (Boundless, infinite in time, space, forms, and auspicious virtues.); Dhanañjayaḥ (The conqueror of all true wealth and the indwelling guide of Arjuna.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 71
verses.te_meaning: వేదాలకు, ధార్మికులకు మిత్రుడు; బ్రహ్మను (ధర్మాన్ని) సృష్టించేవాడు; బ్రహ్మ; బ్రహ్మమే తానైనవాడు; వేదాలను వృద్ధి చేసేవాడు; వేదం తెలిసినవాడు; బ్రాహ్మణుడు; బ్రహ్మజ్ఞానం గలవాడు; బ్రహ్మాన్ని తెలిసినవాడు; బ్రాహ్మణులకు ప్రియుడు.
verses.en_meaning: Friend of the Vedas and the pious; maker of Brahman (dharma); the creator; Brahman itself; increaser of the Vedas; knower of the Veda; the Brahmana; possessor of Brahman; knower of Brahman; dear to the Brahmanas.
verses.words: Brahmaṇyaḥ (The protector and benefactor of seekers of Brahman, the Vedas, and virtuous brahmanas.); Brahmakṛt (The creator of the Vedas, spiritual tapas, and cosmic knowledge.); Brahmā (The great and vast Supreme Being (Brihattvat Brahma) endowed with infinite perfection.); Brahma (The ultimate Reality declared throughout the Upanishads and sacred scriptures.); Brahma-vivardhanaḥ (He who increases and fosters Vedic wisdom, spiritual practice, and devotion.); Brahmavid (The supreme knower of the Vedas and the ultimate reality of Brahman in full.); Brāhmaṇaḥ (He who reveals the sacred Vedic knowledge and guides souls in spiritual wisdom.); Brahmī (Possessor of the sacred wisdom of Brahman, ever abiding in His own glory.); Brahmajñaḥ (He who knows the true inner purport of all sacred scriptures perfectly.); Brāhmaṇapriyaḥ (He who holds dear the devoted seekers of sacred wisdom and is beloved by them.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 72
verses.te_meaning: గొప్ప అడుగులు గలవాడు; గొప్ప పనులు చేసేవాడు; గొప్ప తేజస్సు గలవాడు; మహా సర్పం (అనంతుడు); మహా క్రతువు; మహా యజ్ఞకర్త; మహా యజ్ఞం; మహా హవిస్సు.
verses.en_meaning: Of mighty stride; of mighty works; of great splendour; the great serpent (Ananta); the great sacrifice; the great sacrificer; the great yajna; the great oblation.
verses.words: Mahākramaḥ (Endowed with vast, cosmic strides that span the entire universe (Trivikrama).); Mahākarmā (Performer of colossal, wondrous cosmic deeds beyond mortal imagination.); Mahātejāḥ (Possessing supreme, blinding divine luster and irresistible spiritual energy.); Mahoragaḥ (The great divine Serpent (Adisesha) on whom the Lord reclines, or the Lord Himself as the great cosmic support.); Mahākratuḥ (The greatest of all sacred sacrifices, bestowing the highest fruit of liberation.); Mahāyajvā (The supreme Sacrificer who performs cosmic sacrifices for the welfare of all creation.); Mahāyajñaḥ (The supreme Object and essence of all grand Vedic sacrifices (Yajna).); Mahāhaviḥ (The supreme Sacrificial Oblation that purifies and satisfies the cosmos.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 73
deva: स्तव्यः स्तवप्रियः स्तोत्रं स्तुतिः स्तोता रणप्रियः।
te: స్తవ్యః స్తవప్రియః స్తోత్రం స్తుతిః స్తోతా రణప్రియః ।
iast: stavyaḥ stavapriyaḥ stotraṃ stutiḥ stotā raṇapriyaḥ |
verses.te_meaning: స్తుతించదగినవాడు; స్తుతి అంటే ఇష్టపడేవాడు; స్తోత్రం; స్తుతి; స్తుతించేవాడు; (రక్షణ కోసం) యుద్ధాన్ని ఇష్టపడేవాడు; సంపూర్ణుడు; పూర్తి చేసేవాడు; పవిత్రుడు; పవిత్రమైన కీర్తి గలవాడు; రోగం లేనివాడు.
verses.en_meaning: Worthy of praise; fond of praise; the hymn; the praise; the praiser; fond of battle (for protection); the full; the fulfiller; the holy; of sacred fame; free from disease.
verses.words: Stavyaḥ (The supreme Object worthy of being praised and glorified by all beings.); Stava-priyaḥ (Delighted by sincere, loving hymns of praise and prayers offered by devotees.); Stotraṁ (The sacred hymn of praise itself, personifying all divine eulogy.); Stutiḥ (Eternally glorified and sung by all sages, scriptures, and celestials.); Stōtā (He who praises and uplifts the noble virtues of His sincere devotees.); Raṇapriyaḥ (Fond of righteous battle against evil forces to establish Dharma and protect the good.); Pūrṇaḥ (Completely full, perfect, and overflowing with infinite auspicious qualities.); Pūrayitā (He who completely fulfills the spiritual needs and longings of His devotees.); Puṇyaḥ (Supremely holy and virtuous, purifying all who contemplate His divine name.); Puṇyakīrtiḥ (Possessing sacred fame, hearing or chanting which cleanses souls of all sins.); Anāmayaḥ (Completely free from any disease, affliction, or sorrow, ever healthy in pure bliss.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 74
verses.te_meaning: మనసంత వేగం గలవాడు; (జ్ఞానమనే) పుణ్య తీర్థాలను సృష్టించేవాడు; బంగారు సారం గలవాడు; ధనాన్ని ఇచ్చేవాడు; మోక్షమనే సంపదను ఇచ్చేవాడు; వాసుదేవుడు; నివాసం; మంచి మనసు గలవాడు; హవిస్సు.
verses.en_meaning: Swift as the mind; maker of the holy fords (of knowledge); of golden essence; giver of wealth; giver of the wealth of liberation; Vasudeva; the abode; of noble mind; the oblation.
verses.words: Manōjavaḥ (Swift as the speed of thought, arriving instantaneously to rescue devotees in distress.); Tīrthakaraḥ (The creator of sacred pilgrimage places (Tirthas) and the revealer of sacred knowledge.); Vasu-retāḥ (Possessing a luminous, golden creative potency from which the cosmos arises.); Vasupradaḥ (The generous giver of true wealth, spiritual illumination, and liberation.); Vasupradaḥ (Bestower of the supreme spiritual treasure of devotion and divine grace.); Vāsudevaḥ (The all-pervading Lord in whom all beings dwell, who sports in divine bliss.); Vasuḥ (The supreme Dwelling place and the ultimate spiritual Treasure of the cosmos.); Vasumanaḥ (Possessing a mind that is supremely pure, peaceful, and filled with benevolence.); Haviḥ (The sacred sacrificial offering accepted with grace by the Lord in all rituals.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 75
verses.te_meaning: సజ్జనులకు ఆశ్రయం; మంచి పనులు చేసేవాడు; శుద్ధమైన ఉనికి; సత్యమైన కీర్తి; సజ్జనులకు పరమ గమ్యం; వీరమైన సైన్యాలు గలవాడు; యాదవులలో శ్రేష్ఠుడు; సజ్జనులకు నివాసం; యమునా తీర పవిత్రులచే సేవించబడేవాడు.
verses.en_meaning: The refuge of the good; of noble deeds; pure existence; true glory; supreme goal of the good; of heroic armies; foremost of the Yadus; abode of the good; attended by the holy ones of the Yamuna.
verses.words: Sadgatiḥ (The supreme Destination, Refuge, and Goal of all virtuous and truthful souls.); Satkṛtiḥ (The performer of supreme righteous deeds that sustain and elevate creation.); Sattā (The ultimate Reality whose self-existence sustains the existence of everything else.); Sad-bhūtiḥ (The embodiment of true transcendental existence, wisdom, and glory.); Satparāyaṇaḥ (The supreme supreme Goal and refuge of all righteous seekers of truth.); Śūrasenaḥ (Surrounded by a heroic, invincible army of devotees and celestial guardians.); Yaduśreṣṭhaḥ (The foremost and greatest among the Yadu dynasty as Sri Krishna.); Sannivāsaḥ (The sacred Abode where all saintly, righteous devotees find eternal shelter.); Suyāmunaḥ (Surrounded by the auspicious waters and pastoral beauty of the Yamuna in Vrindavan.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 76
verses.te_meaning: జీవులకు నివాస స్థానం; వాసుదేవుడు; అన్ని ప్రాణాలకు నివాసం; అపారమైన శక్తి గలవాడు; (దుష్టుల) గర్వాన్ని అణచేవాడు; (సజ్జనులకు) గౌరవాన్ని ఇచ్చేవాడు; ఎప్పుడూ తృప్తుడు; పట్టుకోలేనివాడు; ఓటమి లేనివాడు.
verses.en_meaning: Dwelling-place of beings; Vasudeva; abode of all life-breaths; of boundless power; destroyer of pride (in the wicked); giver of noble pride (to the good); the ever-content; hard to hold; the unvanquished.
verses.words: Bhūtāvāsaḥ (The universal Dwelling place in whom all created beings live and move.); Vāsudevaḥ (The supreme Lord who covers and shelters all beings with His divine light.); Sarvāsunilayaḥ (The dwelling place and sustainer of the vital breath (Asu/Prana) of all living entities.); Analaḥ (Possessing boundless energy and strength, whose glory is without any limit.); Darpahā (The destroyer of the arrogance, ego, and pride of the wicked.); Darpadaḥ (Bestower of righteous pride, strength, and spiritual confidence upon the virtuous.); Dṛptaḥ (Ever rejoicing in the contemplation of His own infinite, supreme bliss.); Durdharaḥ (Difficult to hold in the mind without pure, focused meditation and unswerving devotion.); Aparājitaḥ (The unconquered One who has never known defeat in any cosmic realm.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 77
verses.te_meaning: విశ్వమే రూపంగా గలవాడు; విశాల రూపుడు; ప్రకాశించే రూపం గలవాడు; రూపం లేనివాడు; అనేక రూపాలవాడు; అవ్యక్తుడు; వంద రూపాలవాడు; వంద ముఖాలవాడు.
verses.en_meaning: Of universal form; of vast form; of luminous form; the formless; of manifold forms; the unmanifest; of a hundred forms; of a hundred faces.
verses.words: Viśvamūrtiḥ (He whose divine form encompasses the entire universe (Visvarupa).); Mahāmūrtiḥ (Possessing a colossal, magnificent transcendental form of supreme majesty.); Dīptamūrtiḥ (Radiating blazing, self-luminous transcendental light of pure consciousness.); Amūrtimān (Free from any material, karma-generated form (having a form of pure bliss).); Anekamūrtiḥ (Manifesting in countless divine forms while remaining one unfragmented Lord.); Avyaktaḥ (Unmanifest to mortal physical eyes, perceptible through spiritual realization.); Śatamūrtiḥ (Manifesting in hundreds of divine avataric forms for cosmic protection.); Śatānanaḥ (Having hundreds of faces in His cosmic form, gazing in all directions.); Ekaḥ (The peerless, unique One Supreme Lord without any equal or second.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 78
deva: एको नैकः सवः कः किं यत् तत्पदमनुत्तमम्।
te: ఏకో నైకః సవః కః కిం యత్ తత్-పదమనుత్తమమ్ ।
iast: eko naikaḥ savaḥ kaḥ kiṃ yat tat padam anuttamam |
verses.te_meaning: ఒక్కడు; అనేకులు; యజ్ఞం; ఆనందం; ఎప్పుడూ ప్రశ్నించబడేవాడు; “తత్” (బ్రహ్మం); సాటిలేని స్థానం; లోకానికి బంధువు; లోకనాథుడు; మాధవుడు; భక్తులను ప్రేమించేవాడు.
verses.en_meaning: The one; the many; the sacrifice; the bliss; the ever-questioned; the "that" (Brahman); the unsurpassed state; friend of the world; Lord of the world; Madhava; loving to His devotees.
verses.words: Naikaḥ (Manifesting as manifold Avataras and residing in all hearts without losing unity.); Savaḥ (The essence of the sacred Soma sacrifice in which celestial nectar is generated.); Kaḥ (The embodiment of supreme spiritual joy and happiness (Ka = Sukha).); Kim (The supreme Object of inquiry, investigated by all philosophers and scriptures.); Yat (The self-evident Supreme Reality referred to by the pronoun 'That' in Vedic texts.); Tat (The supreme Brahman indicated as 'Tat' (That) who expands and sustains all.); Padamanuttamam (The supreme, incomparable Status and Abode attained by the enlightened.); Lokabandhuḥ (The true, eternal Friend and relative of all beings across all worlds.); Lokanāthah (The sovereign Protector and Master of all the worlds.); Mādhavaḥ (The beloved consort of Goddess Lakshmi and the Lord of spiritual wisdom.); Bhaktavatsalaḥ (Overflowing with parental love, compassion, and tenderness toward His devotees.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 79
iast: vīrahā viṣamaḥ śūnyo ghṛtāśīr acalaś calaḥ.
verses.te_meaning: బంగారు వర్ణం గలవాడు; బంగారు అవయవాలు గలవాడు; అందమైన రూపం గలవాడు; గంధపు భుజకీర్తులు ధరించినవాడు; శత్రువులను చంపేవాడు; సాటిలేనివాడు; (గుణాలు) శూన్యమైనవాడు; ఆశ లేనివాడు; కదలనివాడు, కదిలేవాడు.
verses.en_meaning: Of golden hue; of golden limbs; of beautiful form; adorned with sandal armlets; slayer of foes; the incomparable; the void (of qualities); free from craving; the unmoving and the moving.
verses.words: Suvarṇavarṇaḥ (Possessing a brilliant, radiant golden transcendental complexion.); Hemāṅgaḥ (Having beautiful divine limbs that shine with the luster of molten gold.); Varāṅgaḥ (Endowed with supremely exquisite, auspicious, and charming divine limbs.); Candanāṅgadī (Adorned with fragrant sandalwood paste and glowing celestial armlets.); Vīrahā (The heroic destroyer of demonic ignorance, passion, and vice.); Viṣamaḥ (Incomparable One, having no equal or parallel in all the cosmic realms.); Śūnyaḥ (Completely devoid of all material defects, flaws, and worldly limitations (Nirdosha).); Ghṛtāśīḥ (Receiving pure ghee offerings in sacred Vedic sacrifices with pleasure.); Acalaḥ (Completely immovable, steadfast, and unswerving in His nature and protection.); Calaḥ (Moving swiftly as the life-force and breeze to protect devotees in need.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 80
verses.te_meaning: గర్వం లేనివాడు; ఆత్మగౌరవాన్ని ఇచ్చేవాడు; గౌరవించదగినవాడు; లోకాలకు ప్రభువు; మూడు లోకాలను ధరించేవాడు; మంచి బుద్ధి గలవాడు; యజ్ఞం నుండి పుట్టినవాడు; ధన్యుడు; సత్యమైన జ్ఞానం గలవాడు; భూమిని ధరించేవాడు.
verses.en_meaning: Free from pride; giver of self-regard; the honoured; Lord of the worlds; upholder of the three worlds; of noble intellect; born of sacrifice; the blessed; of true wisdom; upholder of the earth.
verses.words: Amānī (Free from all material pride and false ego, ever humble in His divine greatness.); Mānadaḥ (Bestower of honor, dignity, and spiritual respect upon all sincere devotees.); Mānyaḥ (Worthy of the highest honor, adoration, and worship from all beings.); Lokasvāmī (The supreme Owner, Sovereign, and Ruler of all cosmic worlds.); Trilokadhṛt (The supreme Supporter who upholds and sustains the three worlds.); Sumedhāḥ (Possessing supremely pure, brilliant, and auspicious divine intelligence.); Medhajaḥ (Manifested in the sacred fire of Vedic sacrifices (Yajna).); Dhanyaḥ (Full of all auspicious blessings, fortunate, and fulfilling the purpose of all seekers.); Satyamedhāḥ (Endowed with infallible intelligence and wisdom rooted purely in eternal truth.); Dharādharaḥ (The mighty upholder of the Earth and the lifter of the Govardhana mountain.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 81
verses.te_meaning: తేజస్సును కురిపించేవాడు; తేజస్సును ధరించేవాడు; ఆయుధాలు ధరించేవారిలో శ్రేష్ఠుడు; (భక్తిని) స్వీకరించేవాడు; నియంత్రించేవాడు; (భక్తులపై) ఎప్పుడూ శ్రద్ధ గలవాడు; అనేక కొమ్ములు (రూపాలు) గలవాడు; గదునికి అన్న.
verses.en_meaning: Who showers radiance; bearer of splendour; best of all who bear arms; the acceptor (of devotion); the controller; ever-intent (on devotees); of many horns (forms); the elder brother of Gada.
verses.words: Tejōvṛṣaḥ (He who showers radiant light, energy, and rain across the cosmos through the Sun.); Dyutidharaḥ (Possessing majestic, glowing effulgence that radiates throughout creation.); Sarva-śastra-bhṛtāṁ varaḥ (The foremost and most skilled among all who wield divine weapons in defense of Dharma.); Pragrahaḥ (He who reins in the senses of devotees and grasps their loving offerings with grace.); Nigrahaḥ (The supreme Controller who restrains the senses and subdues all demonic impulses.); Vyagraḥ (Ever intent and actively engaged in fulfilling the welfare of His devotees.); Naikaśṛṅgaḥ (Having multiple divine horns (in Varaha/Matsya Avataras) representing the four Vedas and goals of life.); Gadāgrajaḥ (The elder brother of Gada (Sri Krishna) and the Lord who is invoked through sacred mantras (Gada).)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 82
verses.te_meaning: నాలుగు మూర్తులవాడు; నాలుగు చేతులవాడు; నాలుగు వ్యూహాలవాడు; నాలుగు విధాల గమ్యం; నాలుగు విధాల ఆత్మ; నాలుగు పురుషార్థాలకు మూలం; నాలుగు వేదాలు తెలిసినవాడు; ఒకే పాదం గలవాడు (అతీతుడు).
verses.en_meaning: Of four forms; four-armed; of four vyuhas; the fourfold goal; of fourfold Self; source of the four aims; knower of the four Vedas; of a single foot (transcendent).
verses.words: Caturmūrtiḥ (Manifesting as the four transcendental forms: Vasudeva, Sankarshana, Pradyumna, and Aniruddha.); Caturbāhuḥ (Possessing four graceful transcendental arms wielding the emblems of protection and liberation.); Caturvyūhaḥ (Manifesting in four cosmic emanations for creation, sustenance, destruction, and spiritual awakening.); Caturgatiḥ (The ultimate destination and guide for seekers in the four stages and orders of life.); Caturātmā (The Inner Controller of the four faculties of consciousness (Manas, Buddhi, Ahankara, Chitta).); Caturbhāvaḥ (The divine source from whom the four goals of human life (Dharma, Artha, Kama, Moksha) proceed.); Catur-vedavid (The perfect knower and revealer of the complete inner meaning of the four Vedas.); Ekapāt (The universe is but a fraction (single quarter) of His infinite cosmic majesty.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 83
verses.te_meaning: (చక్రాన్ని) సమర్థంగా తిప్పేవాడు; వ్యర్థం కాని ఆత్మ గలవాడు; జయించలేనివాడు; అతిక్రమించలేనివాడు; పొందడానికి కష్టమైనవాడు; చేరడానికి కష్టమైనవాడు; (కోటను) దాటడానికి కష్టమైనవాడు; (హృదయంలో) నిలుపుకోవడానికి కష్టమైనవాడు; దుష్టులను సంహరించేవాడు.
verses.en_meaning: The efficient turner (of the wheel); of unfailing Self; hard to conquer; hard to transgress; hard to attain; hard to reach; hard to cross (the fort); hard to lodge (in the heart); slayer of the wicked.
verses.words: Samāvartaḥ (The master regulator who revolves the wheel of cosmic time and life with perfect justice.); Anivrutātmā (Ever independent, free from material entanglement and delusion.); Durjayaḥ (The invincible Conqueror who can never be defeated by any hostile force.); Duratikramaḥ (He whose divine laws and supreme commands cannot be transgressed by any being.); Durlabhaḥ (Rare and difficult to attain without unswerving, genuine devotion and divine grace.); Durgamaḥ (Inaccessible to proud intellectual speculation, reached only through heartfelt surrender.); Durgaḥ (The invincible Fortress protecting devotees from all spiritual dangers and worldly fear.); Durāvāsaḥ (Difficult to hold in meditation for minds disturbed by worldly passions.); Durārihā (The destroyer of evil asuras and the dispeller of inner spiritual vices.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 84
verses.te_meaning: శుభమైన అవయవాలు గలవాడు; లోకాల సారాన్ని గ్రహించేవాడు; (విశ్వమనే) సన్నని దారం; ఆ దారాన్ని పెంచేవాడు; ఇంద్రుని లాంటి పనులు చేసేవాడు; గొప్ప పనులు చేసేవాడు; అన్నీ సాధించినవాడు; శాస్త్రాలను రచించినవాడు.
verses.en_meaning: Of auspicious form; who draws the essence of the worlds; the fine thread (of the universe); increaser of that thread; whose deeds are like Indra’s; of great deeds; who has accomplished all; author of the scriptures.
verses.words: Śubhāṅgaḥ (Endowed with limbs of supreme beauty, auspiciousness, and spiritual grace.); Lōkasāraṅgaḥ (He who grasps the ultimate essence (Sara) of all the worlds and sacred scriptures.); Sutantuḥ (Weaving the cosmic web of creation through a beautiful, orderly thread of cosmic law.); Tantu-vardhanaḥ (He who expands and preserves the lineage of creation and the spiritual succession of devotees.); Indra-karmā (Performing majestic, noble, and heroic deeds worthy of the supreme King of kings.); Mahākarmā (The performer of great, inconceivable cosmic works of creation and protection.); Kṛtakarmā (He who has accomplished all cosmic tasks with eternal self-satisfaction.); Kṛtāgamaḥ (The author of the revealed scriptures (Vedas and Pancharatra) which establish truth.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 85
iast: arko vājasanaḥ śṛṅgī jayantaḥ sarvavij jayī.
verses.te_meaning: (అన్నిటికీ) మూలం; అందమైనవాడు; సుకుమారుడు; రత్నం లాంటి నాభి గలవాడు; అందమైన కళ్ళు గలవాడు; పూజించదగినవాడు; అన్నం ఇచ్చేవాడు; కొమ్ము గలవాడు (మత్స్యం); విజయుడు; అన్నీ తెలిసిన జేత.
verses.en_meaning: The source (of all); the beautiful; the tender; of jewel-navel; of beautiful eyes; worthy of worship; giver of food; the horned (fish); the victorious; the all-knowing conqueror.
verses.words: Udbhavaḥ (The divine source from which the spiritual awakening and elevation of souls takes place.); Sundaraḥ (The supreme archetype of transcendental beauty, captivating the entire cosmos.); Sundaḥ (Full of profound mercy and tenderness, melting with compassion for His devotees.); Ratna-nābhaḥ (Possessing a navel as radiant and precious as the most luminous cosmic gem.); Sulōcanaḥ (Having charming, compassionate eyes that shower grace upon all who look toward Him.); Arkaḥ (The supreme Object of worship adored by all great sages and celestial gods.); Vājasanaḥ (The generous provider of food, sustenance, and spiritual nourishment (Vaja) to all.); Śṛṅgī (Bearing the mighty divine horn as Matsya and Varaha Avataras to rescue the world.); Jayantaḥ (The ultimate cause of triumph who ensures the victory of righteousness.); Sarvavijjayī (The all-knowing Conqueror who knows all reality and triumphs over all opposition.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 86
verses.te_meaning: బంగారు అవయవాలు గలవాడు (లేదా ఓంకారం); కదిలించలేనివాడు; వాక్పతులందరికీ ప్రభువు; (ఆనందమనే) మహా సరస్సు; మహా లోతు; మహాభూతం; మహా నిధి.
verses.en_meaning: Of golden limbs (or the syllable Om); the unshakable; Lord of all masters of speech; the great lake (of bliss); the great abyss; the great being; the great treasure-house.
verses.words: Suvarṇabinduḥ (Possessing beautiful golden limbs and revealed through the auspicious golden letters of the Vedas.); Akṣobhyaḥ (Unshakable and serene, never perturbed by any cosmic turmoil or demonic challenge.); Sarva-vāgīśvareśvaraḥ (The supreme Master and Lord over all masters of speech and learning (like Brahma and Brihaspati).); Mahāhradaḥ (The vast, deep reservoir of infinite spiritual nectar in which realized souls bathe in bliss.); Mahāgartaḥ (The unfathomably vast chasm into which the entire created universe dissolves at Pralaya.); Mahābhūtaḥ (The great Supreme Being who is independent of all material limitations and time.); Mahānidhiḥ (The supreme Treasury in whom all cosmic wealth, knowledge, and souls find shelter.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 87
verses.te_meaning: భూమిలో ఆనందించేవాడు; (మల్లె పువ్వులా) ఇచ్చేవాడు; తెల్లనివాడు; వర్షించే మేఘం; పవిత్రం చేసేవాడు; ఊపిరి అవసరం లేనివాడు; అమృతమే భాగంగా గలవాడు; అమృత రూపుడు; సర్వజ్ఞుడు; అన్ని వైపులా ముఖాలు గలవాడు.
verses.en_meaning: Who delights in the earth; the giver (as the jasmine); pure white; the rain-cloud; the purifier; without need of breath; whose portion is the nectar; of immortal form; the omniscient; whose faces are everywhere.
verses.words: Kumudaḥ (He who gladdens the Earth and brings joy to the righteous as the moon gladdens lotuses.); Kundaraḥ (Pure as the white Kunda flower, bestowing the pure fruits of righteousness.); Kundaḥ (As lovely and spotless as the Kunda blossom, rewarding sacrifices with pure grace.); Parjanyaḥ (The celestial Rain-Cloud showering the nectar of grace, knowledge, and life upon all beings.); Pāvanaḥ (The supreme Sanctifier whose very remembrance purifies the heart and soul.); Anilaḥ (Self-sufficient One who requires no outside instigation (A-nila), ever free and independent.); Amṛtāśaḥ (He whose food is the immortal nectar of His own boundless bliss (Atmananda).); Amṛtavapuḥ (Possessing an eternal, immortal transcendental form made of pure consciousness and bliss.); Sarvajñaḥ (The omniscient Lord who has direct, flawless awareness of all things at all times.); Sarvatōmukhaḥ (Having faces in all directions in His cosmic form, observing and accepting all offerings.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 88
verses.te_meaning: (భక్తితో) సులభంగా దొరికేవాడు; మంచి వ్రతాలు గలవాడు; సిద్ధుడు; శత్రువులను జయించేవాడు; శత్రువులను తపింపజేసేవాడు; క్రిందికి దిగే మర్రి చెట్టు; ఆకాశాన్ని మించినవాడు (ఉదుంబరం); రావి చెట్టు (అశాశ్వత లోకం); చాణూర మల్లుని సంహరించినవాడు.
verses.en_meaning: Easily attained (by devotion); of noble vows; the accomplished; conqueror of foes; scorcher of foes; the down-covering banyan; beyond the sky (Udumbara); the peepal (impermanent world); slayer of the wrestler Chanura of the Andhras.
verses.words: Sulabhaḥ (Easily accessible and attained through sincere, unpretentious love and devotion (Bhakti).); Suvrataḥ (Dedicated to the noble, unswerving vow of protecting all who seek refuge in Him.); Siddhaḥ (Eternally accomplished, self-fulfilled, and never dependent on any external cause.); Śatrujit (The conqueror of all hostile forces, both external demons and internal spiritual vices.); Śatrutāpanaḥ (He who scorches and subdues the enemies of Dharma and righteousness with His divine power.); Nyagrodhaḥ (Spreading out like the sacred Banyan tree, providing cooling shelter to all souls.); Udumbaraḥ (Exalted high above the celestial heavens, nourishing the universe like the cosmic tree.); Aśvatthaḥ (The eternal cosmic Peepal tree of life, rooted in the Supreme and branching throughout the universe.); Cāṇūrāṁdhra-niṣūdanaḥ (The heroic slayer of the demonic wrestler Chanura in Mathura as Sri Krishna.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 89
verses.te_meaning: వేయి కిరణాలవాడు; ఏడు నాలుకలు (అగ్ని) గలవాడు; ఏడు జ్వాలలు గలవాడు; ఏడు గుర్రాల రథం గలవాడు (సూర్యుడు); రూపం లేనివాడు; పాపం లేనివాడు; ఊహించలేనివాడు; (దుష్టులకు) భయం కలిగించేవాడు, (సజ్జనుల) భయాన్ని పోగొట్టేవాడు.
verses.en_meaning: Of a thousand rays; of seven tongues (of fire); of seven flames; of the seven-horsed vehicle (the sun); the formless; the sinless; the inconceivable; who causes fear (to the wicked) and destroys fear (of the good).
verses.words: Sahasrārciḥ (Radiating thousands of brilliant transcendental rays of light that illuminate creation.); Sapta-jihvaḥ (The supreme Consumer who accepts offerings through the seven flames of the sacred fire.); Saptaidhāḥ (Kindled and glorified through the seven types of sacred fuels and sacred hymns.); Saptavāhanaḥ (Riding the chariot drawn by seven solar horses as the divine Inner Controller of the Sun.); Amūrtiḥ (Free from any material, physical form made of prakritic elements (possessing a form of pure bliss).); Anaghaḥ (Inconceivable to finite worldly intellects, understood truly only through divine revelation.); Achintyo (Stainless and immaculate, untouched by any sin, impurity, or sorrow.); Bhayakṛud (Striking righteous terror into the hearts of the wicked and demonic tyrants.); Bhaya-nāśanaḥ (The compassionate dispeller of all fear and anxiety for those who surrender unto Him.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 90
iast: aṇur bṛhat kṛśaḥ sthūlo guṇabhṛn nirguṇo mahān |
verses.te_meaning: అణువు; బృహత్తు; సూక్ష్ముడు; స్థూలుడు; గుణాలను ధరించేవాడు; అయినా గుణాలకు అతీతుడు; మహత్తు; ఆధారం లేనివాడు; తనకు తానే ఆధారం; అందమైన ముఖం గలవాడు; ప్రాచీన వంశం గలవాడు; వంశాన్ని వృద్ధి చేసేవాడు.
verses.en_meaning: The atomic; the vast; the subtle; the gross; bearer of the gunas; yet beyond the gunas; the great; the unsupported; self-supported; of goodly face; of ancient lineage; increaser of the lineage.
verses.words: Aṇuḥ (Subtler than the subtlest particle, dwelling within the innermost heart of every atom.); Bṛhat (Vaster than the vastest cosmos, encompassing the entire universe within His majesty.); Kṛśaḥ (Slender and subtle, unencumbered by any gross material heaviness.); Sthūlaḥ (Manifesting as the vast cosmic Virat-rupa that contains all planetary systems.); Guṇa-bhṛt (The independent Master who possesses and supports all infinite auspicious divine qualities (Gunas).); Nirguṇaḥ (Totally devoid of material, prakritic qualities (Sattva, Rajas, Tamas), ever transcendental.); Mahān (The Supreme Great One, peerless in glory, wisdom, bliss, and sovereignty.); Adhṛutaḥ (Self-supported and unheld by any external foundation, while holding everything.); Svadhṛtaḥ (Supported purely by His own independent divine energy and glory.); Svāsyaḥ (Having an exquisitely beautiful and gracious lotus face from which the Vedas emerged.); Prāgvaṁśaḥ (The primordial Origin and Ancestor preceding all cosmic dynasties and generations.); Vaṁśavardhanaḥ (He who expands and protects the cosmic family of creation and the lineage of devotees.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 91
verses.te_meaning: (భూమి) భారాన్ని మోసేవాడు; (వేదాలలో) చెప్పబడినవాడు; యోగి; యోగులకు ప్రభువు; అన్ని కోరికలు ఇచ్చేవాడు; విశ్రాంతి స్థానం; దుష్టులను అలసిపోయేలా చేసేవాడు; క్షయం లేనివాడు; మంచి రెక్కలవాడు; గాలి మోసుకెళ్ళేవాడు (గరుడుడు).
verses.en_meaning: Bearer of the burden (of the earth); the spoken-of (in the Vedas); the yogi; Lord of yogis; giver of all desires; the resting-place; who wearies the wicked; the imperishable; the fair-winged; borne by the wind (Garuda).
verses.words: Bhārabhṛt (He who bears the colossal weight of the universe and relieves the burdens of the Earth.); Kathitaḥ (Celebrated, recounted, and glorified as the supreme Subject throughout all scriptures.); Yogī (The supreme Master of Yoga, ever established in His own infinite divine consciousness.); Yogīśaḥ (The supreme Lord and Master of all great yogis, sages, and enlightened masters.); Sarva-kāmadaḥ (The benevolent granter of all righteous desires, spiritual wisdom, and ultimate liberation.); Āśramaḥ (The supreme Sanctuary and resting haven where all souls find peace from Samsara.); Śramaṇaḥ (He who makes the non-devoted labor in vain while bringing peace to the devoted.); Kṣāmaḥ (He who diminishes and consumes the universe at the end of the cosmic cycle.); Suparṇaḥ (Possessing beautiful golden wings of Vedic wisdom, carrying souls across the material ocean.); Vāyuvāhanaḥ (He who drives and commands the cosmic winds and the life-breath of all living entities.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 92
verses.te_meaning: విల్లు ధరించినవాడు (రాముడు); విలువిద్య తెలిసినవాడు; దండం (శిక్ష); అణచివేసేవాడు; నిగ్రహమే తానైనవాడు; ఓటమి లేనివాడు; అన్నిటినీ సహించేవాడు; నియమించేవాడు; ఏ నియమానికీ బంధించబడనివాడు; మృత్యువు తాకనివాడు.
verses.en_meaning: Wielder of the bow (Rama); knower of archery; the rod (of chastisement); the subduer; the very self-control; the unvanquished; bearer of all; the appointer; bound by no rule; and untouched by death.
verses.words: Dhanurdharaḥ (The supreme Archer wielding the divine bow Sharnga to defend Dharma (as Sri Rama).); Dhanurvedaḥ (The author and master of the sacred science of archery and martial righteousness.); Daṅḍaḥ (The embodiment of righteous punishment and cosmic justice subduing the wicked.); Damayitā (The supreme Discipliner and subduer of the arrogant tyrants across all realms.); Damaḥ (The self-restraint and inner peace attained through contemplation of His divine nature.); Aparājitaḥ (The eternally undefeated and invincible Lord whom no opposing force can ever conquer.); Sarvasahaḥ (Capable of bearing all things and patient with the failings of surrendered devotees.); Niyantā (The supreme Controller who assigns specific functions and laws to all cosmic forces.); Aniyamaḥ (The supreme cosmic Law and order governing the universe.); Ayamaḥ (The inner Ruler who regulates the actions and destinations of all souls from within.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 93
verses.te_meaning: సత్త్వ బలం గలవాడు; సత్త్వంలో స్థిరుడు; సత్యం; సత్యానికి, ధర్మానికి అంకితమైనవాడు; అందరూ కోరే గమ్యం; ప్రేమించదగినవాడు; పూజించదగినవాడు; ప్రియమైనది చేసేవాడు; ప్రేమను పెంచేవాడు.
verses.en_meaning: Full of strength (sattva); established in sattva; the truth; devoted to truth and dharma; the goal desired by all; worthy of love; worthy of worship; doer of what is dear; increaser of love.
verses.words: Satvavān (Endowed with absolute, pure spiritual existence (Shuddha-sattva), courage, and virtue.); Sāttvikaḥ (Embodying supreme goodness, truth, and purity, inspiring virtuous devotion in seekers.); Satyaḥ (The absolute Truth, ever faithful in His promises to protect the surrendered.); Satya-dharma-parāyaṇaḥ (Eternally devoted to truth and righteousness, delighting in those who uphold Dharma.); Abhiprāyaḥ (The supreme Object of desire sought by all enlightened seekers of liberation.); Priyārhaḥ (Supremely worthy of the highest love, adoration, and devotion from all souls.); Arhaḥ (Worthy of the highest worship, praise, and sacred offerings in all the worlds.); Priyakṛt (Ever performing what is genuinely dear, beneficial, and uplifting for His devotees.); Pritivardhanaḥ (Increasing the joyful love, devotion, and bliss in the hearts of His devotees.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 94
verses.te_meaning: ఆకాశమే మార్గంగా గలవాడు; జ్యోతి; మనోహరమైన కాంతి గలవాడు; హవిస్సును అనుభవించేవాడు; అంతటా వ్యాపించినవాడు; (నీటిని పైకి లాగే) సూర్యుడు; ప్రకాశించేవాడు; (కాంతికి మూలమైన) సూర్యుడు; ప్రేరేపించేవాడు; సూర్యుడే కన్నుగా గలవాడు.
verses.en_meaning: Whose path is the sky; the light; of lovely radiance; enjoyer of the oblation; the all-pervading; the sun (that draws up moisture); the shining; the sun (source of light); the impeller; whose eye is the sun.
verses.words: Vihāyasa-gatiḥ (Moving effortlessly through the celestial skies, and the supreme destination attained in the spiritual realm.); Jyotiḥ (The self-luminous supreme Light that illuminates all suns, stars, and minds.); Suruciḥ (Possessing supremely delightful, auspicious, and captivating transcendental radiance.); Hutabhuk (The enjoyer who accepts and consumes all oblations poured into the sacred sacrificial fires.); Vibhuḥ (The all-pervading, almighty Lord manifesting throughout the universe in limitless forms.); Raviḥ (The Sun who absorbs all juices and illumines the cosmos with divine splendor.); Virōcanaḥ (The supreme Illuminator shining with resplendent, diverse transcendental glories.); Sūryaḥ (The radiant Sun who produces prosperity, light, and life throughout the cosmic planetary systems.); Savitā (The divine Progenitor who creates all worlds and inspires spiritual wisdom.); Ravi-lōcanaḥ (He whose eye is the Sun, illuminating the universe and witnessing all deeds.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 95
verses.te_meaning: అనంతుడు; హవిస్సును అనుభవించేవాడు; భోక్త; సుఖాన్ని ఇచ్చేవాడు; అనేకసార్లు జన్మించినవాడు; మొదట పుట్టినవాడు; ఎప్పుడూ నిరాశపడనివాడు; ఎప్పుడూ క్షమించేవాడు; లోకాలకు ఆధారం; అద్భుతుడు.
verses.en_meaning: The infinite; enjoyer of the oblation; the enjoyer; giver of joy; born many times; the first-born; never despondent; ever-forbearing; the support of the worlds; the wonderful.
verses.words: Anantaḥ (Infinite and limitless in time, space, divine forms, and auspicious virtues.); Hutabhuk (The receiver and enjoyer of all sacred oblations offered in holy sacrifices.); Bhoktā (The supreme Enjoyer of all devotional service and the sovereign Master of nature.); Sukhadaḥ (The compassionate giver of true spiritual happiness, peace, and eternal beatitude.); Naikajaḥ (Manifesting in countless divine incarnations across all ages to uphold Dharma.); Agrajaḥ (The first-born, primeval Lord who existed prior to all cosmic creation.); Anirviṇṇaḥ (Ever serene, tireless, and free from any disappointment, sorrow, or frustration.); Sadāmarṣī (Ever forgiving and patient toward the innocent mistakes of His faithful devotees.); Lōkādhiṣṭhānam (The supreme Foundation and Substratum supporting all planetary systems.); Adbhutaḥ (Wondrous, miraculous, and marvelous in His divine forms, deeds, and glories.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 96
verses.te_meaning: సనాతనుడు; అత్యంత సనాతనుడు; పింగళ వర్ణ ముని (కపిలుడు); సూర్యుడు; క్షయం లేనివాడు; స్వస్తిని ఇచ్చేవాడు; మేలు చేసేవాడు; స్వస్తియే తానైనవాడు; స్వస్తిని అనుభవించేవాడు; శుభాన్ని ప్రసాదించేవాడు.
verses.en_meaning: The ancient; the most eternal; the tawny sage (Kapila); the sun; the imperishable; giver of well-being; doer of good; well-being itself; enjoyer of well-being; who bestows auspiciousness.
verses.words: Sanāt (Eternal and timeless, existing continuously without beginning or end.); Sanātanatamaḥ (The most ancient and primordial Reality, preceding all ancient entities.); Kapilaḥ (Possessing a glowing reddish-golden complexion, and the sage Kapila who taught spiritual wisdom.); Kapiḥ (He who drinks the waters of creation (Ka = water, Pa = drink) as the Sun and Varaha.); Avyayaḥ (Imperishable and unalterable, maintaining His infinite perfection eternally.); Svastidaḥ (The bestower of all genuine welfare, auspiciousness, and spiritual well-being.); Svastikṛt (The author of all auspiciousness who accomplishes what is truly beneficial for creation.); Svasti (The embodiment of supreme auspiciousness, peace, and divine perfection.); Svastibhuk (The enjoyer and protector of all auspiciousness, preserving the welfare of devotees.); Svastidakṣiṇaḥ (Prompt and generous in dispensing blessings of auspiciousness and spiritual gifts.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 97
verses.te_meaning: క్రూరత్వం లేనివాడు; కుండలాలు ధరించినవాడు; చక్రధారి; పరాక్రమశాలి; గొప్ప పాలన గలవాడు; మాటలకు అందనివాడు; అన్ని మాటల అర్థం తానే; చల్లని (ఆశ్రయం); (ప్రళయమనే) రాత్రిని సృష్టించేవాడు.
verses.en_meaning: Free from cruelty; wearer of earrings (Kundala); bearer of the discus; the valiant; of mighty rule; beyond the reach of words; the meaning of all words; the cool (refuge); maker of the night (of dissolution).
verses.words: Araudraḥ (Ever gentle, calm, and free from cruel anger toward His devotees.); Kunḍalī (Adorned with glowing celestial earrings (Kundalas) shaped like the sun and moon.); Cakrī (Wielding the invincible Sudarshana Discus that protects the cosmos and destroys evil.); Vikramī (Endowed with supreme, matchless valor and taking cosmic strides across creation.); Ūrjita-śāsanaḥ (He whose supreme commands and cosmic laws are mighty, glorious, and inviolable.); Śabdātigaḥ (Transcending the finite limits of worldly speech, revealed fully through divine grace.); Śabdasahaḥ (He who joyfully accepts and listens to all Vedic hymns, prayers, and mantras of devotees.); Śiśiraḥ (Cool and comforting, soothing the intense suffering of souls in the worldly heat.); Śarvarīkaraḥ (He who brings the peaceful night of rest and causes cosmic dissolution (Pralaya).)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 98
iast: akrūraḥ peśalo dakṣo dakṣiṇaḥ kṣamiṇāṃ varaḥ |
verses.te_meaning: క్రూరత్వం లేనివాడు; సొగసైనవాడు; నేర్పరి; ఉదారుడు; సహనశీలులలో శ్రేష్ఠుడు; అత్యంత విద్వాంసుడు; భయం లేనివాడు; ఎవరి గురించి వినడం, కీర్తించడం పవిత్రమో ఆయన.
verses.en_meaning: Free from cruelty; the graceful; the expert; the liberal; best of the forbearing; the most learned; free from fear; whose hearing and praise are holy.
