verses.words: Akrūraḥ (Completely free from cruelty, ever compassionate and tender toward all living beings.); Peśalaḥ (Charming, soft, and exquisitely graceful in His divine bodily form and actions.); Dakṣaḥ (Supremely competent, agile, and expert in fulfilling all cosmic purposes effortlessly.); Dakṣiṇaḥ (Courteous, liberal, and generous in bestowing boons upon the devoted.); Kṣamiṇāṁ varaḥ (The foremost and greatest among all who practice forgiveness and forbearance.); Vidvattamaḥ (The supreme, unmatched Scholar and Knower of all fields of knowledge.); Vītabhayaḥ (Completely fearless, being the sovereign Lord of all, and freeing devotees from fear.); Puṇya-śravaṇa-kīrtanaḥ (Hearing and chanting whose sacred names and glories bestows supreme spiritual merit.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 99
verses.te_meaning: సంసారాన్ని దాటించేవాడు; పాప కర్మలను నాశనం చేసేవాడు; పవిత్రుడు; చెడు కలలను పోగొట్టేవాడు; శత్రువులను చంపేవాడు; రక్షకుడు; సజ్జనులలో ఉండేవాడు; అందరికీ జీవం; అంతటా వ్యాపించినవాడు.
verses.en_meaning: Deliverer across samsara; destroyer of evil deeds; the holy; dispeller of bad dreams; slayer of foes; the protector; abiding in the good; the life of all; who pervades everywhere.
verses.words: Uttāraṇaḥ (The supreme Savior who rescues fallen souls from the dark ocean of Samsara.); Duṣkṛtihā (The destroyer of evil deeds, demonic vices, and past karmic burdens of devotees.); Puṇyaḥ (The personification of holiness and virtue, purifying all who contemplate Him.); Duḥsvapna-nāśanaḥ (The compassionate destroyer of bad dreams, evil omens, and mental distress.); Vīrahā (The heroic slayer of mighty demonic oppressors who defy Dharma.); Rakṣaṇaḥ (The eternal Guardian and Protector of all the three worlds.); Santaḥ (Manifesting as saintly guides to lead souls toward truth and liberation.); Jīvanaḥ (The supreme Life-Giver and sustainer of all living entities.); Paryavasthitaḥ (Enveloping and pervading the entire cosmos with His omnipresent grace.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 100
verses.te_meaning: అనంత రూపాలవాడు; అనంతమైన శ్రీ గలవాడు; కోపాన్ని జయించినవాడు; భయాన్ని పోగొట్టేవాడు; న్యాయమైనవాడు; లోతైన ఆత్మ గలవాడు; (ఫలాలను) పంచేవాడు; సేనాధిపతి; దిక్కులే తానైనవాడు.
verses.en_meaning: Of infinite forms; of infinite glory; conqueror of wrath; remover of fear; the just; of profound Self; distributor (of fruits); the commander; the very directions.
verses.words: Ananta-rūpaḥ (Endowed with infinite, transcendental forms of pure consciousness and beauty.); Anantaśrīḥ (Possessing boundless, measureless spiritual wealth, beauty, and divine opulence.); Jita-manyuḥ (Completely victorious over anger, maintaining absolute serenity at all times.); Bhayāpahaḥ (The compassionate dispeller of all fear, danger, and mortal dread.); Caturaśraḥ (Supremely just, balanced, and equitable in all His cosmic dealings and rewards.); Gabhirātmā (Possessing a nature that is unfathomably deep, serene, and majestic.); Vidiśaḥ (Dispensing specific tasks and gifts across all directions and to all beings.); Vyādiśaḥ (Commanding and directing all cosmic deities in their respective duties.); Diśaḥ (Revealing the sacred directions of Vedic wisdom through His divine speech.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 101
verses.te_meaning: ఆది లేనివాడు; భూమికి ఆధారం; అందరి కీర్తి; మంచి వీరత్వం గలవాడు; అందమైన భుజకీర్తులు గలవాడు; ప్రజలను సృష్టించేవాడు; జీవుల జన్మకు మూలం; భయం కలిగించేవాడు; (దుష్టులకు) భయంకరమైన పరాక్రమం గలవాడు.
verses.en_meaning: The beginningless; support of the earth; the glory of all; of goodly heroism; of splendid armlets; the progenitor; source of the birth of beings; the awe-inspiring; of terrible valour (to the wicked).
verses.words: Anādiḥ (The eternal, beginningless Lord who is the prime cause of all that exists.); Bhūrbhuvaḥ (The foundation, sustainer, and ruler of the terrestrial and atmospheric realms.); Lakṣmiḥ (The supreme Splendor, fortune, and glory of the cosmos; the eternal shelter of Sri Devi.); Suvīraḥ (Possessing extraordinary, noble heroism and guiding heroic spiritual champions.); Ruchirāṅgadaḥ (Adorned with luminous, attractive celestial armlets that enhance His divine beauty.); Jananaḥ (The supreme Creator and Father of all living beings.); Jana-janmādiḥ (The primordial cause behind the birth, sustenance, and evolution of all living entities.); Bhimaḥ (Awe-inspiring and formidable, commanding absolute reverence across the universe.); Bhima-parākramaḥ (Endowed with formidable, irresistible prowess that shatters demonic forces.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 102
verses.te_meaning: అన్ని ఆధారాలకు ఆధారం; తనకంటే పైన ఎవరూ లేనివాడు; పువ్వు విరిసినట్లు సృష్టిగా వికసించేవాడు; ఎప్పుడూ మేల్కొని ఉండేవాడు; పైకి ఎదిగేవాడు; మంచి మార్గంలో నడిచేవాడు; ప్రాణాన్ని ఇచ్చేవాడు; ఓంకారం; న్యాయంగా ఫలమిచ్చేవాడు.
verses.en_meaning: The support of all supports; who has none above; who blooms as creation like a flower; the ever-wakeful; the ascending; treader of the good path; giver of life; the Om; the just (rewarder).
verses.words: Ādhāra-nilayaḥ (The ultimate Substratum supporting even the fundamental cosmic elements.); Adhātā (Having no creator or master above Himself; self-existent and independent.); Puṣpahāsaḥ (Radiating an enchanting, gentle smile that blossoms like a fragrant flower.); Prajāgaraḥ (Eternally vigilant and awake, constantly watching over and protecting all creation.); Ūrdhvagaḥ (Exalted high above all material realms, dwelling in the highest transcendental abode (Vaikuntha).); Satpathācāraḥ (Treading the path of absolute righteousness and guiding devotees along the true path.); Prāṇadaḥ (The giver of life-breath (Prana), vitality, strength, and spiritual consciousness.); Praṇavaḥ (Denoted by the sacred primordial sound OM, bowed down to by all enlightened beings.); Paṇaḥ (The supreme Worth and Treasure of the cosmos, worthy of being attained at all costs.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 103
verses.te_meaning: ప్రమాణమే తానైనవాడు; ప్రాణాలకు నివాసం; ప్రాణాన్ని నిలిపేవాడు; ప్రాణాలకు జీవం; తత్త్వం (సత్యం); తత్త్వం తెలిసినవాడు; ఏకైక ఆత్మ; పుట్టుక, మరణం, ముసలితనం లేనివాడు.
verses.en_meaning: The very measure (of truth); abode of the life-breath; upholder of the life-breath; the life of the vital airs; the Reality; knower of the Reality; the one Self; beyond birth, death and old age.
verses.words: Pramāṇaṁ (The absolute source and personification of all valid, unassailable divine knowledge.); Prāṇanilayaḥ (The true sanctuary and resting place of the life-breath of all living beings.); Prāṇa-bhṛt (The supreme Sustainer who nourishes and maintains the life-forces of all creatures.); Prāṇa-jīvanaḥ (He who enlivens and animates the vital life-breath itself as its indwelling Lord.); Tattvaṁ (The ultimate Reality (Tattva), independent, eternal, and free from all defects.); Tatvavid (The omniscient knower of all reality, categories, and spiritual truths.); Ekātmā (The peerless, unique Supreme Soul and Master of all existence.); Janma-mṛtyu-jarātigaḥ (Completely transcendent and untouched by birth, death, old age, or decay.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 104
verses.te_meaning: మూడు లోకాలనే వృక్షం; దాటించేవాడు; ప్రేరేపించేవాడు; బ్రహ్మకు తండ్రి (ప్రపితామహుడు); యజ్ఞం; యజ్ఞానికి ప్రభువు; యజ్ఞం చేసేవాడు; యజ్ఞమే అవయవాలుగా గలవాడు; యజ్ఞాన్ని మోసేవాడు.
verses.en_meaning: The tree of the three worlds; the deliverer; the impeller; father of Brahma (the grandfather); the sacrifice; Lord of the sacrifice; the sacrificer; whose limbs are the sacrifice; who carries the sacrifice.
verses.words: Bhūr-bhuvaḥ-svastaruḥ (The cosmic Tree of Life sheltering the terrestrial, atmospheric, and heavenly worlds.); Tāraḥ (The supreme Savior who ferries surrendered souls safely across the ocean of Samsara.); Savitā (The divine Progenitor who creates and illuminates all worlds (proclaimed in Gayatri).); Prapitāmahaḥ (The great Ancestor and Father of Brahma, the creator of the universe.); Yajñaḥ (The embodiment and goal of all sacred Vedic sacrifices and offerings.); Yajñapatiḥ (The supreme Lord and Master of all sacrificial rites and oblations.); Yajvā (The supreme Performer of sacred cosmic sacrifices for universal protection.); Yajñāngaḥ (He whose transcendental limbs personify all the sacred elements and mantras of Yajna.); Yajña-vāhanaḥ (He who carries the sacred offerings of devotees to their true spiritual fulfillment.); Yajñabhṛd (The supporter, protector, and sustainer of all sacred sacrifices and rituals.); Yajñakṛd (The original Author and creator of the institution of sacred Yajna.); Yajñi (The supreme Recipient for whose pleasure all sacred sacrifices are performed.); Yajñabhug (The enjoyer of the fruits and oblations offered in all holy rituals.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 105
iast: yajñāntakṛd yajñaguhyam annam annāda eva ca.
verses.te_meaning: యజ్ఞాన్ని నిలిపేవాడు; యజ్ఞాన్ని చేసేవాడు; యజ్ఞాన్ని అనుభవించేవాడు; హవిస్సును స్వీకరించేవాడు; యజ్ఞానికి సాధనం; యజ్ఞాన్ని పూర్తి చేసేవాడు; యజ్ఞ రహస్యం; అన్నం, అన్నం తినేవాడు రెండూ తానే.
verses.en_meaning: Upholder of the sacrifice; performer of the sacrifice; the enjoyer of the sacrifice; consumer of the offering; means of the sacrifice; who completes the sacrifice; the secret of the sacrifice; the food and the eater of food.
verses.words: Yajña-sādhanaḥ (The ultimate Means through which all sacred rituals attain their true spiritual fruition.); Yajñāntakṛd (The bestower of the final ultimate reward of all sacrifices: eternal liberation (Moksha).); Yayajñaguhyam (The profound inner Secret and transcendental essence of all sacred sacrifices.); Annam (The universal Sustenance that nourishes all beings, and the object of spiritual contemplation.); Annādaḥ (The supreme Consumer of the universe at dissolution and the generous provider of food to all.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 106
verses.te_meaning: తనకు తానే కారణం; స్వయంభువు; (వరాహంగా) భూమిని తవ్వినవాడు; సామగానం చేసేవాడు; దేవకీనందనుడు (కృష్ణుడు); సృష్టికర్త; భూమికి ప్రభువు; పాపాన్ని నాశనం చేసేవాడు.
verses.en_meaning: The self-caused; the self-born; the excavator (as the boar); singer of the Sama; delight of Devaki (Krishna); the creator; Lord of the earth; destroyer of sin.
verses.words: Ātmayōniḥ (Self-caused and uncreated, existing eternally in His own independent majesty.); Svayaṁ-jātaḥ (Manifesting His divine Avataras independently by His own supreme will.); Vaikhānaḥ (He who dug and rescued the Earth from the cosmic depths in His holy Varaha Avatara.); Sāmagāyanaḥ (Sung melodiously and praised in the sacred chants of the Sama Veda.); Devakī-nandanaḥ (The beloved divine son of Devaki (Sri Krishna), bringing boundless joy to the universe.); Sraṣṭā (The supreme Creator who brings forth all cosmic worlds at the dawn of creation.); Kṣitīśaḥ (The supreme Sovereign Lord and Protector of the Earth.); Pāpanāśanaḥ (The compassionate destroyer of all sins, distress, and karmic impurities of devotees.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 107
verses.te_meaning: శంఖం (పాంచజన్యం) ధరించినవాడు; నందకమనే ఖడ్గం ధరించినవాడు; చక్రధారి; శార్ఙ్గమనే విల్లు గలవాడు; గద (కౌమోదకి) ధరించినవాడు; రథచక్రం చేతిలో గలవాడు; కదిలించలేనివాడు; అన్ని ఆయుధాలు ధరించినవాడు.
verses.en_meaning: Bearer of the conch (Panchajanya); wielder of the sword Nandaka; holder of the discus; of the bow Sharnga; bearer of the mace (Kaumodaki); who holds the wheel; the unshakable; armed with all weapons.
verses.words: Śaṅkhabhṛt (Wielder of the celestial conch Panchajanya whose resonant sound proclaims divine victory.); Nandakī (Wielder of the divine sword Nandaka representing pure transcendental wisdom.); Cakri (Wielder of the supreme Sudarshana Discus representing the cosmic wheel of time and protection.); Śārṅga-dhanvā (Wielder of the mighty divine bow Sharnga representing the cosmic senses and strength.); Gadādharaḥ (Wielder of the celestial mace Kaumodaki representing cosmic intellect and power.); Rathāṅga-pāṇiḥ (Holding the chariot wheel/discus in His hand in battle to uphold righteousness.); Akṣobhyaḥ (Completely unshakeable, unperturbable, and victorious over all cosmic adversaries.); Sarva-praharaṇā-yudhaḥ (Armed with all transcendental weapons to defend Dharma and protect surrendered souls from all directions.)

verses.label: VS · Shloka 107
verses.te_meaning: “సర్వప్రహరణాయుధ” తో ముగిసే నామాల తర్వాత ముగింపు — “ఓం నమః.”
verses.en_meaning: Closing seal after the names ending in Sarvapraharaṇāyudha — “Om, salutations.”

verses.label: VS · Shloka 108
deva: वनमाली गदी शार्ङ्गी शङ्खी चक्री च नन्दकी।
te: వనమాలీ గదీ శార్ంగీ శంఖీ చక్రీ చ నందకీ ।
iast: vanamālī gadī śārṅgī śaṅkhī cakrī ca nandakī |
verses.te_meaning: వనమాల ధరించినవాడు, గద, శార్ఙ్గ విల్లు, శంఖం, చక్రం, నందక ఖడ్గం ధరించినవాడు అయిన శ్రీమన్నారాయణుడు — విష్ణువు, వాసుదేవుడు — మమ్మల్ని ఎల్లప్పుడూ రక్షించాలి.
verses.en_meaning: May the glorious Narayana — Vishnu, Vasudeva — who wears the forest-garland and bears the mace, the Sharnga bow, the conch, the discus and the sword Nandaka, ever protect us.
verses.words: vanamālī (wearer of the forest garland), gadī (bearer of the mace), śārṅgī (Sharnga bow), śaṅkhī (conch), cakrī (discus), nandakī (sword Nandaka), śrīmān nārāyaṇaḥ viṣṇuḥ vāsudevaḥ (glorious Narayana, Vishnu, Vasudeva), abhirakṣatu (may He protect us).

verses.label: VS · Shloka 108
verses.te_meaning: మంగళ శ్లోకం తర్వాత ముగింపు — “వాసుదేవుడు మమ్మల్ని రక్షించుగాక. ఓం నమః.”
verses.en_meaning: Closing seal after the maṅgala verse — “May Vāsudeva protect us. Om, salutations.”

verses.label: VS · Phala Śruti 1
verses.te_meaning: ఈ విధంగా కీర్తించదగిన మహాత్ముడైన కేశవుని వెయ్యి దివ్య నామాలను పూర్తిగా చెప్పడం జరిగింది.
verses.en_meaning: Thus have the thousand divine names of the great and praiseworthy Keshava been fully proclaimed.
verses.words: iti idam (thus this), kīrtanīyasya (of Him worthy of praise), keśavasya mahātmanaḥ (of the great Keshava), nāmnām sahasram divyānām (thousand divine names), aśeṣeṇa prakīrtitam (have been fully proclaimed).

verses.label: VS · Phala Śruti 2
iast: ya idaṃ śṛṇuyān nityaṃ yaś cāpi parikīrtayet |
nāśubhaṃ prāpnuyāt kiñcit so 'mutreha ca mānavaḥ || 2 ||
verses.te_meaning: దీనిని రోజూ వినేవారికి, జపించేవారికి — ఇక్కడ గానీ, పరలోకంలో గానీ — ఏ అశుభమూ కలగదు.
verses.en_meaning: Whoever listens to this daily, and whoever recites it, meets with nothing inauspicious — here or hereafter.
verses.words: yaḥ idam śṛṇuyāt nityam (who listens daily), yaḥ ca api parikīrtayet (and who recites), na aśubham kiñcit (nothing inauspicious), amutra iha ca (hereafter and here).

verses.label: VS · Phala Śruti 3
iast: vedāntago brāhmaṇaḥ syāt kṣatriyo vijayī bhavet |
vaiśyo dhana-samṛddhaḥ syāc chūdraḥ sukham avāpnuyāt || 3 ||
verses.te_meaning: విద్య కోరేవాడు వేదాంత జ్ఞానాన్ని పొందుతాడు; క్షత్రియుడు విజయం సాధిస్తాడు; వ్యాపారి ధనవంతుడవుతాడు; శ్రామికుడు సుఖాన్ని పొందుతాడు.
verses.en_meaning: A seeker of knowledge attains Vedānta; a warrior becomes victorious; a merchant prospers; a worker obtains happiness.
verses.words: vedānta-gaḥ (attains Vedānta), brāhmaṇaḥ / kṣatriyaḥ vijayī / vaiśyaḥ dhana-samṛddhaḥ / śūdraḥ sukham (respective fruits by vocation).

verses.label: VS · Phala Śruti 4
iast: dharmārthī prāpnuyād dharmam arthārthī cārtham āpnuyāt |
kāmān avāpnuyāt kāmī prajārthī cāpnuyāt prajāḥ || 4 ||
verses.te_meaning: ధర్మం, ధనం, సుఖాలు, సంతానం — ఏది కోరితే అది పొందుతారు.
verses.en_meaning: One who seeks dharma, wealth, enjoyments, or progeny obtains them.
verses.words: dharma-arthī → dharma; artha-arthī → wealth; kāmī → desires; prajā-arthī → progeny.

verses.label: VS · Phala Śruti 5
verses.te_meaning: రోజూ ఉదయాన్నే లేచి, శుచిగా ఉండి, మనసును స్వామిపై నిలిపి, వాసుదేవుని ఈ వెయ్యి నామాలను జపించే భక్తుడు…
verses.en_meaning: The devotee who rises daily, remains pure, fixes the mind on the Lord, and recites these thousand names of Vāsudeva…
verses.words: bhaktimān (devotee), sadā utthāya śuciḥ (rising daily, pure), tad-gata-mānasaḥ (mind on Him), sahasram prakīrtayet (recites the thousand).

verses.label: VS · Phala Śruti 6
deva: यशः प्राप्नोति विपुलं याति प्राधान्यमेव च ।
te: యశః ప్రాప్నోతి విపులం యాతి ప్రాధాన్యమేవ చ ।
iast: yaśaḥ prāpnoti vipulaṃ yāti prādhānyam eva ca |
acalāṃ śriyam āpnoti śreyaḥ prāpnoty anuttamam || 6 ||
verses.te_meaning: …గొప్ప కీర్తిని, గౌరవ స్థానాన్ని, నిలిచి ఉండే సంపదను, ఉత్తమమైన శ్రేయస్సును పొందుతాడు.
verses.en_meaning: …gains great fame and standing, lasting prosperity, and the highest good.
verses.words: yaśaḥ vipulam (great fame), prādhānyam (pre-eminence), acalām śriyam (unshakable prosperity), anuttamam śreyaḥ (highest good).

verses.label: VS · Phala Śruti 7
deva: न भयं क्वचिदाप्नोति वीर्यं तेजश्च विन्दति ।
te: న భయం క్వచిదాప్నోతి వీర్యం తేజశ్-చ విందతి ।
iast: na bhayaṃ kvacid āpnoti vīryaṃ tejaś ca vindati |
verses.te_meaning: అతనికి భయం ఉండదు; పరాక్రమం, తేజస్సు కలుగుతాయి; రోగం లేనివాడై, కాంతిమంతుడై, బలం, అందం, మంచి గుణాలతో ఉంటాడు.
verses.en_meaning: He knows no fear, gains valour and splendour, and becomes free from disease, radiant, and endowed with strength, form, and noble qualities.
verses.words: na bhayam (no fear), vīryam tejaḥ (valour and splendour), arogaḥ dyutimān (healthy and radiant), bala-rūpa-guṇa-anvitaḥ (endowed with strength, form, and virtues).

verses.label: VS · Phala Śruti 8
iast: rogārto mucyate rogād baddho mucyeta bandhanāt |
bhayān mucyeta bhītas tu mucyetāpanna āpadaḥ || 8 ||
verses.te_meaning: రోగి రోగం నుండి, బంధించబడినవాడు బంధం నుండి, భయపడినవాడు భయం నుండి, ఆపదలో ఉన్నవాడు ఆపద నుండి విముక్తులవుతారు.
verses.en_meaning: The sick are freed from illness, the bound from bondage, the frightened from fear, and the afflicted from calamity.
verses.words: roga-ārtaḥ (the sick), baddhaḥ (the bound), bhītaḥ (the frightened), āpannaḥ (the afflicted) — are freed.

verses.label: VS · Phala Śruti 9
verses.te_meaning: భక్తితో నిండి, పురుషోత్తముని వెయ్యి నామాలతో ఎల్లప్పుడూ స్తుతించే వ్యక్తి అన్ని కష్టాలను త్వరగా దాటుతాడు.
verses.en_meaning: The person who always praises the Supreme Person with the thousand names, filled with devotion, swiftly crosses all difficulties.
verses.words: durgāṇi atitarati āśu (swiftly crosses difficulties), puruṣaḥ (the person), puruṣottamam stuvan (praising the Supreme Person), nāma-sahasreṇa (with the thousand names), nityam bhakti-samanvitaḥ (always with devotion).

verses.label: VS · Phala Śruti 10
verses.te_meaning: వాసుదేవుని ఆశ్రయించి, ఆయనకు అంకితమైన మనిషి అన్ని పాపాల నుండి శుద్ధుడై, శాశ్వతమైన బ్రహ్మాన్ని పొందుతాడు.
verses.en_meaning: The mortal who takes refuge in Vāsudeva and is devoted to Him, purified of all sin, attains the eternal Brahman.
verses.words: vāsudeva-āśrayaḥ (refuge in Vāsudeva), martyaḥ (a mortal), vāsudeva-parāyaṇaḥ (devoted to Him), sarva-pāpa-viśuddha-ātmā (purified of all sin), yāti brahma sanātanam (attains the eternal Brahman).

verses.label: VS · Phala Śruti 11
verses.te_meaning: వాసుదేవుని భక్తులకు ఎక్కడా ఏ అశుభమూ ఉండదు; పుట్టుక, మరణం, ముసలితనం, రోగాల భయం ఎప్పుడూ కలగదు.
verses.en_meaning: For devotees of Vāsudeva nothing inauspicious exists anywhere, and fear of birth, death, old age, and disease never arises.
verses.words: na aśubham (nothing inauspicious), vāsudeva-bhaktānām (for devotees of Vāsudeva), janma-mṛtyu-jarā-vyādhi-bhayam (fear of birth, death, old age, disease) na upajāyate (never arises).

verses.label: VS · Phala Śruti 12
verses.te_meaning: శ్రద్ధతో, భక్తితో ఈ స్తోత్రాన్ని పఠించేవానికి ఆత్మానందం, సహనం, సంపద, ధైర్యం, జ్ఞాపకశక్తి, కీర్తి కలుగుతాయి.
verses.en_meaning: One who studies this hymn with faith and devotion is endowed with inner joy, forbearance, prosperity, fortitude, memory, and fame.
verses.words: imam stavam adhīyānaḥ (studying this hymn), śraddhā-bhakti-samanvitaḥ (with faith and devotion), yujyeta (is endowed with), ātma-sukha kṣānti śrī dhṛti smṛti kīrti (inner joy, forbearance, prosperity, fortitude, memory, and fame).

verses.label: VS · Phala Śruti 13
deva: न क्रोधो न च मात्सर्यं न लोभो नाशुभा मतिः ।
te: న క్రోధో న చ మాత్సర్యం న లోభో నాశుభా మతిః ।
iast: na krodho na ca mātsaryaṃ na lobho nāśubhā matiḥ |
verses.te_meaning: పురుషోత్తముని పుణ్యాత్ములైన భక్తులకు కోపం, అసూయ, లోభం, చెడు ఆలోచనలు కలగవు.
verses.en_meaning: Anger, envy, greed, and impure thought do not arise in meritorious devotees of the Supreme Person.
verses.words: na krodhaḥ mātsaryam lobhaḥ aśubhā matiḥ (no anger, envy, greed, or impure thought), kṛta-puṇyānām bhaktānām (of meritorious devotees), puruṣottame (devoted to the Supreme Person).

verses.label: VS · Phala Śruti 14
iast: dyauḥ sa-candrārka-nakṣatrā khaṃ diśo bhūr mahodadhiḥ |
verses.te_meaning: చంద్రుడు, సూర్యుడు, నక్షత్రాలతో కూడిన స్వర్గం, ఆకాశం, దిక్కులు, భూమి, మహా సముద్రం — ఇవన్నీ మహాత్ముడైన వాసుదేవుని శక్తితోనే నిలిచి ఉన్నాయి.
verses.en_meaning: Heaven with moon, sun, and stars, the sky, the directions, the earth, and the great ocean — all are upheld by the power of the great Vāsudeva.
verses.words: dyauḥ (heaven), sa-candra-arka-nakṣatrā (with moon, sun, stars), kham diśaḥ bhūḥ mahā-udadhiḥ (sky, directions, earth, great ocean), vāsudevasya vīryeṇa vidhṛtāni (are upheld by Vāsudeva’s power).

verses.label: VS · Phala Śruti 15
verses.te_meaning: దేవతలు, అసురులు, గంధర్వులు, యక్షులు, నాగులు, రాక్షసులతో కూడిన — కదిలేవీ, కదలనివీ అయిన — ఈ జగత్తు మొత్తం కృష్ణుని ఆధీనంలో ఉంది.
verses.en_meaning: This entire world of gods, asuras, gandharvas, yakṣas, serpents, and rākṣasas — moving and unmoving — abides under Kṛṣṇa’s control.
verses.words: sa-sura-asura-gandharvam (with gods, asuras, gandharvas), sa-yakṣa-uraga-rākṣasam (with yakṣas, serpents, rākṣasas), jagat sa-cara-acaram (the moving and unmoving world), kṛṣṇasya vaśe (under Kṛṣṇa’s control).

verses.label: VS · Phala Śruti 16
deva: इन्द्रियाणि मनो बुद्धिः सत्त्वं तेजो बलं धृतिः ।
te: ఇంద్రియాణి మనో బుద్ధిః సత్త్వం తేజో బలం ధృతిః ।
iast: indriyāṇi mano buddhiḥ sattvaṃ tejo balaṃ dhṛtiḥ |
vāsudevātmakāny āhuḥ kṣetraṃ kṣetrajña eva ca || 16 ||
verses.te_meaning: ఇంద్రియాలు, మనసు, బుద్ధి, సత్త్వం, తేజస్సు, బలం, ధైర్యం — క్షేత్రం, క్షేత్రజ్ఞుడు — ఇవన్నీ వాసుదేవుని స్వరూపమే అని చెబుతారు.
verses.en_meaning: The senses, mind, intellect, purity, splendour, strength, fortitude — and the field and its knower — are all said to be of the nature of Vāsudeva.
verses.words: indriyāṇi manaḥ buddhiḥ (senses, mind, intellect), sattvam tejaḥ balam dhṛtiḥ (purity, splendour, strength, fortitude), vāsudeva-ātmakāni (are of the nature of Vāsudeva), kṣetram kṣetrajñaḥ ca (field and knower of the field).

verses.label: VS · Phala Śruti 17
verses.te_meaning: అన్ని శాస్త్రాలలో మంచి ఆచారమే మొదటిది; ఆచారం నుండి ధర్మం పుడుతుంది; ఆ ధర్మానికి ప్రభువు అచ్యుతుడు.
verses.en_meaning: Right conduct is first among all scriptures; from conduct arises dharma; and Acyuta is the Lord of dharma.
verses.words: sarva-āgamānām ācāraḥ (right conduct is foremost in all scriptures), ācāra-prabhavaḥ dharmaḥ (dharma arises from conduct), dharmasya prabhuḥ acyutaḥ (Acyuta is Lord of dharma).

verses.label: VS · Phala Śruti 18
verses.te_meaning: ఋషులు, పితృదేవతలు, దేవతలు, మహాభూతాలు, కదిలేదీ కదలనిదీ అయిన ఈ జగత్తు మొత్తం — నారాయణుని నుండే పుట్టాయి.
verses.en_meaning: Sages, ancestors, gods, the great elements, and this whole moving and unmoving world — all arise from Nārāyaṇa.
verses.words: ṛṣayaḥ pitaraḥ devāḥ (sages, ancestors, gods), mahā-bhūtāni dhātavaḥ (great elements and constituents), jaṅgama-ajaṅgamam (moving and unmoving), nārāyaṇa-udbhavam (born of Nārāyaṇa).

verses.label: VS · Phala Śruti 19
deva: योगो ज्ञानं तथा साङ्ख्यं विद्याः शिल्पादि कर्म च ।
te: యోగో జ్ఞానం తథా సాంఖ్యం విద్యాః శిల్పాది కర్మ చ ।
iast: yogo jñānaṃ tathā sāṅkhyaṃ vidyāḥ śilpādi karma ca |
vedāḥ śāstrāṇi vijñānam etat sarvaṃ janārdanāt || 19 ||
verses.te_meaning: యోగం, జ్ఞానం, సాంఖ్యం, కళలు, చేతి పనులు, వేదాలు, శాస్త్రాలు, అన్ని విద్యలు — ఇవన్నీ జనార్దనుని నుండే వచ్చాయి.
verses.en_meaning: Yoga, knowledge, Sāṅkhya, the arts, crafts, the Vedas, the śāstras, and all sciences — all come from Janārdana.
verses.words: yogaḥ jñānam sāṅkhyam (yoga, knowledge, Sāṅkhya), vidyāḥ śilpa-ādi karma (arts and crafts), vedāḥ śāstrāṇi vijñānam (Vedas, śāstras, and science), etat sarvam janārdanāt (all this from Janārdana).

verses.label: VS · Phala Śruti 20
iast: trīṃl lokān vyāpya bhūtātmā bhuṅkte viśva-bhug avyayaḥ || 20 ||
verses.te_meaning: ఒక్కడే విష్ణువు మహాభూతం; జీవులకు ఆత్మగా ఆయన లెక్కలేనన్ని రూపాలతో మూడు లోకాలను వ్యాపించి ఉన్నాడు; నాశనం లేని భోక్తగా విశ్వాన్ని పోషిస్తున్నాడు.
verses.en_meaning: The one Viṣṇu is the great Being; as the Self of beings He pervades the three worlds in countless forms, and as the imperishable enjoyer sustains the universe.
verses.words: ekaḥ viṣṇuḥ (the one Viṣṇu), mahat-bhūtam (the great Being), pṛthak-bhūtāni anekaśaḥ (manifold separate beings), trīn lokān vyāpya (pervading the three worlds), bhūtātmā (Self of beings), viśva-bhuk avyayaḥ (imperishable enjoyer of the universe).

verses.label: VS · Phala Śruti 21
deva: पठेद्य इच्छेत्पुरुषः श्रेयः प्राप्तुं सुखानि च ॥ २१॥
te: పఠేద్-య ఇచ్ఛేత్-పురుషః శ్రేయః ప్రాప్తుం సుఖాని చ ॥ 21 ॥
iast: imaṃ stavaṃ bhagavato viṣṇor vyāsena kīrtitam |
paṭhed ya icchet puruṣaḥ śreyaḥ prāptuṃ sukhāni ca || 21 ||
verses.te_meaning: శ్రేయస్సు, సుఖం కోరేవారు వ్యాసుడు చెప్పిన ఈ విష్ణు స్తోత్రాన్ని జపించాలి.
verses.en_meaning: Whoever desires the highest good and happiness should recite this hymn of Lord Viṣṇu as proclaimed by Vyāsa.
verses.words: imam stavam (this hymn), bhagavataḥ viṣṇoḥ (of Lord Viṣṇu), vyāsena kīrtitam (proclaimed by Vyāsa), paṭhet (should recite), yaḥ icchet śreyaḥ sukhāni (who desires the highest good and happiness).

verses.label: VS · Phala Śruti 22
deva: भजन्ति ये पुष्कराक्षं न ते यान्ति पराभवम् ॥ २२॥
te: భజంతి యే పుష్కరాక్షం న తే యాంతి పరాభవమ్ ॥ 22 ॥
iast: viśveśvaram ajaṃ devaṃ jagataḥ prabhum avyayam |
bhajanti ye puṣkarākṣaṃ na te yānti parābhavam || 22 ||
verses.te_meaning: కమల నేత్రుడు, పుట్టుక లేనివాడు, నాశనం లేనివాడు, జగత్తుకు ప్రభువు అయిన స్వామిని పూజించేవారికి ఎప్పుడూ ఓటమి ఉండదు.
verses.en_meaning: Those who worship the lotus-eyed, unborn, imperishable Lord of the universe never meet with defeat.
verses.words: viśva-īśvaram ajam (unborn Lord of the universe), jagataḥ prabhum avyayam (imperishable Lord of the world), ye bhajanti puṣkara-akṣam (who worship the lotus-eyed), na te yānti parābhavam (they never meet defeat).

verses.label: VS · Phala Śruti 23
verses.te_meaning: విశాలమైన కమల నేత్రాలు గలవాడా, పద్మనాభా, దేవతలలో శ్రేష్ఠుడా, జనార్దనా — నిన్ను ప్రేమించే భక్తులకు నువ్వే రక్షకుడివి కావాలి.
verses.en_meaning: O wide lotus-eyed, lotus-naveled, best of gods — O Janārdana, be the protector of Your devoted lovers.
verses.words: padma-patra-viśāla-akṣa (O wide lotus-eyed), padma-nābha (O lotus-naveled), sura-uttama (O best of gods), bhaktānām anuraktānām trātā bhava (be the protector of devoted lovers), janārdana (O Janārdana).

verses.label: VS · Phala Śruti 24
deva: सोऽहमेकेन श्लोकेन स्तुत एव न संशयः ॥ २४॥
te: సోఽహమేకేన శ్లోకేన స్తుత ఏవ న సంశయః ॥ 24 ॥
iast: yo māṃ nāma-sahasreṇa stotum icchati pāṇḍava |
so 'ham ekena ślokena stuta eva na saṃśayaḥ || 24 ||
verses.te_meaning: పాండవా, వెయ్యి నామాలతో నన్ను స్తుతించాలనుకునేవారు — ఒక్క శ్లోకంతో స్తుతించినా నేను స్తుతించబడినట్లే; ఇందులో సందేహం లేదు.
verses.en_meaning: O Pāṇḍava, whoever wishes to praise Me with the thousand names — I am indeed praised even by a single verse; of this there is no doubt.
verses.words: yaḥ mām nāma-sahasreṇa stotum icchati (who wishes to praise Me with the thousand names), pāṇḍava (O son of Pāṇḍu), saḥ aham ekena ślokena stutaḥ eva (I am praised even by a single verse), na saṃśayaḥ (no doubt).

verses.label: VS · Phala Śruti 25
verses.te_meaning: వాసుదేవా, నీ ఉనికితోనే మూడు లోకాలు నిండి ఉన్నాయి. సకల జీవులకు నువ్వే నివాసం — నీకు నమస్కారం.
verses.en_meaning: By Your presence, O Vāsudeva, the three worlds are permeated. You are the abode of all beings — salutations to You.
verses.words: vāsanāt vāsudevasya (by the abiding presence of Vāsudeva), vāsitam te jagat-trayam (the three worlds are permeated by You), sarva-bhūta-nivāsaḥ asi (You are the abode of all beings), vāsudeva namaḥ astu te (salutations to You, O Vāsudeva).

verses.label: VS · Phala Śruti 26
iast: paṭhyate paṇḍitair nityaṃ śrotum icchāmy ahaṃ prabho || 26 ||
verses.te_meaning: స్వామీ, పండితులు రోజూ విష్ణు సహస్రనామాన్ని ఏ సులభమైన ఉపాయంతో జపిస్తారు? అది వినాలని ఉంది.
verses.en_meaning: O Lord, by what easy means do the wise recite daily the thousand names of Viṣṇu? I wish to hear.
verses.words: kena upāyena laghunā (by what easy means), viṣṇoḥ nāma-sahasrakam (the thousand names of Viṣṇu), paṭhyate paṇḍitaiḥ nityam (is recited daily by the wise), śrotum icchāmi (I wish to hear), prabho (O Lord).

verses.label: VS · Phala Śruti 27
deva: श्रीराम राम रामेति रमे रामे मनोरमे ।
te: శ్రీ-రామ రామ రామేతి రమే రామే మనోరమే ।
iast: śrī rāma rāma rāmeti rame rāme manorame |
verses.te_meaning: అందమైన ముఖం గలదానా, “రామ రామ రామ” అనే మనోహరమైన నామంలో నేను ఆనందిస్తాను; ఒక్క రామ నామం వెయ్యి నామాలకు సమానం.
verses.en_meaning: O fair-faced one, I delight in the enchanting name "Rāma, Rāma, Rāma"; the single name Rāma is equal to the entire thousand names.
verses.words: śrī rāma rāma rāma iti (the name "Rāma, Rāma, Rāma"), rame manorame (I delight in the enchanting Rāma), sahasra-nāma tat-tulyam (equal to that thousand names), rāma-nāma vara-ānane (the name Rāma, O fair-faced one).

verses.label: VS · Phala Śruti 28
verses.te_meaning: వేయి రూపాలు, పాదాలు, కళ్ళు, తలలు, చేతులు గలవాడు, వేయి నామాలు గలవాడు, వేల కోట్ల యుగాలను ధరించే శాశ్వత పురుషుడు అయిన అనంతునికి నమస్కారం.
verses.en_meaning: Salutations to the Infinite — of a thousand forms, feet, eyes, heads, and arms; of a thousand names; the eternal Person who bears thousands of crores of yugas.
verses.words: namaḥ astu anantāya (salutations to the Infinite), sahasra-mūrtaye (of a thousand forms), sahasra-pāda-akṣi-śiras-uru-bāhave (of a thousand feet, eyes, heads, thighs, and arms), sahasra-nāmne (of a thousand names), śāśvate puruṣāya (to the eternal Person), sahasra-koṭī-yuga-dhāriṇe (bearer of thousands of crores of yugas).

verses.label: VS · Phala Śruti 29
deva: यत्र योगेश्वरः कृष्णो यत्र पार्थो धनुर्धरः ।
te: యత్ర యోగేశ్వరః కృష్ణో యత్ర పార్థో ధనుర్-ధరః ।
iast: yatra yogeśvaraḥ kṛṣṇo yatra pārtho dhanur-dharaḥ |
tatra śrīr vijayo bhūtir dhruvā nītir matir mama || 29 ||
verses.te_meaning: యోగేశ్వరుడైన కృష్ణుడు, విలుకాడైన అర్జునుడు ఎక్కడ ఉంటారో — అక్కడ సంపద, విజయం, ఐశ్వర్యం, స్థిరమైన న్యాయం ఉంటాయి; ఇది నా నిశ్చితాభిప్రాయం.
verses.en_meaning: Where Kṛṣṇa, Lord of yoga, and Pārtha the archer are — there are fortune, victory, prosperity, and firm justice; such is my conviction.
verses.words: yatra yoga-īśvaraḥ kṛṣṇaḥ (where Kṛṣṇa, Lord of yoga, is), yatra pārthaḥ dhanur-dharaḥ (where Pārtha the archer is), tatra śrīḥ vijayaḥ bhūtiḥ dhruvā nītiḥ (there are fortune, victory, prosperity, and firm justice), matir mama (such is my conviction).

verses.label: VS · Phala Śruti 30
iast: ananyāś cintayanto māṃ ye janāḥ paryupāsate |
verses.te_meaning: నన్ను తప్ప మరేదీ ఆలోచించకుండా పూజించేవారు, ఎల్లప్పుడూ నాతో కలిసి ఉండేవారు — వారి యోగక్షేమాలను (కావలసినది పొందడం, ఉన్నది కాపాడడం) నేనే చూసుకుంటాను.
verses.en_meaning: Those who worship Me, thinking of Me alone — of those ever united with Me, I Myself carry their yoga and kṣema (attainment and welfare).
verses.words: ananyāḥ cintayantaḥ mām (thinking of Me alone), ye janāḥ paryupāsate (who worship Me), teṣām nitya-abhiyuktānām (of those ever united with Me), yoga-kṣemam vahāmi aham (I carry their attainment and welfare).

verses.label: VS · Phala Śruti 31
verses.te_meaning: సజ్జనులను రక్షించడానికి, దుష్టులను నాశనం చేయడానికి, ధర్మాన్ని స్థాపించడానికి నేను ప్రతి యుగంలోనూ పుడతాను.
verses.en_meaning: For the protection of the good, the destruction of the wicked, and the establishment of dharma, I am born age after age.
verses.words: paritrāṇāya sādhūnām (for the protection of the good), vināśāya duṣkṛtām (for the destruction of the wicked), dharma-saṃsthāpana-arthāya (for establishing dharma), sambhavāmi yuge yuge (I am born age after age).

verses.label: VS · Phala Śruti 32
deva: आर्ता विषण्णाः शिथिलाश्च भीताः घोरेषु च व्याधिषु वर्तमानाः ।
te: ఆర్తా విషణ్ణాః శిథిలాశ్-చ భీతాః ఘోరేషు చ వ్యాధిషు వర్తమానాః ।
iast: ārtā viṣaṇṇāḥ śithilāś ca bhītāḥ ghoreṣu ca vyādhiṣu vartamānāḥ |
verses.te_meaning: బాధలో ఉన్నవారు, నిరాశ చెందినవారు, బలహీనులు, భయపడినవారు, భయంకరమైన రోగాలతో ఉన్నవారు కూడా — కేవలం నారాయణ నామాన్ని జపించినంత మాత్రాన దుఃఖం పోయి సుఖంగా ఉంటారు.
verses.en_meaning: The afflicted, dejected, weak, and frightened — even those in terrible diseases — by merely chanting the name Nārāyaṇa become free from sorrow and happy.
verses.words: ārtāḥ viṣaṇṇāḥ śithilāḥ bhītāḥ (the afflicted, dejected, weak, and frightened), ghoreṣu vyādhiṣu (in terrible diseases), saṅkīrtya nārāyaṇa-śabda-mātram (by merely chanting the name Nārāyaṇa), vimukta-duḥkhāḥ sukhinaḥ bhavanti (become free from sorrow and happy).

verses.label: VS · Kṣamā Prārthanā
deva: तत्सर्वं क्षम्यतां देव नारायण नमोऽस्तु ते ॥
te: తత్-సర్వం క్షమ్యతాం దేవ నారాయణ నమోఽస్తు తే ॥
iast: yad akṣara-pada-bhraṣṭaṃ mātrā-hīnaṃ tu yad bhavet |
tat sarvaṃ kṣamyatāṃ deva nārāyaṇa namo 'stu te ||
verses.te_meaning: నారాయణా, ఈ పారాయణంలో అక్షరం గానీ, పదం గానీ, ఛందస్సు గానీ తప్పుగా ఉంటే — అదంతా క్షమించు; నీకు నమస్కారం.
verses.en_meaning: O Lord Nārāyaṇa, forgive whatever syllable, word, or metre may be faulty in this recitation — salutations to You.
verses.words: yat akṣara-pada-bhraṣṭam (whatever syllable or word is faulty), mātrā-hīnam (deficient in metre), tat sarvam kṣamyatām (may all that be forgiven), nārāyaṇa namaḥ astu te (salutations to You, O Nārāyaṇa).

verses.label: VS · Samargaṇa
deva: कायेन वाचा मनसेन्द्रियैर्वा बुद्ध्यात्मना वा प्रकृतेः स्वभावात् ।
te: కాయేన వాచా మనసేంద్రియైర్-వా బుద్ధ్యాత్మనా వా ప్రకృతేః స్వభావాత్ ।
iast: kāyena vācā manasendriyair vā buddhyātmanā vā prakṛteḥ svabhāvāt |
karomi yad yat sakalaṃ parasmai nārāyaṇāyeti samarpayāmi ||
verses.te_meaning: శరీరంతో, మాటతో, మనసుతో, ఇంద్రియాలతో, బుద్ధితో, లేదా స్వభావం వల్ల నేను ఏది చేసినా — అదంతా నారాయణునికే అర్పిస్తున్నాను.
verses.en_meaning: Whatever I do by body, speech, mind, senses, intellect, or by nature’s impulse — all that I offer to Nārāyaṇa.
verses.words: kāyena vācā manasā indriyaiḥ (by body, speech, mind, senses), buddhyā ātmanā vā (by intellect or self), prakṛteḥ svabhāvāt (or by nature’s impulse), yat yat karomi sakalam (whatever I do), nārāyaṇāya samarpayāmi (I offer all to Nārāyaṇa).

verses.label: VS · Uttara Kara-nyāsaḥ
iast: oṃ viśvaṃ viṣṇur vaṣaṭkāra ity aṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ |
oṃ amṛtāṃśūdbhavo bhānur iti tarjanībhyāṃ namaḥ |
oṃ brahmaṇyo brahma-kṛd brahmeti madhyamābhyāṃ namaḥ |
oṃ suvarṇa-bindur akṣobhya ity anāmikābhyāṃ namaḥ |
oṃ rathāṅga-pāṇir akṣobhya iti kara-tala-kara-pṛṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
verses.te_meaning: సహస్రనామ పారాయణం తర్వాత ముగింపు కరన్యాసం.
verses.en_meaning: Concluding hand-nyāsa after the recitation of the thousand names.
verses.words: Same finger assignments as the preliminary kara-nyāsa, repeated after the stotram.

verses.label: VS · Uttara Aṅga-nyāsaḥ
deva: ॐ विश्वं विष्णुर्वषट्कार इति ज्ञानाय हृदयाय नमः ।
ॐ अमृतांशूद्भवो भानुरिति ऐश्वर्याय शिरसे स्वाहा ।
ॐ ब्रह्मण्यो ब्रह्मकृद्ब्रह्मेति शक्त्यै शिखायै वषट् ।
ॐ सुवर्णबिन्दुरक्षोभ्य इति बलाय कवचाय हुम् ।
ॐ रथाङ्गपाणिरक्षोभ्य इति वीर्याय अस्त्राय फट् ।
ॐ सर्वप्रहरणायुध ॐ नम इति दिग्विमोक्षः ॥
te: ఓం విశ్వం విష్ణుర్-వషట్కార ఇతి జ్ఞానాయ హృదయాయ నమః ।
ఓం అమృతాంశూద్భవో భానురితి ఐశ్వర్యాయ శిరసే స్వాహా ।
ఓం బ్రహ్మణ్యో బ్రహ్మ-కృద్-బ్రహ్మేతి శక్త్యై శిఖాయై వషట్ ।
ఓం సువర్ణ-బిందురక్షోభ్య ఇతి బలాయ కవచాయ హుమ్ ।
ఓం రథాంగ-పాణిరక్షోభ్య ఇతి వీర్యాయ అస్త్రాయ ఫట్ ।
ఓం సర్వ-ప్రహరణాయుధ ఓం నమ ఇతి దిగ్-విమోక్షః ॥
iast: oṃ viśvaṃ viṣṇur vaṣaṭkāra iti jñānāya hṛdayāya namaḥ |
oṃ amṛtāṃśūdbhavo bhānur iti aiśvaryāya śirase svāhā |
oṃ brahmaṇyo brahma-kṛd brahmeti śaktyai śikhāyai vaṣaṭ |
oṃ suvarṇa-bindur akṣobhya iti balāya kavacāya hum |
oṃ rathāṅga-pāṇir akṣobhya iti vīryāya astrāya phaṭ |
oṃ sarva-praharaṇāyudha oṃ nama iti dig-vimokṣaḥ ||
verses.te_meaning: స్తోత్రం తర్వాత ముగింపు షడంగ న్యాసం, దిగ్బంధ విమోచనం.
verses.en_meaning: Concluding six-limb nyāsa and release of the directional binding after the stotram.
verses.words: Heart — knowledge; head — sovereignty; tuft — power; armour — strength; eyes — vision; weapon — valour; then release of the directions with Sarvapraharaṇāyudha.

verses.label: Bhaja Govindam · Verse 1
deva: भज गोविन्दं भज गोविन्दं गोविन्दं भज मूढमते ।
सम्प्राप्ते सन्निहिते काले न हि न हि रक्षति डुकृञ्करणे ॥ १॥
te: భజ గోవిందం భజ గోవిందం గోవిందం భజ మూఢమతే ।
సంప్రాప్తే సన్నిహితే కాలే న హి న హి రక్షతి డుకృఞ్-కరణే ॥ ౧॥
iast: bhaja govindaṃ bhaja govindaṃ govindaṃ bhaja mūḍhamate
samprāpte sannihite kāle na hi na hi rakṣati dukṛṅkaraṇe || 1 ||
verses.en_meaning: Worship Govinda, worship Govinda, worship Govinda, O foolish mind! At the appointed time of death, rules of grammar (mere intellectual learning) will certainly not save you.
verses.words: bhaja govindam (worship Govinda), mūḍha-mate (O foolish mind), samprāpte sannihite kāle (when the appointed time draws near, i.e. death), na hi na hi rakṣati (it will surely not protect you), dukṛṅkaraṇe (the grammatical rule/formula, a symbol of dry scholarship).

verses.label: Bhaja Govindam · Verse 2
deva: मूढ जहीहि धनागमतृष्णां कुरु सद्बुद्धिं मनसि वितृष्णाम् ।
यल्लभसे निजकर्मोपात्तं वित्तं तेन विनोदय चित्तम् ॥ २॥
te: మూఢ జహీహి ధనాగమ-తృష్ణాం కురు సద్-బుద్ధిం మనసి వితృష్ణామ్ ।
యల్లభసే నిజ-కర్మోపాత్తం విత్తం తేన వినోదయ చిత్తమ్ ॥ ౨॥
iast: mūḍha jahīhi dhanāgama-tṛṣṇāṃ kuru sad-buddhiṃ manasi vitṛṣṇām
yal-labhase nija-karmopāttaṃ vittaṃ tena vinodaya cittam || 2 ||
verses.en_meaning: O fool, give up your thirst for amassing wealth; cultivate a wise, desireless mind. Be content with whatever wealth comes to you through the fruits of your own past deeds.
verses.words: jahīhi (give up), dhana-āgama-tṛṣṇām (the thirst for acquiring wealth), sad-buddhim (a good/wise mind), vitṛṣṇām (free of desire), yat labhase (whatever you obtain), nija-karma-upāttam (earned by your own past deeds), vinodaya cittam (occupy/content your mind).

verses.label: Bhaja Govindam · Verse 3
verses.en_meaning: Seeing a woman's full bosom and navel, do not fall into a state of infatuation. This is merely a transformation of flesh and fat — reflect on this again and again in your mind.
verses.words: nārī-stana-bhara-nābhī-deśam (a woman's full bosom and navel region), dṛṣṭvā (having seen), mā gā mohāveśaṃ (do not fall into an infatuated state), etat māmsa-vasa-ādi-vikāram (this is merely a modification of flesh, fat, and such), vicintaya vāraṃ vāram (reflect again and again).

verses.label: Bhaja Govindam · Verse 4
deva: विद्धि व्याध्यभिमानग्रस्तं लोकं शोकहतं च समस्तम् ॥ ४॥
te: విద్ధి వ్యాధ్యభిమాన-గ్రస్తం లోకం శోక-హతం చ సమస్తమ్ ॥ ౪॥
iast: viddhi vyādhy-abhimāna-grastaṃ lokaṃ śoka-hataṃ ca samastam || 4 ||
verses.en_meaning: Life is as unstable as a drop of water trembling upon a lotus petal — exceedingly fickle. Know that the entire world is seized by disease and pride, and is struck through and through by grief.
verses.words: nalinīdala-gata-jalam (a drop of water on a lotus petal), atitaralam (extremely unstable), tadvat jīvitam (life is likewise), atiśaya-capalam (exceedingly fickle), vyādhi-abhimāna-grastam (seized by disease and pride), śoka-hatam (struck by grief), samastam (entirely).

verses.label: Bhaja Govindam · Verse 5
deva: पश्चाज्जीवति जर्जरदेहे वार्तां कोऽपि न पृच्छति गेहे ॥ ५॥
te: పశ్చాజ్జీవతి జర్జర-దేహే వార్తాం కోఽపి న పృచ్ఛతి గేహే ॥ ౫॥
iast: paścāj-jīvati jarjara-dehe vārtāṃ ko’pi na pṛcchati gehe || 5 ||
verses.en_meaning: So long as a man is capable of earning wealth, his family remains devoted to him. But afterward, when he lives on with a decrepit body, no one at home even bothers to ask after him.
verses.words: yāvat (so long as), vitta-upārjana-saktaḥ (capable of earning wealth), tāvat nija-parivāraḥ raktaḥ (so long one's family remains devoted/attached), paścāt jīvati jarjara-dehe (afterward, when one lives on with a decrepit body), vārtām ko’pi na pṛcchati gehe (no one at home even asks about him).

verses.label: Bhaja Govindam · Verse 6
deva: यावत्पवनो निवसति देहे तावत्पृच्छति कुशलं गेहे ।
गतवति वायौ देहापाये भार्या बिभ्यति तस्मिन्काये ॥ ६॥
te: యావత్-పవనో నివసతి దేహే తావత్-పృచ్ఛతి కుశలం గేహే ।
గతవతి వాయౌ దేహాపాయే భార్యా బిభ్యతి తస్మిన్-కాయే ॥ ౬॥
iast: yāvat-pavano nivasati dehe tāvat-pṛcchati kuśalaṃ gehe
gatavati vāyau dehāpāye bhāryā bibhyati tasmin-kāye || 6 ||
verses.en_meaning: As long as the breath dwells in the body, the household kindly inquires after one's welfare. But once the breath departs and the body perishes, even one's own wife becomes afraid of that very body.
verses.words: yāvat pavanaḥ nivasati dehe (as long as the breath dwells in the body), tāvat pṛcchati kuśalam gehe (that long the household inquires after one's welfare), gatavati vāyau deha-apāye (once the breath departs and the body perishes), bhāryā bibhyati tasmin kāye (even the wife becomes afraid of that same body).

verses.label: Bhaja Govindam · Verse 7
deva: वृद्धस्तावच्चिन्तासक्तः परमे ब्रह्मणि कोऽपि न सक्तः ॥ ७॥
te: వృద్ధస్-తావచ్చింతా-సక్తః పరమే బ్రహ్మణి కోఽపి న సక్తః ॥ ౭॥
iast: vṛddhas-tāvac-cintā-saktaḥ parame brahmaṇi ko’pi na saktaḥ || 7 ||
verses.en_meaning: The child is absorbed in play, the youth is absorbed in the pursuit of women, and the aged is absorbed in worries — but hardly anyone becomes absorbed in the Supreme Brahman.
verses.words: bālaḥ tāvat krīḍā-saktaḥ (the child is absorbed in play), taruṇaḥ tāvat taruṇī-saktaḥ (the youth is absorbed in women), vṛddhaḥ tāvat cintā-saktaḥ (the aged is absorbed in worries), parame brahmaṇi ko’pi na saktaḥ (hardly anyone is absorbed in the Supreme Brahman).

verses.label: Bhaja Govindam · Verse 8
deva: का ते कान्ता कस्ते पुत्रः संसारोऽयमतीव विचित्रः ।
कस्य त्वं कः कुत आयातस्तत्त्वं चिन्तय तदिह भ्रातः ॥ ८॥
te: కా తే కాంతా కస్-తే పుత్రః సంసారోఽయమ్-అతీవ విచిత్రః ।
కస్య త్వం కః కుత ఆయాతస్-తత్త్వం చింతయ తద్-ఇహ భ్రాతః ॥ ౮॥
iast: kā te kāntā kas-te putraḥ saṃsāro’yam-atīva vicitraḥ
kasya tvaṃ kaḥ kuta āyātas-tattvaṃ cintaya tad-iha bhrātaḥ || 8 ||
verses.en_meaning: Who is your wife? Who is your son? This samsara is exceedingly strange. Whose are you? Who are you? Where have you come from? Ponder this truth, O brother, here and now.
verses.words: kā te kāntā (who is your wife), kaḥ te putraḥ (who is your son), saṃsāraḥ ayam atīva vicitraḥ (this samsara is exceedingly strange), kasya tvam (whose are you), kaḥ kutaḥ āyātaḥ (who are you, where have you come from), tattvam cintaya bhrātaḥ (ponder this truth, O brother).

verses.label: Bhaja Govindam · Verse 9
verses.en_meaning: From good company comes non-attachment; from non-attachment comes freedom from delusion; from freedom from delusion comes steadfastness in the Truth; and from steadfastness in the Truth comes liberation while yet living.
verses.words: sat-saṅgatve (from association with the good/wise), nis-saṅgatvam (comes non-attachment), nirmohatvam (freedom from delusion), niścala-tattvam (steadfastness in the Truth), jīvan-muktiḥ (liberation while living).

verses.label: Bhaja Govindam · Verse 10
deva: वयसि गते कः कामविकारः शुष्के नीरे कः कासारः ।
क्षीणे वित्ते कः परिवारः ज्ञाते तत्त्वे कः संसारः ॥ १०॥
te: వయసి గతే కః కామ-వికారః శుష్కే నీరే కః కాసారః ।
క్షీణే విత్తే కః పరివారః జ్ఞాతే తత్త్వే కః సంసారః ॥ ౧౦॥
iast: vayasi gate kaḥ kāma-vikāraḥ śuṣke nīre kaḥ kāsāraḥ
kṣīṇe vitte kaḥ parivāraḥ jñāte tattve kaḥ saṃsāraḥ || 10 ||
verses.en_meaning: When youth has passed, what use is passion? When its water has dried up, what is a lake? When wealth is exhausted, where are the relatives? And when the Truth is known, where is samsara at all?
verses.words: vayasi gate (when youth has passed), kaḥ kāma-vikāraḥ (what use is passion), śuṣke nīre kaḥ kāsāraḥ (what is a lake when its water has dried up), kṣīṇe vitte kaḥ parivāraḥ (where are the relatives when wealth is exhausted), jñāte tattve kaḥ saṃsāraḥ (where is samsara when the Truth is known).

verses.label: Bhaja Govindam · Verse 11
deva: मा कुरु धनजनयौवनगर्वं हरति निमेषात्कालः सर्वम् ।
मायामयमिदमखिलं हित्वा ब्रह्मपदं त्वं प्रविश विदित्वा ॥ ११॥
te: మా కురు ధన-జన-యౌవన-గర్వం హరతి నిమేషాత్-కాలః సర్వమ్ ।
మాయామయమ్-ఇదమ్-అఖిలం హిత్వా బ్రహ్మ-పదం త్వం ప్రవిశ విదిత్వా ॥ ౧౧॥
iast: mā kuru dhana-jana-yauvana-garvaṃ harati nimeṣāt-kālaḥ sarvam
māyāmayam-idam-akhilaṃ hitvā brahma-padaṃ tvaṃ praviśa viditvā || 11 ||
verses.en_meaning: Do not take pride in wealth, followers, and youth — time snatches all of it away in an instant. Giving up this entirely illusory world, enter the state of Brahman having truly known it.
verses.words: mā kuru garvam (do not take pride), dhana-jana-yauvana (in wealth, followers, and youth), harati nimeṣāt kālaḥ sarvam (time takes all of it away in an instant), māyāmayam idam akhilam hitvā (giving up this entirely illusory world), brahma-padam tvaṃ praviśa viditvā (enter the state of Brahman, having known it).

verses.label: Bhaja Govindam · Verse 12
verses.en_meaning: Day and night, dusk and dawn, winter and spring — all come and go again and again. Time plays on and life ebbs away, yet the storm of desire never leaves a person.
verses.words: dina-yāminyau (day and night), sāyam prātaḥ (dusk and dawn), śiśira-vasantau (winter and spring), punar āyātaḥ (come again and again), kālaḥ krīḍati (time plays on), gacchati āyuḥ (life ebbs away), āśā-vāyuḥ na muñcati (yet the wind of desire never departs).

verses.label: Bhaja Govindam · Verse 13
deva: का ते कान्ता धनगतचिन्ता वातुल किं तव नास्ति नियन्ता ।
te: కా తే కాంతా ధన-గత-చింతా వాతుల కిం తవ నాస్తి నియంతా ।
iast: kā te kāntā dhana-gata-cintā vātula kiṃ tava nāsti niyantā
verses.en_meaning: Who is this wife of yours, O madman, whose preoccupation with wealth consumes you? Have you no one to restrain you? In all three worlds, only the company of the good and wise is the boat that carries one across the ocean of samsara.
verses.words: kā te kāntā (who is your beloved), dhana-gata-cintā (this preoccupation with wealth), vātula (O madman), kim tava nāsti niyantā (have you no one to restrain you), tri-jagati (in the three worlds), saj-jana-saṅgatir ekā (only the company of the good/wise), bhavārṇava-taraṇe naukā (is the boat to cross the ocean of samsara).

verses.label: Bhaja Govindam · Verse 14
deva: पश्यन्नपि च न पश्यति मूढो ह्युदरनिमित्तं बहुकृतवेषः ॥ १४॥
te: పశ్యన్న్-అపి చ న పశ్యతి మూఢో హ్యుదర-నిమిత్తం బహు-కృత-వేషః ॥ ౧౪॥
iast: paśyann-api ca na paśyati mūḍho hy-udara-nimittaṃ bahu-kṛta-veṣaḥ || 14 ||
verses.en_meaning: Many wear matted locks, many are shaven-headed, many have their hair plucked out, and many don saffron robes — all merely as disguises for livelihood. Though seeing the truth before them, the foolish do not truly perceive it.
verses.words: jaṭilaḥ (one with matted locks), muṇḍī (a shaven-headed one), luñcita-keśaḥ (one with plucked-out hair), kāṣāya-ambara-bahu-kṛta-veṣaḥ (many disguised in saffron robes), paśyann api na paśyati (even while seeing, does not truly see), udara-nimittam (merely for the sake of the belly, livelihood).

verses.label: Bhaja Govindam · Verse 15
deva: अङ्गं गलितं पलितं मुण्डं दशनविहीनं जातं तुण्डम् ।
वृद्धो याति गृहीत्वा दण्डं तदपि न मुञ्चत्याशापिण्डम् ॥ १५॥
te: అంగం గలితం పలితం ముండం దశన-విహీనం జాతం తుండమ్ ।
వృద్ధో యాతి గృహీత్వా దండం తద్-అపి న ముంచత్యాశా-పిండమ్ ॥ ౧౫॥
iast: aṅgaṃ galitaṃ palitaṃ muṇḍaṃ daśana-vihīnaṃ jātaṃ tuṇḍam
vṛddho yāti gṛhītvā daṇḍaṃ tad-api na muñcaty-āśā-piṇḍam || 15 ||
verses.en_meaning: The body has decayed, the head has grown grey and bald, the mouth has become toothless, and the old man walks leaning upon a staff — yet even then he does not let go of his bundle of desires.
verses.words: aṅgam galitam (the body has decayed), palitam muṇḍam (the head has turned grey/bald), daśana-vihīnam jātaṃ tuṇḍam (the mouth has become toothless), vṛddhaḥ yāti gṛhītvā daṇḍam (the old man walks leaning on a staff), tad api na muñcati āśā-piṇḍam (still he does not let go of the bundle of desires).

verses.label: Bhaja Govindam · Verse 16
deva: अग्रे वह्निः पृष्ठे भानुः रात्रौ चुबुकसमर्पितजानुः ।
te: అగ్రే వహ్నిః పృష్ఠే భానుః రాత్రౌ చుబుక-సమర్పిత-జానుః ।
iast: agre vahniḥ pṛṣṭhe bhānuḥ rātrau cubuka-samarpita-jānuḥ
verses.en_meaning: With fire in front and the sun behind, at night curling up with chin resting on knee, eating alms from the palm of his hand, and dwelling beneath a tree — even such a one does not release the noose of desire.
verses.words: agre vahniḥ (fire in front), pṛṣṭhe bhānuḥ (the sun behind), rātrau cubuka-samarpita-jānuḥ (at night, chin resting on knee), kara-tala-bhikṣaḥ (begging food into the palm of the hand), taru-tala-vāsaḥ (dwelling beneath a tree), āśā-pāśaḥ na muñcati (still does not release the noose of desire).

verses.label: Bhaja Govindam · Verse 17
deva: ज्ञानविहीनः सर्वमतेन मुक्तिं न भजति जन्मशतेन ॥ १७॥
te: జ్ఞాన-విహీనః సర్వమతేన ముక్తిం న భజతి జన్మ-శతేన ॥ ౧౭॥
iast: jñāna-vihīnaḥ sarva-matena muktiṃ na bhajati janma-śatena || 17 ||
verses.en_meaning: One may travel to Gangasagar, observe vows, or give charity — yet, devoid of true knowledge, by every account, liberation is not attained even in a hundred births.
verses.words: kurute gaṅgā-sāgara-gamanam (one may travel to Gangasagar), vrata-paripālanam (observe vows), athavā dānam (or give charity), jñāna-vihīnaḥ (devoid of true knowledge), sarva-matena (by all accounts), muktim na bhajati janma-śatena (does not attain liberation even in a hundred births).

verses.label: Bhaja Govindam · Verse 18
deva: सर्वपरिग्रहभोगत्यागः कस्य सुखं न करोति विरागः ॥ १८॥
te: సర్వ-పరిగ్రహ-భోగ-త్యాగః కస్య సుఖం న కరోతి విరాగః ॥ ౧౮॥
iast: sarva-parigraha-bhoga-tyāgaḥ kasya sukhaṃ na karoti virāgaḥ || 18 ||
verses.en_meaning: Dwelling in a temple or at the foot of a tree, with the bare earth as one's bed and a deerskin as one's garment, renouncing all possessions and pleasures — for whom does such dispassion not bring happiness?
verses.words: sura-mandira-taru-mūla-nivāsaḥ (dwelling in a temple or at the foot of a tree), śayyā bhūtalam (the bare earth as one's bed), ajinam vāsaḥ (a deerskin as one's garment), sarva-parigraha-bhoga-tyāgaḥ (renouncing all possessions and pleasures), kasya sukham na karoti virāgaḥ (for whom does dispassion not bring happiness).

verses.label: Bhaja Govindam · Verse 19
deva: योगरतो वा भोगरतो वा सङ्गरतो वा सङ्गविहीनः ।
यस्य ब्रह्मणि रमते चित्तं नन्दति नन्दति नन्दत्येव ॥ १९॥
te: యోగ-రతో వా భోగ-రతో వా సంగ-రతో వా సంగ-విహీనః ।
యస్య బ్రహ్మణి రమతే చిత్తం నందతి నందతి నందత్యేవ ॥ ౧౯॥
iast: yoga-rato vā bhoga-rato vā saṅga-rato vā saṅga-vihīnaḥ
yasya brahmaṇi ramate cittaṃ nandati nandati nandaty-eva || 19 ||
verses.en_meaning: Whether devoted to yoga or to enjoyment, whether attached or free of attachment — only he whose mind delights in Brahman truly rejoices, rejoices indeed.
verses.words: yoga-rataḥ vā (whether devoted to yoga), bhoga-rataḥ vā (or devoted to enjoyment), saṅga-rataḥ vā saṅga-vihīnaḥ (whether attached or free of attachment), yasya brahmaṇi ramate cittam (whoever's mind delights in Brahman), nandati nandati nandaty-eva (rejoices, rejoices, truly rejoices).

verses.label: Bhaja Govindam · Verse 20
deva: सकृदपि येन मुरारिसमर्चा क्रियते तस्य यमेन न चर्चा ॥ २०॥
te: సకృద్-అపి యేన మురారి-సమర్చా క్రియతే తస్య యమేన న చర్చా ॥ ౨౦॥
iast: sakṛd-api yena murāri-samarcā kriyate tasya yamena na carcā || 20 ||
verses.en_meaning: For one who has studied even a little of the Bhagavad Gita, drunk even a tiny drop of Ganga water, and worshipped Murari even once — for him there is no reckoning to fear from Yama, the lord of death.
verses.words: bhagavad-gītā kiñcid-adhītā (having studied even a little of the Bhagavad Gita), gaṅgā-jala-lava-kaṇikā pītā (having drunk even a tiny drop of Ganga water), sakṛd api (even once), murāri-samarcā kriyate (worship of Murari is performed), tasya yamena na carcā (for him there is no reckoning with Yama).

verses.label: Bhaja Govindam · Verse 21
deva: पुनरपि जननं पुनरपि मरणं पुनरपि जननीजठरे शयनम् ।
इह संसारे बहुदुस्तारे कृपयाऽपारे पाहि मुरारे ॥ २१॥
te: పునర్-అపి జననం పునర్-అపి మరణం పునర్-అపి జననీ-జఠరే శయనమ్ ।
ఇహ సంసారే బహు-దుస్తారే కృపయాఽపారే పాహి మురారే ॥ ౨౧॥
iast: punarapi jananaṃ punarapi maraṇaṃ punarapi jananī-jaṭhare śayanam
iha saṃsāre bahu-dustāre kṛpayā’pāre pāhi murāre || 21 ||
verses.en_meaning: Birth again, death again, and again lying within a mother's womb — this boundless samsara is so hard to cross. O Murari, protect me through Your mercy.
verses.words: punarapi jananam (birth again), punarapi maraṇam (death again), punarapi jananī-jaṭhare śayanam (lying again in a mother's womb), iha saṃsāre bahu-dustāre (in this samsara so hard to cross), apāre (boundless), kṛpayā pāhi murāre (protect me by Your grace, O Murari).

verses.label: Bhaja Govindam · Verse 22
verses.en_meaning: Clothed in a patchwork garment of rags picked off the road, walking a path free of merit and sin, the yogi whose mind is fixed in yoga revels in bliss, just like a child or one who is intoxicated.
verses.words: rathyā-carpaṭa-viracita-kanthaḥ (one whose patchwork garment is made of rags picked off the road), puṇya-apuṇya-vivarjita-panthaḥ (whose path is free from merit and sin), yogī yoga-niyojita-cittaḥ (the yogi whose mind is fixed in yoga), ramate bālonmattavad-eva (revels just like a child or an intoxicated person).

verses.label: Bhaja Govindam · Verse 23
deva: कस्त्वं कोऽहं कुत आयातः का मे जननी को मे तातः ।
इति परिभावय सर्वमसारं विश्वं त्यक्त्वा स्वप्नविचारम् ॥ २३॥
te: కస్-త్వం కోఽహం కుత ఆయాతః కా మే జననీ కో మే తాతః ।
ఇతి పరిభావయ సర్వమ్-అసారం విశ్వం త్యక్త్వా స్వప్న-విచారమ్ ॥ ౨౩॥
iast: kas-tvaṃ ko’haṃ kuta āyātaḥ kā me jananī ko me tātaḥ
iti paribhāvaya sarvam-asāraṃ viśvaṃ tyaktvā svapna-vicāram || 23 ||
verses.en_meaning: Who are you? Who am I? From where have I come? Who is my mother, who is my father? Reflect thus, that all this is without essence, and let go of this world like the idle thoughts of a dream.
verses.words: kaḥ tvam (who are you), ko’ham (who am I), kuta āyātaḥ (where have I come from), kā me jananī (who is my mother), ko me tātaḥ (who is my father), iti paribhāvaya (reflect thus), sarvam asāram (all is essence-less), viśvam tyaktvā svapna-vicāram (give up this world as one gives up dream-thoughts).

verses.label: Bhaja Govindam · Verse 24
deva: त्वयि मयि चान्यत्रैको विष्णुर्व्यर्थं कुप्यसि मय्यसहिष्णुः ।
भव समचित्तः सर्वत्र त्वं वाञ्छस्यचिराद्यदि विष्णुत्वम् ॥ २४॥
te: త్వయి మయి చాన్యత్రైకో విష్ణుర్-వ్యర్థం కుప్యసి మయ్యసహిష్ణుః ।
భవ సమ-చిత్తః సర్వత్ర త్వం వాంఛస్యచిరాద్-యది విష్ణుత్వమ్ ॥ ౨౪॥
iast: tvayi mayi cānyatraiko viṣṇur-vyarthaṃ kupyasi mayy-asahiṣṇuḥ
bhava sama-cittaḥ sarvatra tvaṃ vāñchasy-acirād-yadi viṣṇutvam || 24 ||
verses.en_meaning: In you, in me, and everywhere, dwells the one Vishnu alone — your anger and impatience with me are needless. Be even-minded everywhere, if you wish to attain the state of Vishnu without delay.
verses.words: tvayi mayi ca anyatra ekaḥ viṣṇuḥ (in you, in me, and everywhere is the one Vishnu), vyartham kupyasi mayi asahiṣṇuḥ (you needlessly grow angry and impatient with me), bhava sama-cittaḥ sarvatra (be even-minded everywhere), vāñchasi acirāt yadi viṣṇutvam (if you wish soon to attain the state of Vishnu).

verses.label: Bhaja Govindam · Verse 25
deva: शत्रौ मित्रे पुत्रे बन्धौ मा कुरु यत्नं विग्रहसन्धौ ।
te: శత్రౌ మిత్రే పుత్రే బంధౌ మా కురు యత్నం విగ్రహ-సంధౌ ।
iast: śatrau mitre putre bandhau mā kuru yatnaṃ vigraha-sandhau
verses.en_meaning: Toward an enemy, a friend, a son, or a relative, make no special effort in conflict or reconciliation. See the Self in everyone, and abandon everywhere the notion of duality.
verses.words: śatrau mitre putre bandhau (toward an enemy, a friend, a son, a relative), mā kuru yatnam vigraha-sandhau (make no effort in conflict or reconciliation), sarvasmin api paśya ātmānam (see the Self in everyone), sarvatra utsṛja bhedājñānam (abandon everywhere the notion of difference).

verses.label: Bhaja Govindam · Verse 26
deva: कामं क्रोधं लोभं मोहं त्यक्त्वाऽऽत्मानं भावय कोऽहम् ।
te: కామం క్రోధం లోభం మోహం త్యక్త్వాఽఽత్మానం భావయ కోఽహమ్ ।
iast: kāmaṃ krodhaṃ lobhaṃ mohaṃ tyaktvā.ātmānaṃ bhāvaya ko’ham
verses.en_meaning: Give up lust, anger, greed, and delusion, and contemplate the truth of who you really are. Those foolish ones devoid of Self-knowledge are cast into hell and suffer there endlessly.
verses.words: kāmam krodham lobham moham tyaktvā (having given up lust, anger, greed, and delusion), ātmānam bhāvaya ko’ham (contemplate the truth of who am I), ātma-jñāna-vihīnā mūḍhāḥ (those fools devoid of Self-knowledge), pacyante naraka-nigūḍhāḥ (are cast into hell and suffer there).

verses.label: Bhaja Govindam · Verse 27
deva: नेयं सज्जनसङ्गे चित्तं देयं दीनजनाय च वित्तम् ॥ २७॥
te: నేయం సజ్-జన-సంగే చిత్తం దేయం దీన-జనాయ చ విత్తమ్ ॥ ౨౭॥
iast: neyaṃ saj-jana-saṅge cittaṃ deyaṃ dīna-janāya ca vittam || 27 ||
verses.en_meaning: Recite the Gita and the thousand names of the Lord; meditate constantly on the form of Vishnu; lead your mind ever into the company of the good; and give of your wealth to the poor and needy.
verses.words: geyam gītā-nāma-sahasram (recite the Gita and the thousand names of Vishnu), dhyeyam śrīpati-rūpam ajasram (meditate constantly on the form of Vishnu), neyam saj-jana-saṅge cittam (lead the mind into the company of the good), deyam dīna-janāya ca vittam (give wealth to the poor and needy).

verses.label: Bhaja Govindam · Verse 28
deva: सुखतः क्रियते रामाभोगः पश्चाद्धन्त शरीरे रोगः ।
यद्यपि लोके मरणं शरणं तदपि न मुञ्चति पापाचरणम् ॥ २८॥
te: సుఖతః క్రియతే రామా-భోగః పశ్చాద్-ధంత శరీరే రోగః ।
యద్యపి లోకే మరణం శరణం తద్-అపి న ముంచతి పాపాచరణమ్ ॥ ౨౮॥
iast: sukhataḥ kriyate rāmā-bhogaḥ paścād-dhanta śarīre rogaḥ
yadyapi loke maraṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ tad-api na muñcati pāpācaraṇam || 28 ||
verses.en_meaning: For the sake of pleasure one indulges in sensual enjoyment, but afterward, alas, the body falls prey to disease. Although death is the final refuge in this world, still one does not give up sinful conduct.
verses.words: sukhataḥ kriyate rāmā-bhogaḥ (for the sake of pleasure one indulges in sensual enjoyment), paścāt dhanta śarīre rogaḥ (alas, afterward the body falls prey to disease), yadyapi loke maraṇam śaraṇam (though in this world death is the final refuge), tad api na muñcati pāpācaraṇam (still one does not give up sinful conduct).

verses.label: Bhaja Govindam · Verse 29
deva: अर्थमनर्थं भावय नित्यं नास्तिततः सुखलेशः सत्यम् ।
पुत्रादपि धनभाजां भीतिः सर्वत्रैषा विहिता रीतिः ॥ २९॥
te: అర్థమ్-అనర్థం భావయ నిత్యం నాస్తి-తతః సుఖ-లేశః సత్యమ్ ।
పుత్రాద్-అపి ధన-భాజాం భీతిః సర్వత్రైషా విహితా రీతిః ॥ ౨౯॥
iast: artham-anarthaṃ bhāvaya nityaṃ nāstitataḥ sukha-leśaḥ satyam
putrād-api dhana-bhājāṃ bhītiḥ sarvatraiṣā vihitā rītiḥ || 29 ||
verses.en_meaning: Constantly reflect that wealth is truly a source of trouble, not happiness — from it there is not the least bit of real joy. The wealthy fear even their own sons; such is the way of the world everywhere.
verses.words: artham anartham bhāvaya nityam (constantly reflect that wealth is a source of trouble), na asti tataḥ sukha-leśaḥ satyam (truly, from it there is not the least bit of happiness), putrāt api dhana-bhājām bhītiḥ (the wealthy fear even their own sons), sarvatra eṣā vihitā rītiḥ (such is the way everywhere).

verses.label: Bhaja Govindam · Verse 30
verses.en_meaning: Practice regulation of the breath, withdrawal of the senses, and the discernment between the eternal and the transient. Undertake the discipline of meditation together with repetition of the divine name — and do all this with the utmost, careful attention.
verses.words: prāṇāyāmam (regulation of the breath), pratyāhāram (withdrawal of the senses), nityānitya-viveka-vicāram (discernment between the eternal and the transient), jāpya-sameta-samādhi-vidhānam (the discipline of meditation together with repetition of the divine name), kuru avadhānam mahat avadhānam (do this with great, careful attention).

verses.label: Bhaja Govindam · Verse 31
verses.en_meaning: O devotee wholly devoted to the lotus feet of the Guru, become free from samsara without delay. Through such discipline of the senses and the mind, you shall behold the Lord who dwells within your own heart.
verses.words: guru-caraṇa-ambuja-nirbhara-bhaktaḥ (O devoted one, wholly devoted to the lotus feet of the Guru), saṃsārāt acirāt bhava muktaḥ (become free from samsara without delay), sendriya-mānasa-niyamāt evam (through such discipline of the senses and the mind), drakṣyasi nija-hṛdayastham devam (you shall behold the Lord dwelling within your own heart).
